reviews.author: Nina N
reviews.title: They have roaches!!
reviews.text: The resort itself is beautiful. The beach is kept clean. The food was really good at the restaurants and the buffet. However all of this was negated because this property has roaches. Not large water bugs but actual roaches 🪳🪳🪳🪳. I saw another review showing this and should have viewed it before staying. We were so paranoid we would bring back roaches with us we shook everything out before leaving the property. We addressed it with the front desk who then directed us to guest services. All they did was have the room cleaned again and sprayed. No compensation. We emailed their customer care team after the trip. They first needed proof which thankfully we took a video and photo of the first roach we saw. They then said there was no record of the incident at the hotel and denied any compensation since in their words this is typical for tropical places. Untrue I’ve never encountered roaches in any resort I’ve stayed at! They then researched more and found I did report the incident but said my reservation was under some type of complimentary stay. I then said this is false I paid nearly $4000 for my 2 rooms and at this point I feel like you all are making up excuses to not compensate me. They then came back and said sorry again you are correct. There final decision was to give me an upgrade for a future reservation. If you think I will ever stay at another Melia property you are sadly mistaken! This was the first and absolutely the last time! This brand is not trustworthy. Nobody spends thousands to share a room with roaches! This site won’t allow me to upload my video unfortunately.

reviews.author: anna r
reviews.title: All Bad save your money go somewhere else
reviews.text: The staff for the most part is lazy, rude, not helpful, poor communication. We were waiting to be picked up for an excursion at the front of the hotel and one of the staff members told us we have to be at a different location to get picked up. The van to pick us up was a no show, we called the vendor and they informed us that we should have stayed at the front lobby and the staff brought us to the wrong place. We almost missed out on our excursion. A lot of the tables were missing glasses, spoons and forks. Service was very inconsistent. The person servicing the pool by our room was never there. The drinks were terrible and had a medicine after taste, the sheets were itchy, very few people spoke English, no exchange for USD (the ppl at the airport said the hotel would have), the music OMG terrible. Mostly old school bachata. If you are looking to be ignored, confused and to just sleep most of the day go there. If you are looking for a good time with great and friendly staff go somewhere else.

reviews.author: ANNA K
reviews.title: Poor service, not fresh food
reviews.text: Poor service not fresh food in the buffet breakfast and lunch poor communication only 20% of  employees spoke  English

reviews.author: MarekSoraia
reviews.title: Illicit drugs used by guest next to our room
reviews.text: Awful experience as next door guest smoking cannabis which makes our room, corridor and balcony unbearable to stay in. We reported to the reserve reception as we couldn't take anymore as at this point spoilt our staying. I've asked the reception - lady on the night shift to called the cleaners to spray air freshener to minimise the smells however,  still could smells in our balcony due the the couple next door smoking nonstop. The security been called to their room I could see that they refused to open their doors. Next morning the smells worsen yet again we reported and yet again the security been called to issue another warning. Surely in Dominican Republic  marijuana is illicit drugs and should not been use in a  5 stars hotel. And we have to reinforced the hotel to do something about to the point that causes extreme stress and inconvenience.

reviews.author: r0np24
reviews.title: Skip...
reviews.text: Room security issues. Quality of service throughout was atrocious. Definitely some good individuals here and there, but most people working here didn't seem to want to be there. I'd suggest going somewhere else and skipping this one for sure. I've stayed at other melia locations that were pretty good, but not sure I'd continue staying at Melia locations after this

reviews.author: Jade Huguet
reviews.title: Not a 5-star experience - extremely disappointing stay
reviews.text:
We chose this resort expecting a true 5-star experience, especially because it had been renovated in the last 2 years. Unfortunately, it has been one of the most disappointing hotel stays we’ve had. From the moment we arrived, things started off disappointingly. We checked in at 3:00 PM and quickly realized that the sofa bed mattress in our room was completely unacceptable, you could feel every spring, making it impossible to sleep on. 
They knew we were 3 mothers. We reported this issue to the front desk around 5:00 PM before dinner and were assured it would be resolved. When we returned at 9:30 PM, exhausted from traveling, nothing had been done. 
Cockroach: The situation got worse when we discovered a large cockroach on the wall of our room. While we understand that insects can occasionally happen in tropical destinations, this is absolutely not acceptable in a hotel that claims to be 5-star. Even more concerning was the lack of urgency or proper response from staff when we reported it. We have photos documenting these issues, its not an exaggeration. We were told that “a” manager would contact us the following day at 10:00 AM. No such contact was made. We were instead obliged to follow up again, and only received a response at 3:22 PM the next day. This delay further demonstrates a lack of prompt and appropriate handling of the situation. The proposed alternative only included a room change within the same building.
The Melia will probably answer in this chat that they responded rapidly and with a nice offer. This is not true and I have WhatsApp chat to prove it. After2 days of discussion with them, meaning we had to fight for a proper upgrade, an additional “compensation” was offered, including access to a Bali bed, a 30-minute massage (only 2, and we were 3). These compensation are wholly inadequate given the circumstances. It does not compensate for the distress experienced, including the discomfort and concern associated with the presence of the insect, the repeated delays, the effort required to obtain responses, and the attitude displayed by your staff.
Lying to customer: At check-in, we requested to pay the USD 450 upgrade fee for access to “The Reserve” section. The front desk employee informed us that no availability remained. However, in parallel, I contacted the representative by email, who advised that rooms were indeed available and that we should present ourselves accordingly. This inconsistency raises concerns regarding the accuracy of the information provided and the overall standard of customer service.
Additional hidden fees: To make matters worse, the next morning we were told that if we wanted beach chairs with an ocean view, we would need to pay an additional fee. Charging extra for basic beach access in an all-inclusive resort, especially at this price point, is simply unacceptable.
Overall, the service, responsiveness, and quality of the experience do not match the level this hotel advertises. At this price, guests should not have to deal with uncomfortable sleeping arrangements, hygiene concerns, and constant upselling. We strongly recommend future travelers to reconsider before booking here, as this property does not deliver on its promises.
We believe that transparency is important, and as such, we intend to accurately report our experience. Note that I have not uploaded all WhatsApp conv. But did upload the insect photo.  

Overall, the resort offers excellent food, the buffet is varied and high quality, and the steakhouse is outstanding. However, the wine selection is disappointing, and the à la carte options are priced at an excessive markup.
More importantly, the overall management approach at the Melia property feels lacking. There is a clear absence of follow-up and accountability, which gives the impression that issues are left unresolved in the hope that guests will simply move on. For example, a meaningful room upgrade could likely have mitigated the impact of the first night and improved the rest of the stay, rather than having to deal with ongoing discomfort.
The so-called “upgrades” offered (such as a short massage or access to a Bali bed with additional hidden fees) feel superficial and do not reflect the level of service expected from a resort of this category. In higher-quality resorts such as Club Med, more substantial gestures are typically made to address guest concerns and make them come back. This contrast gives the impression that Melia prioritizes revenue without delivering a comparable level of service in return.

reviews.author: Katie D
reviews.title: Horrible experience with concierge hired transport
reviews.text: The hotel concierge arranged a ride for us to the airport. The person who transported us is “Transporte Sandro.”  I was charged $535 for a $35 ride. The hotel will not get back to me to help me with my fraud claim. I have reached out several times and I am ignored. I am not able to move forward without their help.

reviews.author: vic2rruizm
reviews.title: Lindas instalaciones, sin variedad en los alimentos y pésima calidad en los vinos
reviews.text: El hotel tiene un area exclusiva por la que pagas mas, The Reserve, y te ofrecen vino Frontera de 5 USD, saque usted su conclusión. Los buffets parecen fotografías, lo mismo todos los dias. Hay restaurante para la cena que debes reservar, pero cuya calidad deja mucho que desear. Las habitaciones son muy buenas

reviews.author: Guilherme M
reviews.title: Be carefull before booking this place
reviews.text:
Hotel is overrated. The price charged is completely unrealistic for what it offers. Upon arrival, the guy who took our luggage to the room left angry and slammed the door because he didn’t receive a tip. The room was supposed to be for a honeymoon from the start, but they gave us a room with two single beds and did not allow us to change it—unless we paid an extra $800.
There’s no coconut water, no freezers around the resort to grab drinks freely. There’s no ice cream. There’s no heated pool. It was hard to even find a bar that had food. You have to order food and wait for it to be prepared, sometimes taking more than 20 minutes.
I tried to book a restaurant for dinner, but there was no availability—not even for the next day. And the restaurants don’t allow reservations more than two days in advance. I went to get a beer at the beach kiosk, and they said my reservation didn’t cover beach beer. I went to another bar to get wine, but the wines are extremely expensive (yes, they charge for wine at an “all-inclusive” resort).
The room amenities are low quality. Liquid soap. There’s no music, no parties, no shows. It claims to be adults-only, but there are lots of children. Food service is only available at certain hours at the buffet (the only place with food for those who couldn’t get restaurant reservations). I asked for a Corona at a bar, and they said I wasn’t entitled to it. For a coconut or a Redbull you must pay U$$5 extra for each one. The beer is warm and far to get one. ALL inclusive total fake news.
This is the worst all-inclusive resort I’ve ever been to.

reviews.author: Lambchop4ever
reviews.title: Terrible all inclusive
reviews.text: This all inclusive does not tell you that they only offer one place to eat for breakfast and lunch daily and it is the same food everyday. Also, for dinner you must make reservations which are made for two nights at a time. We knew when arriving we would not get a dinner reservation. The next morning we attempted to but they were sold out of all the restaurants. Some only took a max of 34 people for the entire evening. We ended up getting staff to book us at Flora, which is an adults only restaurant for us and our 3 children. We arrived and there were only 2 families there in the entire restaurant but they were “sold out.” They do not offer enough restaurants for how many guests they take, and they know this. Customer service was beyond terrible. We attempted to purchase sunscreen at the gift shop, and were told they did not have change to break a bill and told us we had to go to customer service. I advised the staff that this was their job and they needed to get change in order to operate their business. The room was decent. Housekeeping comes really late in the day. Our patio table was cracked. Maintenance was terrible. I would    Save yourself the headache and go elsewhere.

reviews.author: JTipp2020
reviews.title: Don’t go for the service or food.
reviews.text: The service was so bad it overshadowed the beauty of the place. It was clean and the food was terrible. It was cheap but the service was terrible.

reviews.author: NewYorkPresa
reviews.title: Very disappointed once again
reviews.text:
We have been coming to Palma Real since it opened. We visit a few times each year with our family and our employees, and during the first year after opening the hotel was truly special. The service was kind and attentive, the staff felt genuine, the food was fresh and high quality, and the rooms were always clean and ready—everything felt like a real top hotel.
But honestly, it’s not like that anymore. And it’s been really disappointing to see how much things have changed.
Room check-in delays and missing items
We also had issues with our room and check-in. On our second stay this year, the room was not prepared for our arrival, and the check-in process had constant delays.
We requested an extra bed for our child, and it took many hours and requests to five different people. We finally received the bed at 9:00 PM, but it came without pillows and without a cover. The room was also missing basic things like robes, slippers, an iron, and lotions.
Lack of entertainment
Another big change we noticed is the lack of entertainment and weekly repetitive of the same entrainment. In the past, there was more to do and more atmosphere. This time, it felt quite limited and not what we expected from the hotel.
Evening dinner reservations are very difficult
We also found it extremely difficult to reserve evening diners. Availability to book restaurants for dinner was very limited, and it was hard to get reservations—even when we tried ahead of time.
Food concerns
One of the problem for us recently has been the food as well. Several times it didn’t seem fresh, and we noticed it with items that had a bad smell (especially fish). We mentioned this to the chef, and we were really concerned about guests getting sick.
We also noticed that some food (like chicken and beef) seemed old and dry, and then it was mixed back into sauce to make it look and taste “okay” again.
The situation that made us most uncomfortable was what we saw in front of us. The chef took shrimp that didn’t look the same, quickly toasted them in sauce, and mixed them with other shrimp, then seemed to look around to make sure no one noticed. When he saw me, he quickly disappeared.
I’m sharing this because food should not be handled in a way that could affect guests’ health.
I’m writing because I genuinely want Palma Real to return to the level it used to be. It’s hard to explain how disappointing this experience has become, especially since we used to really love staying here.

reviews.author: Tork0818
reviews.title: Service & Food
reviews.text:
I contacted the resort ahead of time after hearing concerns about service and difficulty getting restaurant reservations. I was seriously considering canceling and booking elsewhere, but I was assured that everything would be taken care of for both our group and our in-laws.

Unfortunately, that was not the case. Reservations were made for us but not for our in-laws, and by the time we realized this, nothing else was available. As a result, we weren’t able to use the reservations at all, which was extremely frustrating and disappointing.

We also had a concierge assigned to us, but despite multiple requests, not a single one was followed through on. This added to the overall lack of service we experienced throughout our stay.

We even booked a spa service at check-in, but when we arrived for our appointment, there was no record of our reservation. That was another frustrating example of the lack of organization and communication.

For the amount we spent, the experience was nowhere near worth it. In addition to the reservation issues, the service overall was very poor, and the food at the buffet was especially disappointing.

The only highlight of our trip was the beach experience, which was excellent. If it weren’t for that, the trip would have been a complete disappointment.

reviews.author: C1460ZXmartined
reviews.title: Muy mala experiencis
reviews.text: La estadía en The reserve no cumplió en nada el standart mínimo para esa categoría que ofrecen en atencion

reviews.author: FarAway00826625645
reviews.title: Major disappointment
reviews.text:
This resort is interesting— very beautiful setting in the beach and impressive views; but the rooms are the absolute worst I’ve ever experienced! The walls and door is so paper thin—it’s currently 2:15 am and I’m wide awake listening to a baby crying on one side and a couple on the other side “sporting”. This was after being able to hear the live music in the lobby area playing until 11:00 pm. 

And while it’s all inclusive, the quality of the food offered is low. Room service is unappealing and many of the on-resort restaurants are a disappointment including the massive breakfast buffet. 

Such a shame. This place has a lot of potential but I’d wish we would have booked some place else.

reviews.author: Lauren G
reviews.title: I’ve never been so underwhelmed
reviews.text: Property was beautiful- that is where the compliments stop. The property is extremely spaced out, which in theory is great because you aren’t tripping on other people. That said, there are zero food options outside the main building (so no poolside or beachside service) so if you are staying in a room farther from the main area, or are on the beach and hungry, you have to pack up and walk 10min to the buffet, which was lackluster at best and gross at worst. I was seriously concerned about food poisoning given how tepid most of the hot food options were. I also watched the omelet chef drop his mixing spoon, quickly rinse it off with water only and the go right back to using it. I regularly witnessed flies hanging out on the buffet food and the first time we ate there, my utensils came wrapped in a dirty/used napkin. Towel huts were scarce and not apparent. Given that there were like 20 pools, this wasn’t great. None of phones in our room worked so I couldn’t call the desk about the hairdryer that didn’t work.  There are so many other, smaller things that happened, but these are the big ones. 100% not worth the money.

reviews.author: frankofrancesco1900
reviews.title: Fabelhafte Zimmer und Anlage - unterirdische Kulinarik
reviews.text:
Das Hotel verfügt über fabelhafte Zimmer und eine gepflegte Anlage. Die Zimmerreinigung war auch tadellos.

Da man aber bei all-inclusive nirgendwo anders essen kann wiegen die Mängel bei der Kulinarik leider schwer.

Themen:
- Hygiene mit Wasser, Eis und Speisen mangelhaft. 
- Viele Magen-Darm-Erkrankungen. Ich schätze dass 20% unserer (sehr großen) Gruppe krank waren
- Standard Wein und Perlwein sehr schlecht
- Speisen fast immer kalt serviert, am Buffet aber auch im Service-Restaurant
- fertige Speisen und Zutaten (Fleisch, Fisch, Patties, ...) liegen stundenlang ungekühlt am Buffet
- Gläser, Teller u. Besteck nie richtig sauber

reviews.author: tanyamurtland
reviews.title: The worst resort I have ever been at
reviews.text: The food was so terrible we lived off of lays chips in the mini bar.  Many in our group got sick with stomach issues. The trip was so bad, we came back early and will never go back to the DR!

reviews.author: Joseph F
reviews.title: VERY SUBPAR RESORT THAT DOES NOT DELIVER
reviews.text:
Upon check in I noticed that room had some issues including bathroom door not able to close , refrigerator was not working and air conditioning shutting off every 5 minutes. Discussed with front desk and they kind of just made a face they did not want to be bothered.  Non of this was resolved so I just let it be at this point. 

Went to Italian restaurant the first night. The food was horrible and honestly un edible including the appetizers and main entrees and because I tried some of food I had to run to the toilet soon afterwards on multiple occasions. 

I do not understand why the service to get food took so long because it seemed as thought whatever they were servicing was either defrosted or taken out of refrigerator and put in microwave for a bit.  ( Un acceptable ). 

Tried making reservations for other restaurants - nothing available. Again do not understand . The place looked like a ghost town. 

Able to get a cancelled reservation for hibachi where about 30 people were placed tightly around the table. Again food was horrible.  When you order a drink at pool side bar they give you a dirty look. 

If no reservations are available then your only option is the buffet and that gets boring after a while and overall was mediocre. 

I did not choose this resort. It was chosen for the occasion that was being celebrated. 

Did not care care of nightly entertainment. The sports bar did not have any event that I would have wanted to watch.  Beach a lot of seaweed.

No non motorized water activities included. Every resort I have been to includes this. 

Enjoyed the coffee shop and desserts and some of the staff was friendly and accommodating however overall I would not recommend this resort.

reviews.author: esparzatorrespaloma
reviews.title: Una pesadilla
reviews.text: En el total de mi estancia solo tuve 1 dia bueno, todo fue una verdadera pesadilla! Sus habitaciones de pésima calidad

reviews.author: Lisa P
reviews.title: Stay anywhere else!! Workers are not trustworthy
reviews.text: Do not stay here. The workers are liars. The customer service is sub par. The resort is new and the rooms are nice but service leaves a lot to be desired. If you request any changes to your reservation make sure you get them in writing. No waiter service by the pool or beach. No food service by the pool or beach either. We booked directly through the hotel and stayed on the reserve side. Our butler / concierge made dinner reservations for us at times we did not prefer however the dinners were good. Room service menu is limited. The fridge in our room did not work all week and all they offered was an ode bucket that remained on the table all week after melting the first day. The hotel is not very crowded and no where near at capacity. Check in took forever despite having private check in at the vip suite. Skip this place and find somewhere with staff that is more accommodating. Rooms didn’t get cleaned until 530 one night. Finally got wash cloths on our last day. After our two hour check in, we were taken on a tour of the resort and when we finally got to our rooms our bags still weren’t there. Slow service. Stay elsewhere. Also you can’t turn the AC below 69F but the room only ever gets to 74F. Everything was very damp in our room.

reviews.author: borjabr84
reviews.title: Desencanto absoluto
reviews.text: Cuando reservas un viaje de este tipo y además te lo venden como una experiencia superior, al menos esperas que te realicen la limpieza de la habitación. Pues ni eso. También estuve esperando 25 minutos a quye me recogieran en el lobby del hotel y los propios recepcionistas no supieron ayudarme. Resulta que el coche que me tenia que recoger estaba en la barrera de fuera del complejo y no le dejaban pasar, cuando yo había avisado de que esperaba un transfer. Eso por un lado. Otro día, tambien avisando con anterioridad vbiendo como se las gastan en la garita, tampoco dejaron que me llevaran un sobre con unas entradas para un espectáculo por lo que no pude acudir. El colmo de los colmos fue al ir a pagar en el check out cuando me dijeron que su máquina no aceptaba billetes de antes de 2006. Como si fuesen ilegales o algo.... Fallo de las llaves que abrian las puertas de la habitacion,.... en fin, DESASTROSO

reviews.author: abhishekmudgil
reviews.title: Not a secure place to stay with your valuables
reviews.text:
I stayed there for 4 nights and put all my valuables, money, credit cards, passport in the safe. Still a bottle of cologne was stolen from my room during cleaning. This is not normal as in case I would've left other valuables open, the hotel staff would've stolen that too. 
Definitely not a secure place to be with family and if you have expensive clothes, accessories then please avoid staying at this place. 
Food is below average, unless you pay for the VIP rooms, where they serve better quality food. 
Later they found who stole that and offered me concession on the next day stay, which I accepted and regretted later coz they didn't live up their commitment on Concierge and other services.

reviews.author: Gerardo hot S
reviews.title: La reforma bajo la calidad del hotel
reviews.text:
Muy pocas Reposeras en relación a la cantidad de personas 
En la playa adelante de todas las Reposeras tiene instalados camastros que tapan la visión del 99% de la gente

reviews.author: Ira P
reviews.title: Flora restaurant experience
reviews.text: Restaurant  FLORA absolutely mess  and  terrible.  We waited to order meals and give some drinks 40 minutes and hour and half didn't get any food left.Few times I asked server  and each tie he was telling it's coming in few minutes, never came. We wet to eat in buffet . They advertise this place of famous chef-it's terrible place

reviews.author: Yeojin C
reviews.title: THE WORST HOTEL SERVICE EVER!!!
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience at this hotel. The biggest issue was the lack of help from the staff when it came to a refund for an incorrect/undeserved charge. Despite explaining the situation multiple times, the staff was unhelpful, dismissive, and showed no interest in resolving the problem. This really ruined my experience. Now I am filing a case with the PayPal to resolve the issue.

Customer service was extremely poor, and I felt ignored rather than supported. For a hotel, this level of service is unacceptable. I would not recommend staying here, especially if you expect fair treatment or assistance when issues arise.

Also, I visited multiple times over the last couple of years and I noticed that Food and Room service quality have gone down so much. Please Skip this HOTEL if you want a nice vacation.

reviews.author: Shannon K
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Great food and restaurants - nice property.  Guest services is horrible.  Complained about unreasonably loud television in unoccupied room next door at 2 am.  Took 2 additional complaints and 2 hours before issue was resolved.  Next day - same unreasonably loud television in unoccupied room.  Brought issue up 3 more times without resolution.  Will never return - hotel club member for 10 years - sadly disappointed!!

reviews.author: Federico C
reviews.title: Experiencia muy negativa con membresía Club Meliá – falta de transparencia
reviews.text:
En 2015 adquirí una membresía de Club Meliá durante una estadía en este hotel, por un valor aproximado de USD 27.000.

Con el paso del tiempo comprobé que los créditos ofrecidos resultan de muy difícil o prácticamente imposible utilización real, debido a restricciones, costos adicionales y falta de disponibilidad que no fueron explicadas claramente al momento de la venta.

A pesar de haber abonado la totalidad del contrato, actualmente mantengo créditos sin utilizar por un valor cercano a USD 17.000 y me encuentro solicitando formalmente la rescisión del contrato y una solución razonable, sin haber recibido hasta el momento una respuesta concreta por parte de la empresa.

Al pedir explicaciones porque la membresía no cumplía lo prometido, me ofrecieron asistir a una reunion para un upgrade indicando que la original ya no era conveniente, junto con masajes como incentivo por asistir a la reunión. 
Finalizada la reunion sin que yo acceda a la nueva membresia, no los otorgaron alegando que debía ir en pareja, condición nunca informada y que tampoco existía cuando contraté la membresía.

Considero importante que futuros huéspedes se informen exhaustivamente antes de aceptar presentaciones comerciales de membresías dentro del hotel.

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.title: Surprisingly sad in paradise
reviews.text:
I’m not one to complain…especially when I’m on vacation…BUT we’ve had several unexpected disappointments since our arrival which has not been the case on all my previous stays here:
1. Our room was ready for checkin  much later than promised 
2. Booking an ocean view room and getting a garden view room. We can see the ocean from the side of our balcony…but definitely NOT what is shown in the booking picture. 
3. Not having power in the room and having to have maintenance come back twice to finally replace a breaker that kept tripping
4. Our refrigerator isn’t working and hasn’t for 2 days which does not bode well when Jody’s medication needs to be refrigerated.  We’ve been keeping it in the ice bucket with us grabbing ice from the bar as it melts 🙄
5. There is no lighting in the hallways in our building so we have to stumble in the dark￼ or remember to bring our phones to use the flashlight app. Clearly there has been some power issues in the building that have yet to be resolved.

reviews.author: TAGS03
reviews.title: So far an awful experience- it can only get better from here I guess.
reviews.text:
We arrived this afternoon and so far this has been an awful experience. We have three adults in one room which sleeps four- four private. We were given a king bed and literally an ottoman. This is NOT a sofa bed. It doesn’t unfold and even at 5’3” I can’t lie flat on it. The bar fridge had one soda and one beer and no snacks. Only two towels for a room that sleeps four.  We were told there were no other rooms available and they would bring a rollaway bed and towels. Four requests to housekeeping and front desk and still no bed. When it finally arrived, only sheets were provided. No pillow. Had to make numerous requests for towels until finally another towel was delivered. 

I know other people have mentioned a butler and a beach bag and other amenities. We definitely were not given any of these- not even robes and only two clothes hangers in a room! So disappointing. We were happy to pay to upgrade to The Reserve but this was not available.

So far it’s been a miserable day but the good part is that it can only get better from here!

reviews.author: maf825
reviews.title: Beware---Double Charged for our children
reviews.text: even when booking a room for 2 adults in addition to the connecting room for 2 adults and you put two children in one of the rooms you paid for 2 adults in, they still charged us for children.

reviews.author: Sebastian O
reviews.title: Poor service bordering on racism and bad food...
reviews.text:
- English proficiency lacking
- Insufficient hospitality training
- Staff was inattentive (or out right ignoring)
- Food was horrible, keeping in mind that all inclusive resorts typically don't have the best food

Extremely bad service bordering on racism. Constant micro aggresions which we noticed was an apparent disdain for my family being here which even both my kids noticed. This was for approx 90% of the staff. There were a few above and beyond, particularly since I made it a habit to drop tips constantly as most did not tip at all. You can tell more trained staff weren't like this, but majority of the staff didn't seem to want us there. I had iitially chalked this up to lack of english proficiency but you could tell there was an issue after a few days. I wouldn't go here if you're not of hispanic descent and speak spanish, and avoid altogether if you're of asian descent. 

--Check in process--
I tip a $20 to the front desk just for a smooth check in, the staff appreciated it, but told me the room wasn't ready since I came early. Ate lunch, came back, we're still waiting for the cleaning staff to clean our room and told several times, another 15 min, another 30min, etc.... After several hours, and about an hour and half past check in time, and all other check in patrons serviced, we're still waiting in the lobby... At some point the hotel manager noticed we're still waiting and walks up to help us. They gave us a room upgrade, which was really nice and it off set the waiting. If this was the only issue, I would have just considered this as a fluke incident and the hotel made it right.... but not the only issue...

--Room--
Room was really modern and nice looking. We were upgraded to the master suite which has a separate bedroom and livingkitchen area. Window was broken and does not lock. There were holes in the window frame which mosquitos could come through, no real fix by the hotel after reporting, so I plugged up the holes with bunches of tissue to prevent any mosquitos from coming in. Phone also broke after the first night, no one fixed the window or the phone for the remainder of the trip. Safe lock was a bit strange and the numbers had to be extremely hard or the numbers wouldn't register. 

--Food--
Horrendous food. Ate mostly the buffet, but the food was re-used from previous service. You can easily tell, e.g. pork chops which were cooked during previous service were now bathed in BBQ sauce but it couldn't hide the dry cook taste from previous service. Room service food, for chick nuggestries - the nuggets  you can easily tell were re-used from dinner and rock hard. Asian restaurant was a very strange fusion. Walked out without even ordering to avoid wasting time.  Avoid anything on tap, the water, soda, lemonade, etc on tap was disgusting and we started asking for bottles.

--BeachPoolAmenities --
Amazing location.... the beach and pool is the true gem of the resort and sets the atmosphere. The pool and beach were pretty empty, i have no clue where everyone was as the pooleach was nearly empty and there is almost no other attractions there. Cabanas were extra charge requiring a package or bottle service, I ordered a cabana daily for the full days I was there. Lifeguards are non existent,  on their phone or taking care of other matters. It seemed like they there for show than they are for true emergency services. No other real amentities. The kids room, is really a baby	oddler room. There's one play area, with a bar and one pool table but no other true amentities - this was fine by me as I was looking for a beach resort. Just another note, there is very limited space with AC available. 

--Staff  Service--
Most tips were not appreciated or acknowledged to provide a basic level of service. I don't care if the staff doesn't come up and thank you for tipping, but I would have appreciated a basic level of service from a higher end resort. There were a few gems staff members who were appreciative and actually provided service, I made it habit to be serviced by them, but most just took the tip, and continued to ignore you. For those that did provide better service, making sure I had bottles of watersoda instead of the flat tasteless tap drinks, or my bottle services for the cabana, I kept tipping constantly to keep their attention. Most staff ignored to service us (or technically the asian guests) intentionally at times. Even on the day of check out the coffee cafe, the staf went around and checked for drinks of all guests except the 2 asian families sitting there. The resort here needs more english proficient staff, hospitality training, and drum out the racist under tone from most of the staff. They also need to tell their staff to stop playing on their phones all day. 

As a wrap up, I would not ever return to this resort or the hotel chain.

reviews.author: Vera

Paradisus survives on tons of conventions because people who have it free from company will not complain! We did have frequent conversations with them, they also 
did not like the food and were happy leaving. This place deserves much better, has lots of potential.
We absolutely do not recommend this establishment as of now and will never return!!!
Sincerely, your seasoned travelers.

reviews.author: Yasslag
reviews.title: Serious food-safety and service failures
reviews.text:
I rarely write negative reviews, but our experience at Paradisus Palma Real was alarming. During our stay around Storm Melissa, my wife bit into a piece of glass inside a sushi roll. We caught it in time, but this is a severe food-safety breach with potentially life-threatening consequences.

We also observed flies on exposed items at the buffet on multiple visits—covered stations and active monitoring were clearly lacking.

Finally, during the intense rains from the storm, no porters assisted with transportation around the property. There was no facilitation to reach our room, leaving us to trek through heavy rain with small children—completely avoidable at a resort of this category.

Safety and basic service should come first. The hotel offered a one-night compensation conditional on signing a legal release of liability, which we declined—not the kind of paperwork anyone expects on a family vacation. I sincerely hope management immediately strengthens kitchen QA (including controls to prevent foreign objects and better pest management) and ensures proactive, weather-contingent guest transport during storms. Until then, I cannot recommend this property.

reviews.author: Marigold M
reviews.title: Very Disappointing Stay
reviews.text:
y husband and I stayed at Paradisus Palma Real for a friend’s wedding, expecting the same great experience we had a few years ago. Unfortunately, this trip was nothing but frustrating from day one.
The first night, we had no running water in our room — no shower, no sink. We were told to wait until morning and use a “hospitality shower” that barely worked. No one offered to move us until it was past midnight. The next few days brought more issues: no hot water, broken shower handle, a leaking tub, and unfinished repairs left in our room.
Despite several complaints to the Circle office, we were promised follow-up and compensation that never happened. Staff were polite but unhelpful, and communication was poor. Even checkout was frustrating — wrong food orders, a broken coffee machine, and an unexpected dinner charge.
As a long-time Melia/Circle member, this experience was a huge disappointment. For a supposed 4-diamond resort, the service and management response were unacceptable. I would not recommend Paradisus Palma Real or the Circle program.

reviews.author: LDField2808
reviews.title: Not Horrible, just not Great
reviews.text:
Our stay (Sept 28 – Oct 5, 2025) at Paradisus Palma Real was disappointing. Despite upgrading to The Reserve Presidential Suite Ocean Front and being Circle members, the experience was far from relaxing. Numerous small but persistent issues made it impossible to unwind.

1. Booking & Payment Problems

Reservation confirmed July 17, but payment link delays began immediately.

Multiple follow-ups were required: first link expired, AmEx not accepted (not disclosed), new link delays, and confusion over Euro vs USD charge.

Refunds and confirmations took until August 25; over five weeks of back-and-forth before the booking was fully resolved.

2. Transfer & Check-In Issues

Airport pickup arrived 20 minutes late.

Upon check-in, staff claimed no record of our upgrade payment; we had to show proof from our emails.

Front-desk staff photographed our phone screen to verify payment.

3. Room & Maintenance Problems

Power and A/C failures on first night; maintenance visits needed multiple times.

Inconsistent hot water throughout the week.

Housekeeping repeatedly failed to clean the master bathtub despite multiple requests.

Frequent power outages (four separate occasions).

4. Resort Environment

Widespread construction with noise and area closures not disclosed prior to booking.

Children frequently in “adults-only” areas, including the pool.

Cats roaming dining areas despite guest allergy.

5. Concierge & Communication Failures

Concierge (José) created group chat but later became unresponsive.

Missed scheduled activity due to lack of communication; only later told his phone was broken.

Replacement staff (Juan Castillo) was dismissive and rude.

6. Unwanted Sales Pressure

Mid-vacation “benefits meeting” turned out to be a Circle membership sales pitch lasting nearly two hours; very intrusive and poorly timed.

7. Overall Experience

The suite itself was beautiful, but constant issues; from booking delays and power outages to construction noise and communication lapses; ruined the intended rest and relaxation.
We left frustrated and exhausted, concluding that we would not return to Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort.

reviews.author: ahoora d
reviews.title: Paradisus Palma Real – Extremely Disappointing Experience
reviews.text:
I would never recommend this hotel. We booked what was advertised as an all-inclusive package, but it was far from it. Food was only available at very limited times and in specific locations, leaving us with no real options throughout the day. The staff was unhelpful and in many cases outright rude. Service by the pool was nonexistent—no one ever checked on guests, and when we asked for help, most employees didn’t seem to know anything.

On top of that, there were no basic amenities such as a shop for essentials or even an emergency convenience store within the hotel. For a resort of this size and price, this was shocking. My husband and I travel four times a year for quick getaways, and this was by far the worst experience we’ve had anywhere.

We expected a relaxing, stress-free stay, but instead we dealt with poor service, lack of food options, and no sense of hospitality. This was our first and last visit to Paradisus Palma real

Las bebidas y alimentos son más básicos que en Mexico. En la zona no hay actividades, tienes que ir a Isla Saona o Catalina, a 2 horas. reviews.author: colegritz
reviews.title: Honeymoon Disappointment – Poor Value for $500–600/Night
reviews.text:
I stayed at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana for my honeymoon, and unfortunately, it was one of the most disappointing resort experiences I’ve ever had—especially given the price point of $500–600 per night for an oceanfront room in the “Adult Reserve” section.

Service:
Despite tipping generously and being polite and respectful (I work in the service industry myself), the service was consistently poor. Requests were often met with indifference, and attention to detail was lacking. A good example: I asked for extra bread, and what was brought out was cold and literally stale.

Food & Drinks:
The food quality was abysmal for a resort in this price range. Most meals were cold, flavorless, or stale. Room service was no better—the food always arrived cold. The coffee was shockingly bad; they were unable to make basic coffee drinks properly. The only decent meal was at the steakhouse; every other dining experience was disappointing.

Rooms & Amenities:
For one of their nicest oceanfront rooms, the experience fell far short of expectations.

The A/C never properly cooled the room.

The mini-fridge barely worked, which is unacceptable in a tropical climate.

Room service food was cold and unappealing.

Even the recreational amenities were neglected: there was only one pool cue for the entire pool table, and it didn’t even have a felt tip.

Overall Value:
This was supposed to be a special trip—our honeymoon—and instead it was frustrating, uncomfortable, and disappointing. For the price, I expected at least reliable service, fresh food, and working amenities. Instead, it felt like the resort is cutting corners everywhere.

Bottom Line:
The resort’s location is beautiful, but everything else—from service, to food, to room comfort—was far below standard. If you’re considering this property, I strongly suggest looking elsewhere. There are better-managed resorts in Punta Cana that deliver far more for the same price.

reviews.author: Cindy
reviews.title: Extremely disappointing experience
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was extremely disappointing and fell far below expectations for a family resort of this category. We had reserved a full week but decided to leave after only three days due to a series of unacceptable situations.

From the moment we arrived, there was no staff available to assist with our luggage. A large group had arrived before us, and we were left to carry our own bags despite traveling with two small children (ages 2 and 5).

Housekeeping service was also a major issue. Although we checked in on Friday, by Saturday at 3:30 p.m. our room had still not been cleaned. I specifically requested service since my 2-year-old uses diapers, and the trash was already producing a strong odor. Despite repeated requests, no one came until 10:00 p.m., after I had to physically take the trash out myself and go to the lobby to complain. This level of neglect is unacceptable.

During breakfast on Saturday, we were horrified to find a cockroach walking on our table. This was not only unsanitary but also extremely disturbing, especially at a resort that presents itself as high-end.

The final and most upsetting incident happened on Sunday night. While in the room with my children quietly watching TV, security knocked on our door to complain that our baby was crying and that we were being “too noisy.” This was deeply shocking and frustrating. At a family resort, it is only natural that a 2-year-old may cry — that is the way babies express their needs. For security to treat us this way was humiliating and unacceptable.

This experience turned what was supposed to be a relaxing family vacation into a stressful and unpleasant situation. I had no choice but to request a refund. I strongly urge your management team to address these issues, as they are entirely incompatible with the standards and expectations of a family-friendly luxury resort.

reviews.author: Jhanalyn B
reviews.title: A mess from start to finish
reviews.text: Check in procedure was different  for every single person in our party even though all the rooms were booked the same way through a travel agent. When we were trying to figure out what was needed and why  and even put the front desk on the phone with the travel agent was disrespectful and dismissive. The only option they would give was to pay again with no mention on how to get a refund even though we had already paid. While trying to get this figured out I asked could I add my Melia awards and I was told No by the front desk agent. If there were any benefits available to me as an awards member I will never know. Also while i was staying here my safe and mini bar did not work. I called and they sent someone up who fixed the mini bar and said he fixed the safe. He did not fix the safe at all. That required me to leave my valuables in the room and housekeeping stole money from me. When I mentioned this to the front desk the sent someone else to fix the safe but disregarded the statement I made about the missing money. Also when I got there I had wash clothes. When housekeeping came the first time they did not replace the washcloths nor the towels. When I called housekeeping about the items they said we will send them right up. Six hours later I had to call back because I had not received anything. Still nothing and I had to call again. They finally brought be some towels and when I asked where the washcloths was because that was my main ask the guy  we delivered the towels told me No. I asked him how are you going to just tell me no. I had to call housekeeping again and I was informed that they never had washcloths and I had to inform them that I had them when I got here. The person on the phone said they would send some up in the morning by 9am. That never happened. Two days later I finally got some. I had to hide them because housekeeping would take my unused items and not replace them when they cleaned the room. As it relates to how things work at the property all we were given was a very unhelpful piece of paper. It was confusing on how to book specialty restaurants nor the fact that we already had reservations at some. The only area I did not have an issue with is room service (which was not the case for others in my party as they would order room service and never get it) and the porters.

reviews.author: foocux
reviews.title: Filtraciones, engaños y servicio deficiente
reviews.text:
Tuvimos una de las peores experiencias que recuerdo en un hotel. Al llegar, la habitación estaba hecha un desastre: grandes filtraciones de agua caían del techo y el teléfono no funcionaba, así que tuvimos que caminar repetidas veces hasta la recepción para pedir un cambio. Mientras esperábamos, mi esposa, que está embarazada de mellizos, resbaló por el piso mojado. Estuvimos a punto de salir al médico porque estábamos muy nerviosos y preocupados. Solo entonces el personal accedió a cambiarnos de habitación.

Para compensar, prometieron un masaje gratuito para mi esposa, pero resultó ser un engaño para que firmara un descargo de responsabilidad para evitar demandas. Tras varios seguimientos, nunca se concretó nada.

La comida fue otro gran problema. El primer día el buffet principal estaba cerrado y habilitaron uno diminuto, casi sin variedad ni proteínas, así que terminamos en la habitación sin cenar bien. Para colmo, el teléfono de la nueva habitación también estaba dañado y tuvimos que volver a recepción para pedir servicio a la habitación.

En cuanto a la atención, el personal dejó mucho que desear. Mi esposa entró ligeramente mojada al restaurante de la playa y un empleado le habló de forma agresiva y le pidió que saliera. Esa mala actitud se repitió en distintos momentos y, en toda la estancia, jamás pudimos probar un corte de carne decente ni vimos mejoras en el menú.

Entre el mal mantenimiento, las promesas vacías y el trato poco profesional, nuestra estancia fue realmente decepcionante. No recomendaría este hotel, especialmente a familias o a quienes busquen seguridad y buen servicio.

reviews.author: 12ruben890
reviews.title: SERVICIOS DECEPCIONANTES
reviews.text: La experiencia fue desagradable. Pagué por habitaciones con vista al mar y me dieron unas con vista parcial en un primer piso desde donde se veía solamente el techo del restaurant de abajo y prácticamente nada se veía del mar. Además era notorio que a la habitación le faltaba mantenimiento. Las mamparas de la zona de bañeras estaban hinchadas de humedad, había luces que no funcionaban y la caja de seguridad se quedó sin batería y tardaron un día para sustituirlas.  El personal del front desk es despreciable, y no está capacitado para la atención ni para solucionar inconvenientes, siquiera muestra interés en ello. Al ingresar, pretendí pagar con una tarjeta de mi banco en EEUU y salió rechazada.  Quien me atendió en el front desk  insistió para que abonara con otra tarjeta y debí hacerlo con una de mi cuenta en mi país, lo que no estaba dentro de mis perspectivas realizar. Sin embargo, luego fui a realizar una compra en el shop del hotel y no tuve inconveniente en pagar con la tarjeta de EEUU. Ahí me advirtieron que en el front desk cobran en pesos dominicanos y no ponen la opción de pago en dólares, lo cual resulta ridículo en un hotel que supone ser de prestigio internacional. Según el Meliá Rewards debían entregarme un obsequio por mi cumpleaños y al reclamárselos se hicieron los desentendidos y no me ofrecieron absolutamente nada aduciendo que debía haberlo requerido al hacer el check in, sin embargo, paradójicamente fue lo primero que me preguntó la persona de recepción ya que lo había consignado en mi reserva . En el restaurant Mina tardaron dos horas en servir entre el primer y segundo plato, porque el cocinero estaba enfrentado a los gritos con los camareros y con el supervisor. He visto como tomaba la carne de un plato con la mano y lo pasaba a otro impunemente. Pretendieron servirme una hamburguesa que estuvo 45 minutos en medio de sus disputas y se las rechacé, dado que vi toda la situación ya que mi mesa estaba pegada a la cocina y vi como salivaban sobre ella en medio de la disputa. El supuesto show del restaurante oriental es decepcionante. Debí pedir me pusieran los almohadones en los sillones del balcón 4 veces. Los grifos de las duchas estaban rotos. Solo arreglaron uno de ellos. En la otra habitación filtraba agua al resto del ambiente desde la base de la ducha. He estado en otros all inclusive en punta cana y en muchos hoteles de 5 estrellas por el mundo, incluso en otros Meliá, pero puedo asegurar que a éste no le corresponde tal nivel.

reviews.author: Samantha Auguste
reviews.title: Don’t come here if you value you possessions or your sanity
reviews.text:
This was one of the worst travel experiences I’ve ever had. My family and I stayed at Paradisus Palma Real, and the trip was full of issues that the resort completely failed to take seriously. It was honestly shocking how little they seemed to care about guest safety.

The housekeeping staff stole my father’s wallet from our room, the resort brushed it off like it was no big deal. And told us we should have secured it better (mind you, it was in our locked resort room) Their official response to my complaints was careless and full of errors . The persistent (to the point where I had to leave the beach area) solicitors on the beach completely ruined the experience. 

This was our first time in the Dominican Republic, and it left such a bad taste that we won’t be coming back EVER. Between the lack of accountability, the ignored complaints, and the overall poor treatment, I can’t recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: emails4u484
reviews.title: bad experience
reviews.text: I was born in the country. I know what real good food taste like. the love and dedication of food reflects on it's taste. every restaurant reservation I made was horrible food quality and poor customer service. The buffet had better quality food and still not the best.

reviews.author: Martin L
reviews.title: No volvería ni lo recomendaria
reviews.text: Nunca estuve en un all inclusive tan malo. Lo contraté a pesar de ser más caro que otras alternativas, pensando que este hotel era mejor por su precio. El hotel es LAMENTABLE. La comida DEPLORABLE y sin variedad. Me tuvieron que cambiar de habitación porque el duchador no desagitaba y se inundó la habitación. Tuve que llamar 4 veces para que le armen una camita a mi hija. El mantenimiento del hotel es calamitoso.

reviews.author: H P
reviews.title: Don’t stay here
reviews.text: I was staying in room 1022 on the second floor and the security guard said I can’t sit on the cabana even though it’s right in front of my room. He made me get up even though know one was using them. Don’t stay here if you want to sleep on a cabana. The hospitality at this hotel is horrible

reviews.author: CARLOS JAVIER S
reviews.title: ROBO DE TARJETA
reviews.text: En líneas generales el hotel tiene mucha restricciones que aplican ciertas áreas solo para socios FUE ROBADA UNA TARJETA DE DÉBITO Y REALIZARON  CONSUMOS DE 682$ se informó el hotel en donde me hicieron perder medio día de mi tiempo en la estadía indicándome que realizando la denuncia formal iban a resolver el asunto ofrecieron compensación y rembolso , salimos confiados  del hotel y su resolución ninguna de las dos nunca más se comunicaron ni dieron solución NO VAYAN A ESTE HOTEL SI VAN EN FAMILIA  ( CUIDADO CON LUISA GERENTE DE ATENCIÓN AL CLIENTE )

reviews.author: Exploration49030
reviews.title: Dining NIGHTMARE
reviews.text: The "restaurants" will always be booked.  It is a scam. The customer service at CORPORATE is horrible. Worst company ever. I was repeatedly teased and made fun or by these inappropriate horrible people.

reviews.author: JorgeC
reviews.title: No está a la altura de lo esperado en Meliá
reviews.text:
Soy cliente Platinum Meliá y hago más de 50 noches de hotel al año solo en Meliá. 

Segunda vez en este hotel y misma mala experiencia. La primera vez le di otra oportunidad por ser post pandemia, pero esta vez será la última que vengo a este hotel que no está a la altura de otros Melia.

A pesar de ser abogado en The Reserve muy mal servicio desde el check in, al que se llega a través de pasillos estrechos de habitaciones para hacerlo en “privado”, la atención del personal, la comida y restaurantes como siempre un lío para reservar y pésimo servicio. 

Todo a base de propinas para tener un mejor servicio. 

Pido late check out hasta las 14:00 con la tarjeta platinum pues que no. (El hotel no está completo
Esta noche ni mucho menos, aunque no depende de eso al ser platinum) pues que no, que por ser Reserve a la una pero a las 14:00 que no. A un compañero de viaje siendo plata si le dejan y sin estar en Reserve. 

Nos dicen el primer día que no consta el pago de la agencia que lo iban a comprobar, al día siguiente nos dicen que está todo ok, y al hacer el check out que no, que no está pagado y que hay que pagar y nos cobran mucho más que lo que teníamos con la agencia. Eso sí, avisan el domingo cuando la agencia está cerrada. 

La verdad es que muy bajo el nivel comparado con otros hoteles de la zona. Sobre todo a nivel atención y servicio. 

Lo dicho, si vienes con familia y niños pues ni tan mal, pero si buscas la más mínima atención y exclusividad no la tendrás y pagarás como si lo tuvieses que es lo peor 

Espero que esto ayude a otros viajeros a tomar mejores decisiones sobre sus viajes.

reviews.author: ali m
reviews.title: Great place with worse food.
reviews.text:
This is the first day in resort. 
1. Nice resort, beach and rooms.
2. Nice  people who trying to make your stay  relaxing and great.
3. Food is  not good at all. You can not call it 5 star resort food at all.There is no tase to food. We were in Blue agva for dinner. Simple and blend food. From starter to appetizer. I can easily say worse food ever I ate in a Mexican restaurant.  As some one who has been traveling to all carribian  islands and Mexico. By far this is the most tasteless food I ever had. I  invite  Melia resort manager  to randomly  go and taste the food. .
I should say the people who work there are all welcoming .

reviews.author: Cale C
reviews.title: SO BAD, CAN WE PLEASE LEAVE ALREADY!
reviews.text: Do not come here, unless you love to over pay for unbelievably poor food and service.  Been waiting a the concierge desk for 30 minutes this time.  See Photo below.  Had the worst meal of my life if you consider three bites a meal.  Cannot get anyone to listen to how bad this place is as no one is in charge, of anything.
