(Still waiting to speak to some).  I really don’t write reviews, but this place sucks so bad.  We leave tomorrow and will never come back.  P.S.  At least 10 people waiting to check in at 11:20 PM

reviews.author: Rachel P
reviews.title: Five Star Pricing for a One Star Experience
reviews.text: Just awful. Staff was rude. It was impossible to get a dinner reservation. Five nights could not get one reservation and the resort was half empty. The buffet food was unedible.

reviews.author: Jamie B
reviews.title: Terrible, empty restaurants but you can’t eat
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, very clean but positives ends here. If I could give this negative stars I would. I have been to resorts of all different brands and have never written a bad review, I can find the good in all things but not here. I started my vacation bad with resort booking and it never got any better. If you want to stress where you are eating or feel like you have to fight for a dinner reservation go here. We spent most of our vacation trying to figure out where you are going to eat other than the buffet. We were told many times go to the Buffet, if you want to eat there breakfast, lunch and dinner than book it. If you want to sit for dinner for 2 hours and wait and miss the very little entertainment they have, you should go here. This resort is not geared toward families, nothing for kids to do our preteens were bored out of their mind. Do not make a mistake with your booking because they will not help you, no concessions, no helping to rebook, they will tell you there is nothing they can help with. I have never been to a resort or traveled with a resort company that is more difficult to work with and does not do anything for customer service, and I mean nothing. They do not want to help you period, they tell you to come back and then you are at the same page even going back to talk to someone many times. The restaurants are empty yet you still cannot get in. If you are traveling without a concierge or reserve status forget it you do not matter, you are literally told you don’t matter.But also if you have a concierge hopefully they respond because many of our group was in the same boat. Meliá brand is a never again for our family which is sad because of their management was better it could be a different story.

reviews.author: Christopher W
reviews.title: Restaurant Capacity Problem
reviews.text:
The morning after we arrived, our family of 6 attempted to make dinner reservations at one of the restaurants on property. We were told that there are no reservations available for any of the restaurants during our time at the resort, but would be able to access the buffet (aka The Lunch Box).

When we approached the front desk staff regarding this issue, they confirmed that no dinner reservations would be available to us during our stay, and then chuckled amongst each other.

The concierge staff were sympathetic, but they were unable to do anything.

While expectations for food an all inclusive is tempered, while staying at a 4/5-star resort we do enjoy getting dressed and enjoying a meal as a family in an air conditioned restaurant. The food at The Lunch Box is poor at best, so if you enjoy a good meal while on vacation this resort isn't for you.

reviews.author: mdshamburg
reviews.title: Disappointing resort
reviews.text: The resort itself is beautiful, but that’s where the compliments end. The food was mediocre at best and the service from much of the staff was not what you expect from a resort like this. We won’t be returning to  the DR.

reviews.author: anonymousU5792JT
reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text: Note I have never left any type of negative reviews for any hotels or resorts in the past 20+ years of traveling internationally - I typically air travel 8-10 times a year at minimum. The facility itself is nice. Food is okay, not the best but I get it with the all-inclusive resort. The reason why I would NOT recommend this place to anyone is that they have he worst service I have received anyway in the world. I can't believe they are calling themselves 5 star hotel. Staff are often rude, unresponsive and lacks customer service. The front desk couldn't offer the room type we booked and the next day, they kicked us out from 11 am to 6 pm so they can offer another "available room." This is unheard of - we should have been offered another room that became available earlier in the day. One day, we didn't get the room service by 6 pm so we asked for extra towels. The towels only arrived after I made 3 calls and an hour later. Restaurant staff were often ignorant of my requests. One staff member even poured milk all over my husband's plate when he told her he didn't want any milk with his coffee. What the heck?

reviews.author: marspie07
reviews.title: Horrific stay
reviews.text: Terrible stay from begging to end. Food was very Americanized and disappointing! Front desk staff were no help especially (RUTH) or accommodating to our needs and concerns. The bath tub in the room was leaking and the shower head was broken the wrist band to get into the room wasn’t working we kept getting locked out of our room the concierge Eriol was the only person that was helpful and accommodating to our stay he was the only one doing his job he needs to be the manager of the whole establishment! Overall this place is horrible

reviews.author: Maya663
reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text:
Had an awful experience during my stayfrom Dec 27 2024 to Jan 2 /2025. 
I was awaken at about midnight by 2 security guard claiming that I had not pay for the room. They were absolutely rude and treated me poorly. 
The hotel failed to apologize and make this right. 
Very disappointed

reviews.author: Fra
reviews.title: Paradisus o inferno?😱
reviews.text: Premetto dicendo che abbiamo prenotato in questa struttura fiduciosi dell’ottima esperienza avuta al Melia di Zanzibar nel 2024. Purtroppo non posso dire lo stesso quest’anno. Paradisus Palma Real e’ davvero pessimo. Il cibo e’ praticamente sempre lo stesso riciclato nei vari ristoranti della struttura che si trovano tutti o quasi all’interno di un cortile centrale attaccati l’uno all’altro con la stesso design, freddo e poco accogliente. Riservare un ristorante per la sera è un impresa tra l’altro perché sono sempre tutti pieni e spesso i clienti sono costretti a mangiare a buffet.Scordatevi poi una cena romantica con la vostra compagna bevendo un drink vicino alla spiaggia(non ci sono tra l’altro ristoranti vicino al mare nella struttura apparte una specie di self service)e preparatevi invece ad un’orda urlante di famiglie con bambini.Anche il personale non è fra i più accoglienti…preparatevi a comprare il vostro asciugamano per il mare visto che quelli in dotazione dell’hotel sono quasi sempre esauriti e noi avevamo la formula Reserve dove il servizio sarebbe dovuto essere ancora migliore..Nessuna assistenza in spiaggia..sporcizia e difficoltà continua a trovare un ombrellone libero…Se non comprate le escursioni proposte al doppio del prezzo dalla struttura preparatevi ad aspettare a lungo le navette che vi porteranno dentro e fuori dall’hotel…bus e taxi non sono ammessi all’interno se non quelli dei tour proposti da Paradisus…Al termine di un’escursione abbiamo aspettato mezz’ora che ci venissero a prendere e nonostante diversi solleciti nessuno è mai arrivato e ce la siamo dovuta fare a piedi al buio per circa 25 minuti. Prenotate un altro hotel…c’è molto di meglio a Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Ralph K
reviews.title: Worst customer service in any hotel in the world. Lizandro the assistant  manager and Luisa the manager were worthless
reviews.text:
I have traveled all over the world.
 I am 1.5 million mile flyer on several airlines. 
I have vacationed all over the world including 15 times in all inclusive hotels in Punta Cana. 
This is by far the worst experience I have ever had in any hotel in the world. 
We had no air conditioning, no wifi. We were only able to eat in 2 of 8 restaurants. We could never get reservations, even booking several nights in advance. 
My wife burnt her arm at the buffet and spent 3 days with doctors and had to deal with her arm in NY. 

I spent literally every day with Lizandro the assistant guest service manager as well as Luisa the guest service manager. Neither person did 1 thing to help us or accommodate us. 

This is supposed to be a 5 star resort. The customer service was less than a 1 star. 
Stay away. 
Best regards 
Ralph

reviews.author: DougieGilmore
reviews.title: 2 star dressed as a 5 star
reviews.text:
We are here right now and from the start it has been an unmitigated disaster.
We work with hotels all over the world and this stay as vacationing guests is nothing short of a disaster.

Disorganized front of house staff.
Asked for rooms in same building for 4
people over 2 months ago, told upon arrival it wasn’t possible. They are at “full capacity “
Restaurants are available on the days they decide, that’s it that’s all. If you want steak house 3 days of your week, no luck. Want a specific time for your reservation, no luck. 
They organize the restaurants like they are booked months in advance and you’ll be wait listed. We paid over $12k for this trip and we are being told when and where to eat.
Breakfast and lunch? If you want to have soggy French toast, crepes and bacon that was made the night before, you’ll love it. 
No ala carte options, just processed premade items outside of an omelette station at a buffet.

Service on beach- expect to wait 40 mins before someone remembers you are sitting there. 

This resort is missing one key ingredient. Service.
It’s lipstick on a pig. It looks nice from the outside but if you’re used to true 5 star service, this is not the place. 

We work with 5 star resorts and this resort unfortunately is not even close to that.
Service and front of the house staff need to be better organized. We are very disappointed in our first 24 hours here. 
We have spent a total of 2.5 hours of our first day, dealing with Resturant reservation requests, rooms issues, room being 25 degrees and all while waiting extended periods each time. Was told 2 times by concierge he would text us info on reservations but never did, we also told him it was our sons birthday and we wanted to do
something for him ( a candle on a cake or something) when we arrived they didn’t know
about reservation or the birthday surprise. 
Would not recommend this place to others due to lack of care, service or attention to detail. 
Here you do not feel a sense of welcome, it is quite the opposite. You feel like you are an inconvenience. Everyone here passes the buck, no accountability, no solution just plain old terrible service and mid grade at best food. No bueno. 

Room 9314
January 2025

reviews.author: Raymond S
reviews.title: Bittersweet Review
reviews.text:
Beautiful weather . Beautiful resort. 
Great place to be at if you’re coming from a colder country. 
However, my overall experience was a let down. 
Checked in first day. Missing 2nd balcony chair. Requested many, many times for additional chair as all units have 2 accessible for their stay. Staff followed up with a phone call but did not bring the second chair the whole visit.

Food was good. Buffet was tasty, and al la carte was entertaining. Housekeeping kept room tidy and replenished towels daily. Staff were friendly. Day time activities were fun and entertaining.

Beach vendors were an annoyance to our stay. Constant rude behaviour of trying to get our attention and wanting us to buy something or show us something to purchase. One of them threw a sandball at us because we did not respond.

Some of the Circle Club and Reserve resort staff were likewise an annoyance and disturbance to our stay within the hotel. Continuously trying to sell us packages/upgrades to our stay (circle membership, etc) and approaching us when we were just trying to relax and enjoy our vacation.

Health and safety hazards at the pool. Management needs to keep the pool safe to all guests by doing their due diligence in the maintenance of the tiles inside the pool. 
Had a freak accident. Cut my right ankle inside the pool with a sharp broken tile. 
First aid was provided by lifeguard, followed by standard paper work to fill out an accident report. Then was transferred to the medical clinic located inside the resort. The doctor was great and provided medical treatment. Was then told I need to go to the local private hospital to get 6 stitches. 
I have medical travel insurance, but hotel opted to pay for all medical fees. However did not compensate the transportation fee of getting there and back.  
Guest service staff was very sympathetic and tried his best to accommodate me for the remainder of my stay.

Hotel wanted me to sign a nondisclosure agreement about this accident, right as I was about to check out, which I thought was absolutely ridiculous.  Felt as if it was an intimidation tactic to sign or else you can’t leave. After bantering back and forth, I refused to sign the document as I do not feel comfortable signing anything without legal counsel present.  

P.S: the pool was likely not closed or cleaned after I bled in it, and I’m sure the tile was not fixed either. 

Enjoy your stay, folks.

reviews.author: ub b
reviews.title: Stay Away - Absolute Nightmare of a "Resort"
reviews.text:
If you value your money, time, and sanity, STAY AWAY from Paradisus Palma Real Resort. This is not a hotel; it's a backstreet circus run by prison guards. From the moment you check in, you are treated like you owe them something. The staff, especially at check-in, act like they're doing you a favor just by acknowledging your existence. Smiles? Nonexistent. Courtesy? Forget about it. Every employee wears an angry scowl as if they're ready to punch you for daring to approach them.

The rooms are tiny and depressing, with barely any amenities. Don't expect a luxurious escape here—this feels more like a poorly maintained back street student hostel. The beach chairs? Covered in towels at all times, but nobody is ever around to claim them, meaning you can't use them. It's an absolute joke.

The food? Utterly disgusting. Always cold, clearly reused leftovers from previous meals. You won't find a single fresh bite of food during your stay. It's appalling and downright unsanitary.

And if you're unlucky enough to stay in their so-called Reserve section, prepare for the absolute worst. The "concierge" (mine was Gustavo) is beyond horrible—rude, nasty, and completely clueless. They openly expect "tips," so you're essentially paying them to mistreat and torture you. I asked Gustavo to book the sauna for me, and he said, "Okay, okay, I booked the sauna." Next thing I know, I’m at the steam room, where the sauna doesn’t even exist. It’s as if no one at this hotel has any ''human'' in them. To make matters worse, no one speaks English. If you don’t speak Spanish, good luck trying to communicate with anyone. It’s a complete disaster from start to finish.

Need to speak to a manager? Good luck. They're invisible, and no one will bother returning your calls. You can spend all day trying to reach someone from your in-room phone, only to be met with silence.

A back street abortion place would provide you with much better service than this place from hell, Save yourself the pain and frustration. Avoid this disaster of a resort at all costs.

reviews.author: U B
reviews.title: DO NOT EVEN THINK ABOUT STAYING HERE – WORST EXPERIENCE EVER
reviews.text:
"DO NOT EVEN THINK ABOUT STAYING HERE – WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!"

This is not a hotel – it’s a backstreet circus! If you value your money, peace of mind, and respect, do not even dare to book here. Staff act as if they’re paying you to stay and treat themselves like kings of the planet. Smiling? Forget it. Courtesy? Non-existent. You pay $500 per night, but what you get is rude, unprofessional behavior and an experience that feels more like a punishment than a vacation. You will feel like you are in prison, you are the prisoner and the staff are the prison guards

The rooms are small, outdated, and not worth the price at all. They assign you a so-called "concierge" who has absolutely no clue about anything. I asked the concierge to book me for the sauna, and he assured me it was done. When I arrived, there was no sauna booking, and no one had a clue about it.

The staff also went so far as to openly discuss my gender, questioning whether I was a man or a woman. This level of disrespect was appalling and incredibly offensive.

If you ever use the in-room phone to call for assistance, be prepared for an absolute nightmare. It takes a minimum of 30 minutes for someone to answer (if they even bother), and when they do, a man named Carlos will interrogate you like you’re a criminal and then hang up on you. Forget about reaching a manager—managers are completely unreachable, and the staff couldn’t care less about solving any issues. If something goes wrong, you’re completely on your own.

The front office and check-in staff stare at you with the most hostile, hateful expressions, like you’re their worst enemy. If you request to speak to a manager, they take you to a random computer room with no explanation. No one understands English, and no one cares to help or even try.

Stay far, far away from the following staff members: Gustavo, Richard Sanchez, Carolina Marchi, and Vicmar Simeoli. These individuals, along with the rest of the team, are the epitome of unprofessionalism and rudeness.

This place is a disgrace to the hospitality industry. I wouldn’t recommend it to my worst enemy. Save yourself the time, money, and frustration, and book anywhere else. This was, without a doubt, the worst hotel experience of my life.

reviews.author: Rosario d
reviews.title: Mala estadía
reviews.text:
Peor experiencia en un todo incluido. Llegamos en época alta y según lo descrito en la descripción del hotel hay varias opciones para comer, en diversos Restaurantes. Al
Llegar al hotel resulta que no hay disponibilidad en los restaurantes. Pasamos 2 días enteros Discutiendo con el
Personal para las reservas en los restaurantes y no resuelven. Además te dicen que hay 2 restaurantes que puedes ir sin reserva pero al
Llegar a uno de ellos te dicen que no es cierto. Qué es solo 1 restaurante. Total el
Personal no está bien informado de la
Logística misma del hotel. Además, ofrecen actividades acuáticas en la información, al llegar tampoco es cierto.

reviews.author: OnAir07213365485
reviews.title: One of the worse birthday vacations ever
reviews.text:
Review:

I’ve visited Punta Cana over 10 times and have always loved it—until my most recent trip, which was, unfortunately, the worst vacation I’ve ever had. What was supposed to be a special birthday getaway turned into a frustrating and disappointing experience due to the lack of commitment to customer service across the board. From the concierge staff to the waitresses and housekeeping, the service was consistently subpar and unprofessional.

There were countless issues during our stay, and the problems completely overshadowed the few good moments of the trip. To make matters worse, we were charged twice for our stay and are still working on getting a refund. This experience has left me questioning whether I’ll ever return to Punta Cana, a destination I once loved. I truly hope the resort takes steps to improve its service and prioritize its guests, as this experience was far below expectations.

reviews.author: isaenz2025
reviews.title: No está a la altura del resto de Paradisus
reviews.text: Una atención de clientes Platinum y The Reserve que no está a la altura de otros establecimientos que tienen en Mexico, por ejemplo. Viajando solo no se tiene el mimo y cuidado que requiere un viajero single y no se maximiza la experiencia para este público. El personal es simpático, pero no es exactamente lo que se espera de un servicio premium/de lujo para público europeo.

reviews.author: Jj S
reviews.title: Worst resort I’ve been too, overpriced , can’t get reservations for restaurants, had to eat in the buffet everyday,
reviews.text:
This is a true review, we have travelled many times to Mexico and Punta Cana, this is the most expensive resort we have purchased , thinking 5 star resort should be fantastic, sorry to say worst vacation resort ever, check in took about 45minutes took us to our room which overlooked the pools, the room was very nice and huge. But unfortunately it was on the 3 floor and no elevator, I recently had a hip replacement and there was no way I could manage all these stairs. We back to the front desk and asked to change the room for a Ground floor one. Was told we will change your room tomorrow, have your suitcases packed and leave by the door at 10.00am, then come to the front desk at 1.00pm. Stood in line again for  30minutes and was told room not ready come back at 4.00, went in the line up again , was told only room available was a garden view, which we accepted, then they couldn’t find our suitcases, eventually they located them and we moved, the room while nice is utter garbage compared to the other room. My son In laws mother was here with us , she had a garden view room and wanted to change to a room with the pool view, she was told she would have to pay $300 a day extra, I told them that I had paid extra for our pool view room why can’t she have that room, was told no way we will lower the price to $199 extra per night, needless to say she didn’t move. I also couldn’t manager to operate the safe, it sits on the floor, I can’t bend that far.

I’m not a fussy eater all I wanted for breakfast was toast and jam, the toaster in the buffet area was not working correctly, you had to put the bread through 7 times to get it light brown , day 2 the same issue with the toaster , tried to find somebody that could speak English which is next to impossible, anyway 3 different people looked at it and I was told it’s broken . OK I’ll just have a jam sandwich then could not find any butter, after asking 4 different people 1 finally found someone who understood me and after 5minutes came back with some butter.
Day 3 toaster still not working,but there was butter, I asked to speak with a manager  Gregory said he was the captain how could he help me, I explained to him the issue that toaster not working properly, he said he would speak to his boss and either get it fixed or get a new one.
Day 4 toaster still not working and no butter to be found, found Gregory again he explained I sent a email to my boss asking for the toaster  to be fixed , not sure when it will happen, again I asked where is the butter, 10minutes later butter arrives .
5 star resort can’t even get a simple slice of toast .
Everyday sitting in the buffet for breakfast , sat at the table for 10 minutes waiting to order coffee , in the end you have to get up and ask someone to bring coffee, then you are lucky to get them to understand English  simple coffee and milk.
Tried for 3 days to book  al a cart restaurant, wait in line for 40 minutes only to be told none available. 
The resort it’s self is very nice spacious and clean, 
Never any issues getting a chair on the beach , always plenty available, beach is nice. You get pestered every 5 minutes by a vendor, 
The beach area only has one toilet, you go into the men’s washroom  one toilet bowl ,one  urnal and 2 sinks. The only door is the one going into the washroom, the lock is broke , you sit there having a crap and people are walking in to take a pee. 5 star resort and this is the washroom. A outhouse toilet is a 5 star compared to this place. At least in an outhouse only one person at a time can use it.
We are from Canada $6000 for 2 a weeks stay , hardly anyone that speaks English,   Have to eat in the buffet everyday, because you can’t get a reservation for a restaurant after lining up everyday, as previously stated can’t even get a slice of toast

reviews.author: Hrneumann11
reviews.title: Don’t go here
reviews.text: The service was terrible.  They wanted to put my husband and I in an adults only room and put our children in a different room on the other side of the resort.  This was because they overbooked and didn’t have anymore of the garden view Junior suits that we had reserved.  The “upgraded” room they gave us smelled badly of mold.  Almost every day something was messed up, dinner reservations, massage reservations, and then our keys wouldn’t open our room on New Year’s Eve around 10:30.  The are a mess!!  No apologies given from anyone at the front desk.  I asked to speak to the manager, was delayed and delayed and never spoke to them.  Is there even any management?

reviews.author: Priya J
reviews.title: Not worth the money!!
reviews.text:
Food is average, Restaurants are overcrowded and not able to get reservations at the good places.
Overcharged at the SPA after checkout! Not worth the money!!! Roaches in the rooms!

reviews.author: James S
reviews.title: Not great
reviews.text:
Not the greatest experience. Started at check-in when we were told we were VIP and needed to go the Reserve check-in desk. But we weren't as we have a kid. And oh you didn't check in on-line so sorry not many rooms left. Turns out a junior ocean front suite can mean not a nice large room but a small cramped room. We were told we could change rooms the next day. Only sorry the room we promised you is going to someone else. Ok we will upgrade you. To a suite which was large but the patio door wouldn't close and fell off trying to close it. They did get the door back on. But it was nearly impossible to sleep as a loud whistling door came through the side of the door.

Tried to make dinner reservations the next day. I went to the regular desk and was told no were VIP and needed to ask our Conceirge. But turns out we didn't have a Conceirge. Went back to the desk, the restaurants were booked for our nights. I went to the regular concierge who was able to help us out later that day. Wasted hours of time trying to make dinner reservations. But honestly the restaurants weren't that good so not sure. Maybe just don't expect much from the food and do the buffet?

I guess we didn't know the system there. But still it was ridiculous between check-in, the room, dining options, and lack of service. I can't say much about the Reserve experience as we were able to use the adult Reserve side with our reservation but couldn't with our son.

reviews.author: gsbrown10
reviews.title: Don’t Stay Here. There are better options.
reviews.text: We are here right now. This place looks great but the service is not so good. You cannot make dinner reservations until you arrive but then all restaurants are fully booked. There is no place to eat except the buffet which is horrible, hot and stuffy. We are considering ending our trip early. Waiting to hear from the resort manager.

reviews.author: Tony W
reviews.title: the worst food and service ever
reviews.text: I would never go back or recommend it to anyone. The worst thing was the food, the service, the lack of friendliness of the staff and the reservation system. The adult sector is full of kids. It's boring, there's nothing to do.

reviews.author: Hasan M
reviews.title: Horrible,
reviews.text: Horrible experience, came at hotel around 4pm, now is 8pm and still nothing works in the room, no air condition, frig, TV remote control, safety deposit. After several reporting to concierge in person and phone have not heard from them yet. Very disappointed, never had a first day like this at any resort we have been till now.

reviews.author: angelateodorescu
reviews.title: Unacceptable Experience at The Reserve Area
reviews.text:
Our stay at The Reserve in Punta Cana Palma Real was the most stressful and disappointing resort experience we’ve ever encountered. From check-in, where we faced hours of delays, dishonesty, and poor service, to daily frustrations with unfulfilled promises and inconsistent amenities, the management and staff failed to deliver on the premium service advertised.

Key issues included:
	•	Check-In & Room Problems: Multiple errors and hours over hours spent resolving simple room requests. Even after resolution, rooms were not cleaned or restocked for days.
	•	Food & Beverage Failures: Constant denials of premium drinks included in our package, blatant lies about availability, and even instances of fake or improperly labeled alcohol being served. Food was often subpar, with one incident of food poisoning.
	•	Dishonest Staff & Management: Repeated lies from staff and management regarding services, availability, and compensation. Promised solutions, like a special dinner, were never delivered.
	•	Lack of Service: Virtually no beach service, and poolside service was sporadic at best. Requests were met with resistance or outright refusal, making us feel like we had to beg for basic amenities.
	•	Health Concerns: Fake drinks and questionable food quality resulted in some health reactions, including abscesses and food poisoning.

Despite being Platinum members and paying for a 5-star experience, we were treated with disrespect and dishonesty. This resort fails to meet even basic standards, let alone the premium promises of The Reserve. A holiday should be relaxing—not a daily battle for what you’ve already paid for. We cannot recommend this resort to anyone seeking a stress-free vacation.

reviews.author: AR
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience - Overpriced and Poor Amenities
reviews.text:
Disappointing Experience - Overpriced and Poor Amenities

I had a very disappointing stay at this hotel. First, the pool was freezing cold—completely unusable. If you’re hoping for a relaxing swim, don’t even bother.

I booked my stay a day before arrival, only to find the price on Booking.com on the day of my arrival was half of what I paid. When I brought this up to the front desk, they referred me to customer service instead of resolving it on the spot. Customer service took four days to respond and refused to match the price. This lack of accountability and customer care was frustrating and unprofessional.

The restaurants were mediocre at best. While the buffet was decent, I’d recommend avoiding the restaurants altogether. The steakhouse was the worst—they served me beef tartare that was half dark, which was unappetizing and concerning.

Overall, the stay was not worth the price I paid. Look elsewhere for better value and service.

reviews.author: Gianluca L
reviews.title: Circle no way
reviews.text:
Promesse mai mantenute e soldi spesi sempre di piu…
Cliente dal 2017 e mai stato peggio…
Davvero bad

reviews.author: Coreane68
reviews.title: Failed in food. Cold bland and lack of choices.
reviews.text:
PRO’S. Resort is beautiful. Raul at the beach service is amazing 5 out of 5!! Always friendly, smiling and happy to help!! If you cone here definitely take care of him!!

CON’S. Food to be honest not good. Definitely was hoping for more choices. Breakfast and lunch buffet only. No other options. Typically cold lack of flavor. Dinner options are also slim restaurants closed maybe 2 options a night. In honesty you get what you pay for. We stayed at Secrets Cap Cana first so no comparison.

reviews.author: Flyer47595814282
reviews.title: Not 5 stars. Not family friendly
reviews.text:
The grounds are amazing and so is the pool and beach. That's where the good points stop. 
Stayed on the family side with wife and 2 kids. Paid for a master swim up suite. The pictures had a king bed for parents and queen bed in living area for kids. When we got there there was nothing but 2 twin beds and roll out crappy twins for the kids. There's a connecting room where we heard the TV in the room next door. Dead cockroach on the floor. Complained and they moved us to another room where the only difference was the master bed was finally a king. Everything else was the same. The phone was broken in the room. After asking 4 times to get it fixed I gave up when nobody came. So unable to order room service the entire time. 

The concierge we paid for also was MIA for 2 days during our trip with a personal issue. This is understandable but the hotel should have assigned us someone else. The customer service is horrible in this hotel. Too much to type. 

The food at the buffet is absolutely disgusting. Cold. Soggy. Overcooked. Undercooked. You name it. 

If you stay on the family side you are limited to such a small section of the resort. The adults only and the "circle  members" section take over the resort. We were told we couldn't sit in the beds on the beach because it "wasn't included"  you get harrassed all day long by beach vendors to buy things so sitting on the beach isnt even enjoyable. They are pushy and annoying. There is also NOTHING for the kids to do. You need your cell phone for everything also. No food menus anywhere. You have to scan a QR code. So bringing my phone with me everywhere was annoying. I've stayed at 4 other Melia properties and they were so much better. Do yourself a favor and stay away.

reviews.author: Jerrywestnewyork2024
reviews.title: Train your staff. With two people you can not run the entire resort.
reviews.text:
I would like to commend two staff members because without them I would have left the property upon arrival. 
Adriel Cabrera (concierge) and Mairelis (house keeping)
This two individuals went above and beyond their positions to help my wife and I. Thanks to them we were able to deal with all the problems that exist at the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Emiliano N
reviews.title: Does not meet expectations
reviews.text:
Dear Mr. Juan Carlos Lloret
Resident Manager
Paradisus Palma Real.

My name is Emiliano Navarro, I stayed at the property you manage from September 3rd to 8th. It is a property with Caribbean characteristics and impressive natural charm. I was impressed from the first moment and I did not stop praising the service of the staff because I felt exhausted by so much kindness and good vibes... but as the days went by the inconveniences began and it was sad for me how the effort of the staff in dealing with the client is tarnished by situations beyond their control and this should not happen.
I imagine that you were aware that there would be a wedding on Saturday the 7th and that more than 150 people would arrive at the property on different days.
I am going to list several issues that I hope you keep in mind.
1- I requested room service after 10pm on 3 occasions and they served me chicken with fries and hamburgers with fries and they only had coke to drink. The third time I did not complete the order because I thought it was disrespectful.
2- There were losses of belongings in a room. The person's name is Mario Rodriguez Del Rey. The pertinent inquiries were made and everything was as it was.
3- Problems with the Heineken beer supplies. I spent the last 5 days with a bucket going around all the bars because it is the beer I drink and there was none. One night at the ginger bar at 10:30pm there was no beer. They needed to put a place to cool down that closes the alcohol service at 1:00am. (When I'm on vacation I drink beer from the moment I open my eyes, it's not a matter of time)
So, with this bucket we shared several friends and I tell you, I'm not interested in the other variety they offer because it's not to my taste, and the beer dispensed at the Bar near the White Bridge, not to mention, but we made the effort to avoid the inconveniences but everything increased then it was the turn of the Chivas Regal 12 year old whiskey, also The Macallan, then this got out of hand to me to the point that I went up to complain to the office and I told the guys what was happening that everyone knew, but they don't have a way to solve it, but on top of that I told them, tomorrow Saturday with the wedding please I hope you can have everything necessary and the incredible happened we paid for one or two hours of extension of the party and you have programmed the A/C until 1:00 am therefore at 2:00 we were dying of heat and another complaint was made... this goes beyond everything and to give the final touch they began to remove the decorations and the tables even with us inside and The belongings were placed on the chairs as we were dancing. I had the idea that the first table where this incident happened had a defect and that was why they had moved it, but then it was the turn of the next table, and I said to myself, wow, they are crazy to finish. We ordered drinks and went out to the dance floor. When we came back, everything had been removed. You can be proactive, but they went too far. So, to sum it up, they ruined a good stay.
I don't consider this a criticism, but with the category that you have, this can't happen! I felt taken advantage of and I wonder if in my case with the brown bracelet I went through this. Regular customers, what can they expect? I thank you for your time, thank you very much!

reviews.author: Marietta
reviews.title: Horrible food, miserable staff and be careful at check in.
reviews.text:
First of all, the facility is beautiful and that’s it! We booked a 2 bedroom master suite but gave us two connecting rooms. We complained and was moved the next day to another regular rooms, at this point i can’t pack and repack my 4kids. Lots of reviews about not giving u the right room of what u paid for.
I’m a party of 6, we need space.

Food: it’s a 2star, not great at all. My kids won’t even eat the pizza! They were very slow the last few days so they only opened 2 restaurants which is always no availability for 6 people 

Staff:Horrible, except for some waiters at the buffet and main  pool. 90% of the staff were just miserable. I mean they won’t greet you GM, I say GM to everyone and they are shocked. lol.  I blame management, no proper training.  The staff doesn’t even know if they have watermark!( we asked 6 people)

Check in:

Pls be careful with this hotel. We paid in full but forgot the credit card we used, the concierge said will charge the stay and will give credit  as soon as u check out. We check out and it’s been 3 days and no credit back in our credit card.  There are a lot of reviews about this. I’ve emailed them and called numerous times. every single person that picked up the phone has no clue what I’m talking about. I’ve emailed twice and no response.  The concierge was not clear , I would have not given my credit card if they have to charge $4200 again! 

Just stay away from Melia hotels

reviews.author: Donna S
reviews.title: Focused on Timeshare way too much!
reviews.text: I would like to start off with a positive before I get into the negative.  The property is lovely and the wait staff, bartenders, and maids were top notch.  My problem came when we checked in.  We were a party of 14 and the hotel cancelled one of our reservations and said the person was a no show. They spoke to several different people without resolution until they told us that they would need to book an upgraded room because the room reserved was no longer available.  So I ended up paying double for the room.  My travel agent contacted the hotel to inquire and was given the run around.  We were also supposed to get spa credit and when we went to check out the amount was not applied to our bill.  When I inquired the front desk stated that I should have received a voucher a the time of check in and there was nothing that they could do about it now.  Since we were not sitting for the timeshare presentations (absolutely refused) it seemed like the customer service we received from the front desk was horrible.  The only response we received was that it was our travel agents fault and not the fault of the hotel.  This is the 2nd and last stay I will have at this brand (Melia) as the one in Cabo hawked us to attend the timeshare presentation every day and once we went and refused their gifts we never saw our concierge again.

reviews.title: If you want a peaceful vacation, don't book here
reviews.text:
1. We waited for 4 hours after flying all day from the US for a room that we paid for and were supposed to check in a day earlier, taking precious time off our vacation. There was a lobby full of irate customers at the front desk at ALL times. All they do is lie and delay to get you out of their faces.

We could not order room service at all via the app (which is completely useless) or via phone, as neither were working during our stay. 5.	Our room was not cleaned until 3rd day of our stay. We sat around all day on July 6th as housekeeping cleaned the rooms adjacent to ours and told them we wanted our room cleaned and they never came. 

In sum, BEAUTIFUL resort, but the staff and service are horrific. Nothing 5-star about this place. The food is OK and the rooms are very nice, but if you want a peaceful vacation, you won't get it here.

reviews.author: worldexpeditioner
reviews.title: Avoid this hotel, especially if traveling with family!
reviews.text:
I work in the tourism and hospitality industry myself, so I normally stay away from posting bad reviews online because I am aware that sometimes issues happen in this industry. However, I also know that the way one chooses to deal with unsatisfied customers is what can turn a negative experience into a positive one. Unfortunately, at this hotel, the terrible way they chose to deal with our situation is precisely what leads me to write this extensive review, so that anyone considering the Paradisus Palma Real can know exactly what they can expect from the property. 

We stayed here with our family of five (2 adults and 3 kids, ages 7, 5, and 2) and we would never come back again. Service is not good and the staff's attention to detail and their willingness to make things right (when they have admitted they messed up) is non-existent. I'll dive into the full details so anyone who reads this review can come to their own conclusions.

The nightmare began at check-in. We showed up at 2 pm, hoping there would be a room available for us before the normal check-in time at 3 pm. That was our mistake because we quickly found out the hotel was very disorganized in terms of housekeeping (every day the housekeeping lady showed up at our room at around 3 to 4 pm). They ended up giving us a room at almost 5 pm on the first day, as our 3 kids waited bored and sweaty at the reception area (which has no A/C, and the days were super hot and humid).  While we waited we went to visit the family / kids playrooms, which were a big reason why we selected this hotel for our family vacation, but came back extremely disappointed.  We were surprised there were no cameras in these rooms and what we found was the adult supervision was minimal and when we showed up we just saw a bunch of kids sitting in front of a TV with snacks.

We had an upgrade as part of the package that we booked, but the hotel said it was subject to availability and we never got upgraded (despite the fact the hotel was only 60% full, as a staff member pointed out the day after). The staff at reception could sense our dissatisfaction with the check-in issue and this is when the concierge, Ely, took us to the side and apologized for the issues at check-in, gave us his personal number, and told us he would PERSONALLY make things right for us and would make sure we had everything we needed during the rest of our stay. He NEVER AGAIN RESPONDED to the messages we sent him (almost daily) and would not pick up the phone. It was clear that his promise on day one was only meant to avoid a scene at reception and they had no intention of making things right for anyone. Just as a side note, each day we passed by reception we would see an angry customer having a discussion with the staff. We were clearly not the only ones.

THE FOOD & RESTAURANTS:
The hotel has a buffet area that was very sub-par for a property that promotes itself as a 5-Star property. A few of the things they served were good, but most of the food tasted bland, and the variety wasn't good. A big problem that is not mentioned anywhere on the website is that the entire BUFFET AREA HAS NO A/C, so we would find ourselves eating breakfast or lunch here, drenched in sweat. As mentioned above, the days were very hot and humid when we were there, and an air-conditioned area would have been wonderful to enjoy our meals, but this did not exist (only at the restaurants - which I go into detail below). Also, a few of the servers had a terrible attitude and you could tell they hated their jobs. We ran into them daily. Sadly, we were forced to eat here every day because we could only get a reservation at the property restaurants for one of the four nights we stayed here.

One morning, tired of the sweaty breakfast experiences, we chose to order breakfast to our room via room service. We called the night before to have it delivered at 10 am. The following day, when it was 10:30 am and breakfast had not arrived, we called room service and they told us there was no record of our reservation from the night before (not surprised). They took our order all over again and we ended up getting our breakfast at 11:30 am, losing most of the morning at the beach or pool. For anyone with very young children (who are up at 7 am or earlier), you know how painful this wait can be.

The hotel has 4 or 5 restaurants apart from the main buffet, yet we were only able to get a reservation at one of them (the Italian restaurant) on day three of our stay. According to the staff, each day we showed up early (8:30 am to make a reservation) they told us the restaurants were all fully booked. This seemed very strange to us and we later learned from a staff member, that they would tell us the restaurants were fully booked because we were a family and they did not like kids eating with the adults (despite the fact that there are adult-only restaurants at the hotel too). I have traveled on adult-only trips, and I understand that sometimes having kids at restaurants is not ideal, but this was NEVER mentioned anywhere on the website or when we talked to sales staff from the hotel. They make it seem like the hotel is very family-friendly, but this IS NOT TRUE. We ended up confirming this suspicion the day we showed up at the Italian restaurant for our reservation because they did not have high chairs for our 2-year-old anywhere in the restaurant. They told us they would immediately get a chair for us, but it never came (after 1 hour at the restaurant) and we ended up having to sit our toddler in the stroller for dinner. The food was also not very good.

During our stay, we realized they did this to all families since you rarely saw families with small children at the restaurants, and they all had to conform themselves to the bad buffet for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. I can attest, from personal experience, that this is not by choice, but by how the staff that books the restaurant reservations discriminates against families with younger children.

THE BARS:
The hotel put us in the northern building of the property, close to the Circle area (for Melia Circle members). While we thought this could be a plus at first, it was the opposite. The bar and beach chairs, towels, etc. that were closest to us were only for Melia Circle members and we had to walk across the entire property to get a drink or get towels. This was a big hassle for us because of our young children. Also, the drinks at the bar that are part of the all-inclusive standard package are terrible. Piña coladas, cosmopolitans, rum, and cokes, etc. I tried several of their drinks and the large majority were not good at all.

LOST ITEM:
I forgot a valuable item in the safety box of our room. When I realized this, I called a few days after I checked out to see if they had found it and they asked me to send an email with full details to reception, and cc a security email they provided. The security email bounced every time, and then I was given an alternate email. IT HAS BEEN OVER A MONTH since I checked out and I have not received a reply to that email yet. I had to call yesterday and talk to security, only to learn that they did not find my valuable (which was not a surprise).

THE ONLY POSITIVE PART:
Up until this point, everything has been negative, so I don't want anyone reading this review to think it's an isolated issue and that I am one of those pessimistic people who sees the negative side in everything. On the contrary, I try to make the best of everything and try to overlook minor issues when on vacation, but at this property, it was impossible. At one point, my wife and I decided that we would just try to enjoy our stay here despite all the issues every day, but they really made this hard. However, as I mentioned above, there was one positive part to our stay and that was the room (1025). It was nice and comfortable and had recently been renovated. Arriving back to the room from the beach or pool to a nice room was a small relief to all the issues (but we had to wait until the housekeeping lady was done with it at around 3 to 4 pm each day). I am sad to say this is the ONLY part of the stay that was positive, and it is also the ONLY part of the stay that does not involve service and people. And that is the big issue with this hotel, their staff and their willingness to help.

It's a shame that I cannot say better things about our stay here. I work in the tourism and hospitality industry and I know Melia is a reputable name in this industry, but what we experienced here really killed my experience with the brand (having had some positive experiences in the past with it).

I would never come back to a Melia all-inclusive beach property, and if you are considering the Paradisus Palma Real for your visit to Punta Cana, I would DEFINITELY LOOK ELSEWHERE, especially if traveling with family.

reviews.author: Dipa
reviews.title: FOOD POISONING!!!!
reviews.text:
This was the worst vacation I have ever taken.  It was NOT a vacation but a nightmare.  From the moment we arrived until we left, we had nothing but issues.  We had just checked in and had to wait 3 hours in our room for them to come fix the AC which was not working as well as the safe.  We were told we had to wait in our room for them.  1am &6am we had to call for AC issues. They come and fix it and 10 minutes later it doesn't work again.

They decide to give us a new room.  So now I have to pack all of our stuff up that I put out just to unpack all of that stuff.

New room: Our door would not close all the way unless both my husband and I pushed it in so it could latch.  

Thursday, our last day rolls around.  AC would stay at 74 since we got in the room which was Tuesday (We arrived Monday). I gave up.  My husband and I went to have lunch at the buffet. This was around 3 or 4pm.  We went back to our room to change into pool clothes.  I would say it wasn't even a full hour and my stomach started to cramp.  My stomach was hurting so bad, like I was in pain.  AND...bam....the throwing up begins.  I wouldn't wish that pain on anybody.  I was literally lying on the bare bathroom floor because I was throwing up every 6-8 minutes to the point there was nothing coming out.

Not only am I in pain and thinking I am dying, I am thinking about OUR FLIGHT that was the next MORNING!  We were scheduled to leave at 9am.  I WAS STILL THROWING UP.  I threw up for 14 hours.  We had to miss our flight because I was in NO condition to leave or even move.

My poor husband has his hands on his head because he has no idea what to do.  Book flights or help or book another night.  I told him to go to the front desk and they can help him reserve one more night.

He came back and they gave him a website he can book another night.  That's it.  They all knew I was sick because we told our concierge.  He manages to book another night and the website allowed us to stay in the same room.  Next we have to book flights.  So my husband figures that out while I sound like I'm a monster from a horror movie.

At this point I am passing out.  My husband calls our concierge and he says to call the front desk for a doctor.  He calls them and they said that have on-site doctor.  If we go to their clinic the cost is $185 for the doctor to take a look.  If the doctor has to walk a few steps and come to our room, the cost was $280.

I mean, there was no way I was getting there so we had no choice but to have a doctor come to the room.

Doctor:  WTF. That's all I can say. So rude. Can't speak a word of English.  She begins to check my ears, feet, arms, back.  Eventually she presses on my stomach which obviously hurt.  And just like that, she knew what my prognosis was.  I had a bacterial infection from the food.  She sits there and does paperwork for 10 minutes.  SHE HANDED ME 5 PAGES OF PAPERWORK TO FILL OUT!!!!!!!  She starts pulling out all kinds of different medications she wants me to take which she couldn't tell me the name of.

As she is handing meds to my husband, she starts saying this one is $35 etc.  I don't want any of this from you lady besides getting out of my room.  She came out with a bottle of Tramadol. Lol.  That's for pain from an injury or after having surgery.  Whatever, at least I could read it and it'll help my stomach some.  She gives me a shot on my butt.

She sits back down and here we are 15 minutes later, and she's still doing paperwork.  I said are you done?  I want to lay down.  She's shakes her head like she is about to leave.  5 more minutes go by and my husband  was like can you please leave so my wife can rest.  She tries to convince him to buy the random name so called antibiotics she was giving him.  He had to sternly say NO.

Fast forward to 5pm, I finally stopped throwing up.  14 hours.  I felt like I got him by a dump truck.  Our pick up was Saturday morning at 8.  We packed and went to the front desk.  I wanted to speak to someone in guest services that I could explain my situation to.  A guy comes out, and sits down and just stares at me.  Finally he says what do you need.  I explained my situation.  I should be comped for my extra night, doctor and new flights.  Which all totaled $1400ish. He said no managers were around. I went to another lady, Rosa.  I explained everything.  

I would have not been there had THEIR food not got me sick.  There food is the sole reason behind what I went through. She said no managers are here that I can talk to.  She tells me I can leave my information and someone will contact me.  She cannot provide me with any names or contact information for anyone.  

She called someone at guest services and then she tells me....................the room they gave us on Tuesday was an upgrade and that was our compensation.  It was the SAME room as what we had before but now I have to climb 3 stories.  Seriously???

I had to leave my information because I was left with no choice.  There are about 5 people workers there and all of them are just chatting away in Spanish while we just sit there.  Our ride was going to be there soon and she said she would be sure to give my information to the manager and son as "she" got there and that I would have a text message from her within one day.  Here we are, a week and a half later and it's radio silence.  I tried to email whoever I could, gave them an opportunity to fix things so I didn't have to blast them like this.  Nothing.  They offered me nothing. They did not try to help or accommodate us knowing how bad I was.

This wasn't just food poisoning.  It was some bacteria on steroids.  They were so rude to us while we were trying to get help.  No one speaks English.  Everyone says we have to talk to a manager.  Manager is not there and then won't give me contact information.

Side note and not relevant -  The pool was STINKS.  It stays on you and in our hair.  No matter how much you shower or wash your hair.  It took about a day of showering at home and washing clothes in detergent for the stank to get off of us.  It was a distinct smell.

We only got to eat at a restaurant one night which was the Mexican spot.  AWFUL. The food was disgusting.  And to top it off, not only does our waiter barely speak English but he's rude and lazy.  He took 15 minutes to give us water.  There was only 2 other couples in there.  He would come to our table to give us our food and continue his loud ass conversation across the restaurant right next to me.

Whenever an employee comes in your room, they all leave the door wide open.  About 3024920 mosquitos get in the room.  Also, when the door opens the AC automatically shuts off.  So now I'm hot and getting eaten alive.

We saw our concierge about two times. No help there.  I have never been so ready to leave a vacation and go home.

This place SUCKS. If you want to get sick and stink go to this resort.

reviews.author: Javier Noble
reviews.title: Club Melia CUIDADO
reviews.text: Hemos ida muchas veces a República Dominicana ( mas  de 10)hermoso pais con buena gente. Hemos ido a hoteles de esta cadena así como también de otras. Somos socios de Club Melia desde el año 2014, cuando te venden la membresía prometen un montón de cosas, te muestras habitaciones espectaculares, te dicen que cuando llegues vas a tener tu habitación pronta,  independientemente de la hora del arribo y otras muchas cosas mas. Con el tiempo estas cosas van cambiando o no se fueron cumpliendo, por ejemplo la ultima vez esperamos  bastante para ir  a la habitación después de haber viajado muchas horas. Cada vez sacan nuevos programas  con “mejoras” , es mas difícil reservar lugar y sos de alguna forma presionando en toda tu estadía para que concurras a las reuniones para ofrecerte mas cosas , obviamente desembolsando mucho dinero. Desde sud america he estado llamando a muchos telefonos para poder reservar los dias que nos correspondian y el telefono no era correcto o si era deMelia no decian que no era esa area. Una de las chicas nos dijo que habia problemas desde sud america para comunicarse con el centro de reservas. Envie un email a una direccion (Lasupport@club.melia.com), y no he recibido respuestaTodo muy complejo y engorroso. Ojo cuando viajan y les ofrecen estas membresías.

reviews.author: Samuel L
reviews.title: Resort Spiraling Down in Quality and Service
reviews.text:
After 3 consecutive years of visiting this property I can state that their level of service and quality is going down the drain.
The personnel at the Paradisus Punta Cana (resort we visited for 5 consecutive years prior to being closed for renovation) was very attentive to details, always greeting you with a smile, calling you by name, knowing what you like, etc.
Well, the management at the Palma Real really drop the ball on this matter. The personnel at their restaurant looks like they had a bad day, you have to get up to request service, and you notice that the overall attitude is negative.
I spoke to some of the personnel and they mentioned that they are overwork/underpaid - obviously reflecting in their service.
For what you are paying at the Reserve - Adults only section I felt that the quality of food is deplorable. Here are a few examples:

Sante Restaurant: you can order a la carte or from the buffet. The first day I ordered waffles and they told me it was not possible because the waffle machine was broken. Even though I spoke to different individuals including the supervisor, chef, management; they could not get a waffle machine in 8 days that we were there. It is hard to imagine that a resort of this magnitude does not have the money to purchase a waffle machine. At the same restaurant they have a sushi bar - well the fish they use to prepare the sushi was left out in the open without proper refrigeration or cold-chain maintained  for several hours. I mentioned to the chef, he indicated that it was going to be taken care off - of course nothing was made to correct the issue.
I ordered a seafood soup from the menu; instead of getting something fresh I got pieces of previously frozen seafood in a fishy broth.

Mina Restaurant: One of their entrees was a plate of mushrooms - to my surprise they served mushrooms straight out of a can.

Tokimeku Restaurant: The individual cooking for us that night indicated that he is not traditional in a sense that he does not taste his food fist to check it is properly seasoned/prepared. He mentioned that only by looking at the food color/appearance that he could tell if was OK or not. Obviously the rice tasted like butter and the meat was over seasoned. 
At the same restaurant you have the option to order a la carte as well. I ordered a Ramen Soup and what I received was angel hair pasta with canned vegetables on a fishy broth.

The details can go on and on, the point been is that I am taking the time to write this review to let you know that you will be a lot better off expending your money somewhere else than at this place.

The only commendation goes to the individuals working at the Adults beach section - they are the only ones that really have kept the essence of what good service and a good attitude toward the client is (and guess what - management is trying to force them into retirement).

reviews.author: Jhonelle W
reviews.title: Ha disminuido su calidad
reviews.text: No vayan nunca a conocer el programa de circle. Es incómodo y cuando trate de cambiar el certificado de estadía, por el cual hay que pagar por activar, me dice. Que ya lo ocupe. Plop! Respecto a la atención ha mermado.

reviews.author: bswan2024
reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK AT THIS RESORT!
reviews.text:
Areas where the resort failed to deliver basic standards of service: 
Room Reservations:
•	Unable to confirm room bed, given twins not king
•	Long, unorganized, and delayed check-in process
Resort Layout & Infostructure:
•	Resort is challenging to navigate, little to no signage
•	Room door had gap against the door jamb when closed allowing bugs into our room
•	Air conditioning in the rooms was subpar with no humidity control
Food:
•	The main buffet was awful. The food was mediocre, it was very understaffed resulting in long lines and food stations running out of food
•	The fruit was mostly all unripe, tortilla chips were stale, cheese was sweating, and the pizza was undercooked to highlight a few 
•	Food signage was unclear, missing, or mislabeled which made navigating with dietary restrictions very challenging. 
•	The restaurants are only open for dinner! Tried to make a dinner reservation at 10:45AM and was told that every single restaurant was booked solid. 
•	Limited snacks, sit down service only
•	My room service chicken quesadilla came with a hidden 2-inch-long chicken bone which was disgusting to bite into. 
•	You are not able to order any food at the pools. 
Bars & Beverages:
•	Adults only pool bar selection was incredibly limited and was bottom shelf package only. 
•	The pool bar also closed at 6pm 
Beach & Pool:
•	Hands down the most disgusting Caribbean beach I have ever visited. The water was brown and smelled worse than our beaches back home in NJ 
•	No attempt to clean up the washed-up seaweed and it lined the water edge 
•	The number of hecklers allowed to wander around the beach chairs is outrageous. 
•	The pools closed at 7PM! 
Customer Service:
•	This was the most unfriendly, unaccommodating, unhelpful staff I have ever encountered in all my years of traveling and working in the hospitality industry. 
•	Calls for support from the hotel room often times resulted in calls going unanswered
•	I was shocked by the lack of English spoken and understood by the staff, most understood zero English.
•	The house keepers were not properly trained and entered room multiple times unannounced.
•	I physically went to the customer service desk at 11am, 1pm and 3pm to try to speak with the manager, Stephanie, and was dismissed each time. I still have not heard from anyone at the resort regarding my experience.
Avoid the Paradisus Palma Real and any other Melia resort while visiting the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: ricardo1979877
reviews.title: Mala atención u comida
reviews.text:
El hotel tiene una buena infraestructura, pero el servicio es muy malo. La gente no tiene ganas de atender y si nota q lo hacer por obligación.

La comida no es buena y cuando se acaba algo en el buffet es muy difícil que lo repongan.

reviews.author: María José Z
reviews.title: No vuelvo, mala experiencia
reviews.text:
Empecemos por lo bueno, porque esta parte es bien corta. El cuarto es lo único bueno que encontramos. Es un cuarto recién remodelado y cómodo para la familia.
En cuanto al servicio, es pésimo en casi todas las áreas. Desde que llegamos empezaron los problemas. Llegamos 2pm y daban las 4:30 pm y aún nos tenían esperando para darnos el cuarto.
La comida del buffet bastante mediocre, por no decir mala. Me esperaba muchísimo más.  No había disponibilidad para reservar en ningún restaurante que no fuera el buffet ninguno de los días que estuvimos ahí y el hotel no estaba lleno. 
La zona de niños o kidszone, fui a conocerla el primer día, por que nuestra idea era poder dejar a los niños ahí aunque fuera 1 hora para poder descansar, y cuando entré la persona a cargo de los niños estaba en una esquina del lugar haciendo una pulsera, los niños en cualquier parte sin mucha atención, no me dió confianza para dejarlos ahí solos ni un minuto de la estadía, ósea no cumplió la función para lo que lo queríamos. 
Nuestro cuarto estaba muy cerca de la playa pero para ir a buscar las toallas de playa o ir a buscar un trago teníamos que recorrer el hotel completo.
Room service no funciona, llamé 3 veces, durante 2 días, para pedir almohadas para mis hijos (que nunca pusieron en el sofá cama) y estas nunca llegaron.
La verdad muy mala experiencia, no volvería

reviews.author: Eduardo Joaquin C
reviews.title: Not a paradise, but literal hell!
reviews.text:
I really don’t mean to be abrasive but the reality is quite different from what is portrayed here. If you travel to Paradisus, you do need be prepared to deal with constant harassment within the resort and beach. There are literally dozens of illegal vendors everywhere offering people drugs and other illegal items. All of this as the resort staff/tourist “police” take bribes (literally, in front of you) and turn a blind eye.

The quality of entertainment and food are beyond underwhelming, especially when compared to similarly-priced resort chains (i.e.: Excellence Resorts or Iberostar).

The rooms are in very poor condition as well, with rust being present throughout most metallic items, including outside tub. It was literally unsanitary.

The staff is rude and under-trained, again, especially when compared to the performance you find at comparably-priced resorts in the Punta Cana/Uvero Alto region.

My one (and only) trip to this awful place ended on the second day. My fiancé and I had a nonrefundable reservation; this experience was so traumatic and disappointing that we decided to book a vacation on the fly for the remainder of our stay in the Dominican republic — at a resort we knew and away from this awful place. We ended up spending an extra $2200 to make the change, but it was money well spent to leave this place!

Our advice is simple. Stay away at all costs; the experience and value at competitively-priced chains in the area is so overwhelmingly better.

reviews.author: Juan Jose Fernandez
reviews.title: No cumplen con la reserva
reviews.text: No me quisieron dar la habitación que pague. Saque una habitación de 75 metros por el sitio Booking, que al día de hoy siguen vendiendo, para el lugar solo adultos. Y me querían dar una habitación simple y que además 48 horas antes de la salida debería mudarme a otro complejo porque el hotel había sobrevendido a esa fecha.Depcecionante.

reviews.author: Pathik P
reviews.title: Family get to gether
reviews.text: I don't have very good stay since I made the bookings, it's always there something before , while staying when service issue , food issue and after stay as well that my points are still not there in my account. Contact serval time even corporate people also but no one even cares and reply.

reviews.author: Anivette GarciaSoldevila
reviews.title: Do not be mesmerized by the looks!
reviews.text:
Do not be mesmerized by the looks!
This is the worst experience I’ve had in the last years.
I had not experienced such bad customer experience.
Everything in this place is controlled, even these reviews.
They instruct you and tell you that if you do not put 5 stars, the review won’t show or will be erased.
We have experienced no AC in our room, and no offering to change us from it.
The refrigerator never cools enough a water bottle or a coke; it’s just there to look pretty.
Room service doesn’t broom the floors or mop them unless you ask for it. They are there to pick up beds and that’s it!
Everyone tells you something different and everyone has a new excuse.
Will never recommend!

reviews.author: Hello24
reviews.title: OUR STUFF GOT STOLEN
reviews.text:
Our stuff got stolen from this place.

For Background: I never write reviews. This is my first review on anything so imagine my frustration. I am writing this while on “vacation”. Don’t waste your money. Please please go somewhere else. Our stuff got stolen from our room the night we arrived. We checked in, dropped our bags and went for dinner. When we got back, most of our stuff was gone. My husband’s clothes (All brand new shirts) underwear even used ones including mine, also my makeup bag/ prescription glasses/ sunglasses/ my personal bag with everything. I still can’t believe we are going through this nightmare. My husband and I came here to celebrate my son’s birthday and it turned out to be an absolute nightmare. We even paid extra for their fancy swim up suites which was on the ground floor. The thief literally jumped in from a window. This stay COULD BASICALLY BE A WHITE LOTUS EPISODE. AND TO TOP IT ALL , HOTEL DID NOTHING EXTRA TO MAKE US FEEL BETTER. THEY  JUST GAVE US FAKE PROMISES WITH NO ACTUAL PROGRESS. WE ARE NOT EXPECTING OUR THINGS BACK BUT C’MON!!!

MAYBE IF WE WERE WHITE THINGS WOULD HAVE BEEN DONE DIFFERENTLY. SO YEAH, STAY AWAY. BE SAFE.

reviews.author: samy0319
reviews.title: Not a good experience
reviews.text: The service is horrible in this resort. It took 3 people and a supervisor to get us checked in. We booked various rooms, but the rooms in the same tier have different standards of amenities. The supervisors do not help and they don’t care if they mess up. In fact, Fernando blamed us that he didn’t understand what we wanted. Mind you we spoke in his native language Spanish and repeated it multiple times. Service to the rooms, call them like 4 times to get anything. We even had a part of the family say in the Nikete level, they paid more money for even worse service. They actually didn’t anything they were promised and the lower end rooms where nice then the more expensive room. They had issues with their room from the start of the trip and their dedicated concierge was a complete lie, he didn’t show up and didn’t help. Activities are scarce. The food was okay. But for the price, go to another resort and have a blast. This one looks like they painted it from falling apart and the service was terrible.

reviews.author: Yegzeru A
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Good day,
I am writing to give feedback on my stay at Paradisus Palma Real. I am a member for about 8 years. There are times I stay using my options, and there are times I go to Punta Cana just because my family and I love it there. We have always have good experiences and this was the first time we didn’t. 
We checked in and our room was not ready. Understandable, because we arrived to the hotel at 1.  After checking in, the person at the front desk told us to come back at 3 to see if the room was ready. We went to the beach and grabbed a bite to eat before heading back to the front desk. I found it weird how I wasn’t given a concierge right away so that the concierge would let me know when the room was ready, but I figured I would get one soon enough. 
The following day, I decided to make a reservation for a restaurant. Upon trying to make a reservation, a concierge came to me and said that he wasn’t notified of my arrival and he was waiting for us, meanwhile this was the following day. He went ahead and made a reservation for us that Saturday night at the Italian place. He told us the reservation would be under another room because I guess that person cancelled. The reservation was at 8. We usually never eat that late, but we took it. When we got to the restaurant, we gave the person the room number that the concierge had given us. They asked our name and told us there was no reservation. We showed them the text message from the concierge but they said there was nothing they can do. We left the restaurant disappointed because we could not eat there and because now we were forced to eat late at the buffet. 
The next day, the concierge let us know there was another reservation made for us at the Mexican place. When we get there, we give our room number and name and they tell us that the reservation was made for one person. They told us that luckily they had room so they were able to squeeze us in. Another disappointment for us having to be told the reservation was made incorrectly by the concierge. 
The day I met the concierge, he knew I wanted to eat at either the steak house or hibachi for our final dinner which was Monday. He let me know that reservations can only be made 2 days in advance. So when we asked him on Monday morning, he said everything was booked. So for our last night there, we ordered room service. 
This whole trip was disappointing. My family and I have never experienced this and I ask myself, is good service given to members only? If that’s the case, very sad. Melia is a huge company and has to remember they have members that don’t always come using options and regardless great service service always be provided. 
There were 2 employees that were nothing but nice to us and that was Eric that was our waiter at the buffet for lunch and  Vanessa who took take of us while at the beach.

reviews.author: Nubar K
reviews.title: Deception, disgusting and disappointing
reviews.text:
I would give this hotel a 0 if i could. Recently got back from our 1st family vacation in years and was run through the typical mill of ripping off tourists.  
We booked connecting rooms as we have 3 small children, all was confirmed over the phone.  A week prior we are told rooms are not connected and there is no availability.  Of course when i arrive at the front desk what am i told  by front desk "if you can pay $700 cash we can give you connecting rooms"  What do i do? I traveled 1k miles with my kids, I was left with my pants down and had to pay.  Insane extortion.
The facility itself is beautiful, I cant knock it.  The majority of the staff is disinterested in your happiness and comfort.  There were a few absolutely selfless and dedicated employees on site, good luck finding them as it wont be hard since most are so rude and make fun of you when you try and speak spanish.
Room keys always malfunction so you need to go to front desk all the time.
The pinnacle was after the 1st room cleaning, we came back at night and found a stain on the sheets - you decide, blood or feces that was not cleaned.  Although they immediately changed it the customer service after claimed it was RUST.  How does a cloth sheet rust???? absurd.  
Think twice before you book.  Truly gives the Paradisus name a bad look.  My post stay complaints with the hotel were absolutely worthless and you can see from every comment on these reviews.  They apologize and hope they can improve next time.  

So much for a paradise.......

reviews.author: Eric C
reviews.title: I don’t recommend you can find better place
reviews.text: Food is terrible, people preparing breakfast don’t know what they doing. They cannot make even simple eggs over easy. Half of the restaurants you not allowed to go too unless you are a member you cannot use full facility because you’re not a member and bars are restricted to a member or adults only section, Communication with the guests are terrible. They had a big event and they did not notify anybody that you cannot use buffet for a dinner. They made me eat in Mexican restaurant which I don’t like. None of the bars can make a piña colada. They told me they don’t have piña colada in this hotel. I can have anything else, but piña colada the simplest drink to make and specially in Caribbean. Waiters and maids working great rooms are very clean. Waiters are polite, but everything else in this place bad

reviews.author: Teresa B
reviews.title: NO SERVING UTENSILS at BUFFET
reviews.text: If you like to use your hands to get food vs serving utensils at the Buffet then this is your place. 🤮. Not every item on the buffet had serving utensils and people were using their hands. GROSS & NO THANK YOU

reviews.author: Erica
reviews.title: Hard Pass.
reviews.text:
We had the most disappointing stay here. We upgraded to a Nikke room so we would have upgraded services and a butler to help us with our stay. Our room was old and dated. Our butler did NOTHING for us. Not one reservation. Didn’t answer our texts. We did not get the promised amenities or services or experiences. We called, talked to front desk, emailed Melia. No one cared. I’m furious and beyond disappointed. 

Nothing in the resort is amazing. Food is meh. Activities are very few and far between. Go elsewhere.

reviews.author: scott a
reviews.title: poor customer service and cold showers
reviews.text:
I am really not one to write reviews but I had no choice after our recent visit.  My wife and I organized a trip for our daughters spring break and convinced 15 other families to join us.  
Let me start with a couple positives:  this location has great weather, the swim out pool was amazing and the beach was walkable and really nice.
Here we go:  the customer service was flat out pathetic!   I was fully expecting somone to understand english but the majority of the resort knew little to zero english.  This really makes communicating or asking any questions nearly impossible.   The food was maybe a 2 out of 10 and our entire group was sick the majority of the time.  (3) of our days/nights were without hot water in both of our rooms.  When I asked to have this addressed, nothing was done.  When we went to check out and I asked to speak to our "butler", he walked the other way.  When I asked to speak to a manager to discuss our frustrations, no one had any authority to do anything.  I was not looking for a huge portion off the bill, but wanted someone (anyone) to take accountability for no hot water.  I would never, ever recommend staying at this resort!

reviews.author: Heather O
reviews.title: TERRIBLE! Spend your money elsewhere
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for four nights and I would never return. The staff are the opposite of helpful and they hide behind the language barrier and act like they don't know what you are asking for. When we asked in fluent Spanish, they still act like they don't understand you. All the staff want are tips, tips and more tips. If you don't have money waving in front of them, they ignore you. A roach was in my room -- they don't care. We were out of towels, toilet paper and tissues - they don't care. It's really shocking the terrible service. The food is plentiful, but not appetizing at all. The first vacation in my adult life that I have lost weight. The breakfasts were good --- you could get an omelet. But it went downhill from there.
