Una semana de desesperación . 
En cuanto a comida , la calidad terrible y encontramos pelos en ella. El room service el peor que he tomado nunca en un hotel. El buffet Naos muy sucio y en pocas ocasiones reponían la comida . el buffet Palazzo , exclusivo para “The reserve “ ( clientes exclusivos se supone ) estaba muy poco surtido y fatal atendido.  La imagen general es que los huéspedes no paraban de quejarse a el personal del hotel.
En cuanto a habitaciones , están muy dejadas y poco limpias , hubo días que no repusieron los productos del baños ni los snacks del minibar después de haberlo pedido durante constantemente. Nuestra ventana estaba rota y había días que el viento silbaba como si estuviéramos en la selva y no nos dejaba dormir.
Seguidamente, el servicio es MUY LENTO aparte de malo . Camareros muy lentos y con constantes olvidos de las comandas en TODOS los diferentes restaurantes del hotel. De 6 días , desayunamos la mitad , ya que simplemente pasaron de traernos el desayuno. 
En este hotel pasamos la nochevieja , y la cena pintaba bien al menos en el menú escrito , pero la falta de organización y descoordinación de camareros resultaron en que nos trajeron el postre a la mitad de la cena y los entrantes después , a pesar de haberlos pedido reiteradamente . Por no hablar de que teníamos una botella de champán (comprada aparte ) y nos la trajeron caliente , como todas las demás bebidas que pedíamos ( refrescos , cervezas , agua embotellada …) 
Y lo peor es que nos habían vendido “las mejores habitaciones de todo el hotel además de un trato exclusivo” pero nuestra sorpresa fue al hablar con otros huéspedes y a ellos les vendieron exactamente el mismo “speech” y las mismas falsedades.

Aunque también me gustaría destacar el servicio de Pedro el señor que trabaja en la playa , que está desde bien temprano allí asegurándose que todo el mundo esté cómodo y es muy atento. Además de los jardineros , que hacen un buen trabajo manteniendo los jardines del hotel cuidados y bonitos. Y también de la camarera del bar del lobby del hotel además de el camarero que sirve en la barra que se encuentra entre el “steak cave” y el restaurante del tepanyaki. A todos ellos muchas gracias.

Si para Melia el nombre de Paradisius Palma Real significa lujo , está muy lejos de serlo . Pero no vinimos buscando lujo( aunque así sea como lo publicitan )  vinimos buscando descanso y buen servicio por el que pagas una buena cantidad de dinero.
En resumen, unas merecidas vacaciones que si te dejas llevar por este personal del hotel pueden ser las peores de tu vida. 
Una pena ya que la playa y el clima son impresionantes , pero ….

reviews.author: Car.ag
reviews.title: LA MEN TA BLE
reviews.text:
Un auténtico desastre, las habitaciones bastante dejadas, el personal maleducado y poco profesional (salvo 4-5 trabajadores), la comida una auténtica vergüenza por no decir asqueroso, no solo el buffet, los restaurantes más de lo mismo…
Venden este hotel como lujo y es lo más alejado a eso.
La sensación es de dejadez constante, en el servicio, en la limpieza de las habitaciones (si tienes suerte de que vayan), la predisposición ante cualquier solicitud es nula.
Me llama mucho la atención que un Meliá de todo esto, pero lo que está claro es que nunca más iremos a ningún alojamiento de esta cadena.
A mi vuelta mandaré una carta a la dirección de Meliá para expresar todo lo que hemos vivido en estos 7 terribles días en su “hostal”.

Por favor, NO VENGAN a este hotel.

Pd: le doy una estrella porque no me deja dar cero

reviews.author: Family of 4
reviews.title: First and Last visit to Paradisus Resort.
reviews.text: The customer service was horrible.  The first day we were here we tried to reserve a tennis court. We were told to use the Meliá App. We tried this and the App said to call the number to reserve a court. We called and there was no answer. The next day we asked guest services about reserving a tennis court. After 5 minutes of discussion about using the Meliá app they finally agreed to call and make a tennis reservation for us. The experience was horrible. The court had exposed wires and the net had holes in it. I will try to attach a picture so you can see for yourself.  The absolute worst part was the buffet dinner.  My son found a staple in his dessert. I talked to three staff about the situation. Nothing was done. They took our room number as if they were going to do something to help us and then they disappeared. We never saw that particular staff again. Additionally, we tried to make a reservation for dinner at the other restaurant  on the property and we were told we had a reservation. When we arrived for dinner at the time we were told, the hostess told us we had no reservation and they were booked up for the evening. I could go on and on, but this  has been the absolute worst experience. Don’t waste your money here!

reviews.author: lsfcmh
reviews.title: Third Time Was Not A Charm
reviews.text:
Apologies for this long review--I am very active on Trip Advisor, travel over 1M miles a year globally for work and have NEVER written a review like this!

Reading reviews from the past week, I cannot believe anyone who has ever been to this resort previously, would say it was a 4- or 5-star experience last week as literally every single aspect of this all-inclusive has plummeted since last year, when we were in the throws of COVID for the first time, so there was no “Covid” excuse here for everything being poor. This was our 3rd stay at this complex since we loved it so much, but after the past 8 days, we will not return and have virtually nothing positive to share other than the free COVID Rapid Test was a welcome amenity.

1)	Reservations: I had almost a dozen discussions directly with Melia Reservations over the past 3 months as they offer the best price. Last year at this time we stayed at Grand Cana, and it was amazing without a single service lapse. We were able to use all the facilities at Palma Real Golf and Spa and Grand Cana (as Reserve was closed last year). My kids wanted to stay at PR this year as that is where the “action” is for the college and post-college age crowd, so we booked a room at both. It wasn’t until 3 weeks before the trip that I called Reservations to confirm a room request that I discovered that Grand Cana is no longer part of PR and was told it was a separate resort and I could no longer use the facilities at PR (This turned out to be a lie as we met many people using all 3 sites). Reservations said what used to be 3 in 1 resort and was now 2 in 1 (Reserve and PR) and I could upgrade to stay at the Reserve and be able to use PR. 

I used Amex points for a few nights at the start of the stay for each room and sent multiple notes to a half dozen people in Reservations on site to request that the reservations be linked so we wouldn’t need to switch rooms. None of this was honored and when we arrived, they claimed to not know anything about this until I showed the string of emails.  Despite promises of an upgraded room on the Melia Rewards site and in every conversation, none was forthcoming. We had a dark, dank ground floor basic room. In fact, we were put in PR, not in the Reserve and told that was what we booked. My reservation clearly shows the Reserve in the booking, and I was in the lowest level of room next to my kid’s room. I was told there were not other rooms available.  I asked if the Reserve rooms had the tub on the balcony like the Grand Cana did and was told no, this wasn’t an option (This was a lie—the balcony rooms at the Reserve indeed have the tub on the balcony).

2)	Check In: The butler assigned to us was too busy to meet and greet us for check-in, so we had a regular check in agent from behind the desk who walked us down to the Reserve Lounge. By the time we were done, we had 3 different people check us in, none of whom had any responsibility as our butler, and we could not make any restaurant reservations. I was told I had a great upgraded room (false) and that I was getting a “Reserve” room in the main building. Both were patently false. 

3)	Butler Service: Non-existent. Our first butler, Guerrero, couldn’t deal with our questions about the wrong reservations and our displeasure. He turned us over to Frank, who, after trying to tell me the only way to use the Grand Cana and get better reservations was to do a meeting with the Circle team as that is how you get great service. (After doing the 2 hours + hard pressure bait and switch time share sell last year, I passed).  Frank tried to push us into every buffet dinner possible instead of the restaurants we wanted to try. He never sent the daily activities to us or recommended anything. Completely different from our 2 previous butlers who would meet us every morning and provide updates, suggestions for the day etc. He then went MIA for a day with no response or notice so after an hour at the main lobby “customer service” I was turned over to Grace, the manager of the butlers. While she was super helpful and gracious enough to upgrade my kids to the Reserve level to get into Palazzo for lunch, the backlash from Frank for escalating to his manager, was swift and he refused to help with anything for the rest of the trip. Guerrero then turned me over to Leonela (note he showed up the last day to ensure we checked out on time and get the bellman to get our bags and, I suspect, to get a tip) who responded to requests for activities. 

4)	Reserve Pool: The 2 “Private”  Reserve Pools at PR are a joke. Despite saying it is “Adults Only”, the first pool was crammed with families, screaming babies and toddlers with all their toys around the pool. They also were largely not Reserve guests.  The second, more private pool, had zero availability. Day 1, I went at 9AM to put towels on the chairs—completely full. Day 2 went at 8AM. Same deal. Day 3 went at 7:30 AM same deal. Asked the worker how this could be and found that they are heavily tipped by guests the day before to put their towels out. In many cases, guests didn’t show up til after noon. This is an all-inclusive—to see blatant tipping like this all over for the first time as a real disappointment. 

5)	Buffets, Food and Beverage: Across the board this was the biggest disappointment.  Unless you were at the buffet when it first opened, what was consistent is that the replenishment was slow to non-existent. If you showed up at 10AM for breakfast, at least 50% of the stations were empty and not refilled (no bacon, no ham, no ingredients for juicing, no smoked salmon). At lunch, it would take 15-20 minutes to replace the pizza station—it was empty daily for 30-minute stretches at a time. The variety was half of what it was last year. The omelet station burned the eggs every day—how hard is it to teach a cook how to make eggs on a flattop? The customized smoothies from last year were gone. When we went to the juice station to ask them to make a smoothie (since they had all the ingredients and the blender), instead of juice, we were refused.  The outdoor buffet was horrible—burners were not relit so food was universally cold, half of the stations not replenished. The only good buffet was Christmas Eve in the ballroom where the food was as good as the previous years.  

Beverage selection took a huge hit this year. All that is available is the lowest level of “well” alcohol virtually every bar. No more Corona or Heineken, only local Presidente beer offered. No Grey Goose, Absolut, Tanqueray, Boodles—all low-end choices. Half of the blenders were “broken” all week causing me to question if they just didn’t want to make blender drinks outside of the pina colada mix already pre-made.  Service in the “high end” restaurants was poor consistently. First time we had poorly trained waitstaff who don’t know the menu, don’t know how to use the tablets for taking orders and largely don’t speak a lot of English—all of this was an issue this year for the first time.  At the Mexican restaurant, soup came congealed and lukewarm having sat too long in the kitchen. We watched every table (it was less than 50% filled) be served before us and after 45 minutes tried to get our waiter who disappeared. We called over the manager about the poor service. 10 minutes with no feedback, we got up and walked to the kitchen where we saw them furiously making our entrees as the order had never been placed. We walked out. We were told every restaurant was sold out, yet they were 40% full at best, with tables distanced. 

6)	Rooms and Housekeeping:  Toilet was broken and needed repair day 1. Phone was broken and needed repair. Sink was clogged. Refrigerator was half empty and restocked once during our stay. 1 bag of chips and 1 oreo. My kids room wasn’t cleaned for 3 days in a row. Called daily to ask what the issue was. Day 3 we called at 5PM as the room was still not serviced and they showed up at 6:30. No washcloths, random assortment of towels left daily.

7)	SPA: Used the YHI Spa at the Reserve which was so awesome during our previous stays. Literally every amenity has been stripped out: No outdoor showers (no showers at all!! So, you are covered in oil from a massage and can’t shower), Jacuzzi jets broken on one tub and the other is left unfilled. Cold plunge pool not refrigerated, Steam room randomly shuts off, all water fountains shut off, hot tea for before and after service is now just empty teapots as ornaments. Prices haven’t dropped 1 penny for this reduction in service. Service was good. 

8)	Escalation: Melia does a very good job making sure it’s almost impossible to get to a manager and escalate your problem to anyone who can do anything.  You cannot get their extension, their name, their email without going through multiple layers of people with no ability to resolve the issues. This is so different than when you go to a 5-star resort and the staff has the ability and limited authority to make the guest experience excellent. 

When you see the cut and pasted feedback on Trip Advisor and other social media sites from the “manager” about how much they value your comments and feedback, it’s a joke. We spent the vacation with over a dozen “new friends” who were all repeat guests at PR, and all had the same reaction to how bad this resort has become in the past year and all lamenting how you couldn’t find anyone who would help resolve the issue and make the vacation what we anticipated it being.

reviews.author: Valentina G
reviews.title: Lo Peor que he estado para ser cinco estrellas.
reviews.text: Si buscas un lugar para ir de vacaciones en familia, a descansar, no hacer nada, comer bien. Este no es el lugar. Busca otro hotel. Si quieres una manta extra, ten paciencia te llegará en tres días, no hay shampoo así que te recomiendo traerlo de tu casa, debes tener paciencia para almorzar o comer en el buffet a la carta porque puedes estar esperando mas de una hora por tu plato. Si quieres ir al buffet prepárate para pegarte codazos con los huéspedes para un trozo de pizza o una mesa limpia. Olvídate por ser atendido en tu mesa. Lleva tu bebida. Cuando el día de playa está por terminar y vas a ducharte a tu habitación para ir a cenar, anímate nuevamente pues el aseo de tu habitación tampoco está listo, es más rápido que lo hagas tu. El hotel cuesta una fortuna y la atención, calidad de comida, servicio, capacitación del personal es una vergüenza. Mi lista es interminable. Te recomiendo el Majestic Mirage. Nuestra experiencia no tuvo punto de comparación. Como dice el dicho: First and Last. Mi nota para este Hotel es un 0.

reviews.author: Chen N
reviews.title: 1 star review
reviews.text:
I stayed in many all inclusive resort all over Mexico and the Caribbean, this is by far the worst one I stayed in.
Inside the building where all the regular rooms are there is a night club that is open until 2am. The music is so loud, no one can sleep in the noise.
If you want to upgrade to stay at a quieter building you need to be the Reserve which is adult only or The Reserve family section which is over 10 minutes walk from the beach with no view at all.
After many complaints they promised to reduce the music a little which helped, but every night we had the same problem again and again.
This hotel is very run down.
Food is average minus. The only good thing is the service, still cant compare the service to any of the Mexico resorts I have been to.

reviews.author: Krimmie
reviews.title: Look Elsewhere - Worst All-Inclusive Experience
reviews.text: Please don’t believe the positive reviews you see here.  I’m not sure how they have those, but trust me, this is the worst all-inclusive experience you can pay for.  Multiple issues with our room (no hot water, AC not working properly, toilets constantly backing up, dirty linens and drapes to name a few).  Food was terrible and limited.  Buffet was luke warm and picked over/dirty.  It’s nearly impossible to get reservations in their restaurants (despite standing in long lines).  The only choices for breakfast and lunch are the nasty buffet and hot dogs/hamburgers in beach stand.  Customer service is horrible, no manager available despite multiple requests to speak to one and impossible to get someone from Meliá corporate customer service.  Do yourself a huge favor and find a different resort.

reviews.author: Reem S
reviews.title: If you care about quality, dont spend ur money here
reviews.text: Dont go to this place. I had to go to the service desk 10 times after my arrival to ask to fix things in my room. Not really clean. Everything I had to ask for even my advisory person who supposed to guide me, I contacted her after I missed first day’s activities.

reviews.author: Rich M
reviews.title: Crap food, crap service all around, nobody speaks English- Terrible disappointment
reviews.text: The title says it all.  Don't waste your time or money.   Nobody that works there actually cares about what  you want they just do whatever they feel like doing.  Highly disappointed and will never go back.

reviews.author: Ferveci
reviews.title: Terrible place to stay
reviews.text: I just got back from my trip in this facility and there is no way to describe how bad and how terrible experience on this Melia I will never go back again and I will recommend you never go To this property, Bad food, terrible experience with management on the property, not even know  what kind of alcohol you getting at the bar ,terrible experience never go to this place,I stay at this property back in 2018 And that is the reason that I went back now but after the experience now I will never go back again to this property

reviews.author: Angegol
reviews.title: Me Robaron en la habitación, Nunca antes me había sucedido
reviews.text: Me robaron en la habitación y nadie me solucionó nada. Encima la mucama que estaba limpiando la habitación al preguntarle por lo sucedido nos contestó mal. Hicimos el reclamo pero no solucionaron nada.

reviews.author: tmontana2018
reviews.title: This resort is not open!! BAIT AND SWITCH ALERT!!
reviews.text:
We booked this vacation for 12 people and we’re switched to GRAND CANA (CACA) on the last minute. Not only did we still pay the premium for THE RESERVE RESORT, they did not give us back the premium we paid.

The Reserve at Palma Real has not been open for 2 years. We saw drained pools and roof that was falling apart. 

Shame on you Melia for baiting and switching guests who are paying a lot of money to visit your property.

reviews.author: Alberto S
reviews.title: La decadencia de paradisus
reviews.text: Estuve 4 veces en el paradisus punta cana,en realidad 3 y en esta oportunidad cómo está cerrado me enviaron al Palma.En el tiempo fuy experimentado como fue perdiendo calidad en servicio, desde la primera vez que fue hace 25 años me pareció impresionante estaban hasta en el último detalle después comenzaron a diferenciar con sectores más privados y más caros entonces comenzaron a bajar la calidad de bebidas y comidas y ya ahora está ultima experiencia fue desastrosa desde la atención de su personal hasta que en las habitaciones no hay siquiera una bata el hotel muy descuidado y la calidad de sus bebidas creo que son de lo peor de República Dominicana ya todo es de pago si queres tomar una bebida de las conocidas,en los comedores jamás vi queso cotagge un ejemplo cosa qué hay en cualquier hotel del mundo ni hablar de encontrar un langostino o camarón y por último creí que al haberme cambiado de el paradisus punta cana a él palma real estaría mejor ya que su precio fue siempre superior a él nombrado anteriormente pero por esta experiencia tan mala hoy no lo recomendaría y tampoco yo no volvería más hoy me quedo con la cadena Barceló por precio y calidad por mis últimas experiencias

reviews.author: Sabrina S
reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text:
Hi i have been calling and email this resort but no luck in getting a respond from the wedding coordinator. Not good how can I got today a call from someone from the hotel telling me i will get an email waited all day no email 
 Not good😞

reviews.author: baujammie
reviews.title: Do not stay here
reviews.text: We are only on day 3 of a 7 day vacation and ready to leave. We didn’t know you had to book reservations at all restaurants except the buffet so we will only get to eat at one restaurant for breakfast, lunch and dinner and they don’t adjust what is available. Most staff is rude, speakers around pool don’t work so there isn’t music out there very often. We brought our own speaker. If you want something to drink you have to walk and get it. The waiters just pick up your empty paper cups and don’t ask if you want anything else. Beach is dirty and water is not at all clear like in photos. Toilet is broken, door to the bathroom won’t close, walls in the rooms are paper thin and the room next to us like to talk a lot. When we arrived half our group was greeted with drinks and we were not. We were hungry from a full day of travel but the only food option at that time was a shack on the beach that served hamburgers and hot dogs but they were out of hamburgers and the guy didn’t offer to go get more I had to tell him to. We got a different room that we booked on Expedia and was told that room does not exist. You will get hounded by people trying to sell excursions and it isn’t just on the beach, they come onto the resort and won’t leave you alone when you are trying to relax in the pool. One in our group had pizza left in the fridge from previous group yet had a disinfected sticker on there so I can’t imagine they clean the rooms very thoroughly. My daughter left her eye glasses at home so we asked guest services how we could get in town to get her new glasses. He told us he would call a taxi and it would cost $15 each way. We then heard another guest order Uber so we cancelled to taxi and got an Uber and it was only $4 each way. While we were waiting for the Uber a bus pulled up and it was a shuttle to and from the shopping area we were going to for $3 each way. There were many other options than a $15 each way taxi ride. Let me remind you we are only on day 3. We have been going to different all inclusive resorts twice a year for almost 7 years and this is the worst one we have ever been to.

reviews.author: mprtrucklines
reviews.title: Malo
reviews.text: La comida es buena pero no les alcanza, como se les acaba la carne a la parrilla y ya no comen, en el desayuno se les acaba el huevo, en los jugos solo tienen naranja, melón y piña, en un caribe país en temporada de mango y no tenían mango es un ejemplo,En la música es biolín para que te duermas, no tienen nada bueno, el hotel es muy lindo nada más, lamento haber votado el dinero

reviews.author: Elic
reviews.title: Worst place to visit
reviews.text: I made a family reservation with Tripadvisor plus 1 month prior to staying at this resort. First thing, this resort is not open and they will move you to another part of the resort. Second, they will not honor your reservation. They required me to pay extra for my children which were already included in the reservation. The additional $450 I paid for my children didn't not include a bigger room to accommodate them. Instead my poor children had to sleep on a sofa mattress that was all springs. At the end of the stay, the hotel pretty much held me hostage until I paid them the initial reservation amount that I had already paid tripadvisor. Third, my reservation included a 50 minute massage for 2, however that was never honored. Please stay anywhere else but here for your safety! We were in another country with kids and no where else to stay so we had to give in to this extortion.

reviews.author: Yoaned
reviews.title: Mentira y engaño
reviews.text: Voy a tratar de resumir en pocas líneas lo que nos pasó, POR SEGUNDA VEZ!!!! Hace un par de meses(noviembre) reservamos en el hotel, recién abriendo para viajar, antes de viajar llamamos al hotel para confirmar que todo estaba bien, y quiero contarles, que cuando llegamos, directamente nos llevaron a otro hotel, hasta el del taxi sabía que estaba cerrado, menos nosotros. Resumiendo pasamos las vacaciones en un hotel que no queríamos. Pero que tal la sorpresa, que ahora en abril, volvimos a sacar pasaje, llamamos varias veces al hotel para confirmar, hasta email tenemos con la gerenta de ventas confirmando la estadía, y cuando llegamos, fue tal la sorpresa que el hotel estaba desolado, y nadie ni tan siquiera para decirnos que hacer!!!! Horrible!!! Un custodio que encontramos caminando, nos Dino que quizás nos estaban mandando para otro hotel ahí cerca, así fue, habíamos pagado ocean front y todo!!! Y tal fue la mentira, que nos mandaron sin remordimientos a otro alojamiento. No se vale mentir, no se vale estafar, no es justo que le hagan eso a ninguna persona bajo ninguna circunstancia, digan la verdad, y si no tienen el hotel disponible, no mientan para vender. Horrible, es una pena que después de tantos pero tantos años viajando tantas veces en un año,  teminemos desilusionados de esta manera. Esto lo hago para que no lo sigan haciendo a otras familias.

reviews.author: MaryB
reviews.title: Do not book this resort - The Beachfront section is still closed
reviews.text:
We booked a dream vacation last fall to celebrate my husbands retirement. We are due to arrive next Tuesday, expecting to stay at the in the Presidential Suite, beach front royal service. We have been dreaming about this extravagant vacation for many months. 
I went on Tripadvisor this morning to see if there was any information about limited restaurant services due to Covid. Imagine my surprise when another reviewer noted that they had been "upgraded" last minute to another part of the resort away from the beach because that section is closed.

I can understand that Covid has impacted so many businesses, especially in the travel industry. If the resort had contacted us a month ago - because clearly they would have known that they would not be open... 

But we have not received a single communication alerting us to any changes!! 

Imagine if we had just showed up expecting to stay at the Presidential Suite on the beach and we wind up in the back of the resort far away from the beach! 

What terrible customer service!! I have been trying to reach the hotel, not only did they not answer my call when I called Melia main reservation number they were not able to reach the hotel.  

This is a beautiful resort - but beware, what you book and what you get may be completely different. As I said, I understand that we are in a difficult time with the pandemic, but that is no excuse for this complete lack of communication!!

reviews.author: sjv_10
reviews.title: Racism and Incompetence
reviews.text:
My family and I are currently here at the resort. We’re a group of 12 and Dominican. I emphasize the latter because it’s the only reason left as to why we continue to receive poor service. 

Initially, we thought “OK, we’re a large group so the restaurant may have issues delivering our meals on time”. But on our second night here, after close to two hours, we received incomplete appetizers (the lobster bisque was extremely salty) on our second night here at the Sal steakhouse (many of us couldn’t eat the salty and/or cold food). To add insult to injury, there was another large group (8+ people) sitting at a large long table that was done with their entire meal during the same two hour time span. 

We came here to celebrate my mother’s birthday. I wanted to do something nice and rented out the Winery on Dec 28, 2020 from 7-9pm. I was told at the Club Melia office that because the Winery is technically a standalone business, we would need to consume US$600 worth of wine in order to have full privacy (ie, no one else would enter the establishment, especially since the restaurant was already at max occupancy due to COVID restrictions). Not 20 minutes into our event, a white person enters and buys a bottle of wine!! The excuse given - “how could I turn down a customer?” My response: “then don’t and don’t force me to consume a minimum!” The logic is fairly simple - either sell me privacy and commit to it, or don’t. 

Why would the hotel want to put restrictions on me but not another person? Why does my family have to wait about two hours for appetizers, while another family finishes their entire meal during the same time span? Why do the bartenders only choose to implement certain “protocols” to avoid serving us, despite us following the lead of others? This last point is important...the service staff feels comfortable telling us in Spanish what we can and can’t do (because we’re Dominican) but would never dare to speak in English (or any other language) to a non-minority guest because they’re not as fluent in another language. For example, my wife comes out of the main pool wrapped in a towel and has her mask on...she approaches the Gabi beach bar and the bartender says “you can’t come to this bar if you’re went.” Mind you, the bar is called “the Gabi beach bar” and many other non racial minorities had already been served in their wet bathing suits sometimes with NO MASKS ON and the bartenders don’t say anything....coincidence, I think not!

Conclusion: if you’re a non racial minority, come and enjoy the great resort. If you’re a racial minority, don’t bother giving a racist and incompetent service staff money. #RacistMelia

reviews.author: Adam R
reviews.title: Terrible Experience with coronavirus
reviews.text: Came here for my 5th reunion of our honeymoon.  The resort shut down and we did not receive the service we paid for.  Restaurants weren't open most nights, they stopped serving alcohol, and guests were not allowed to lay by the pool.  I understand the precautions and the Dominican Republic shutting their borders.  My review is based upon the fact that they refused to offer us a refund for the days we paid for.  They offered a voucher for one year from when we booked.  Well we booked three months ago and are planning to have children.  Can't travel with an infant.  They have refused to be understanding and offer us a refund.  Never again will I travel to this family of resorts for their behavior.  Sad because I've had a great time at this resort for my honeymoon and love the staff.  I will be proceeding in small claims court against this resort.  I would strongly encourage that no one prepay for their booking as the hotel will outright steal your money if their is an extenuating circumstance.

reviews.author: Steven T
reviews.title: Very Disappointing Experience
reviews.text: I stayed at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana from February 28th until March 5th in room #1437, Bldg.#43. The room had many maintenance and housekeeping issues. Some issues were fixed, others were not, such as both phones not working during my stay. I have used Melia Resorts for my last 5 vacations and my experiences have been good.This time, I was not satisfied at all. I will not return or recommend this hotel!

reviews.author: Oleg R
reviews.title: NOT "The Best Vacation Ever"
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real during the third week of February 2020. The property actually has 3 hotels on premises - The Grand Reserve, The Reserve, and Palma Real. The Grand Reserve is their top of the line hotel, and Palma Real is the lowest level on the list.
The grounds look amazing and all hotels are very well maintained. We had an excellent 1 bedroom suite in a newly renovated building close to the beach and were very happy about it. The beach is not very crowded so one can always get a spot, and there is no need to get up very early in the morning to "reserve" it.
Unfortunately, there were a lot more negatives than positives at the hotel:
1. The food at the buffet is really terrible. In the morning, the pancakes would always be burned, waffles hard as stone, and "chefs" would overdo the omelet on regular basis. The food is almost exactly the same during the lunch time and the evening with a very little variety.  They are definitely pushing you to eat at the restaurants in the evening.
2. At the same time, it is extremely difficult to get a reservation at the restaurants. We came to the resort on Saturday. On Sunday, I went to make the reservation for the whole week and was only able to make the reservation for next Friday. All other days were completely booked. Since the food at the buffet was unacceptable, we complained to the Guest Services. Only then, with the great help from Delgis Castillo we were able to get the reservations. Delgis was kind enough to completely take care of the problem for us and texted me every day with the exact time and the name of the restaurant. Thanks again Delgis for the great service.
3. The food at the restaurants was definitely better than the buffet, but it was nothing special – very average.
4. The beach is divided into small parts depending on your level of service. People staying at the Grand Reserve get the new chaise lounges. We stayed at Palma Real so we had very old chaise lounges that had paint peeling off of them (see picture attached).
5. The beach was covered with seaweed. They only started cleaning it on the fourth day of our staying at the hotel, but still to no avail (see picture attached).
 6. Kids have no kids club anywhere on Palma Real property and have to go to the one located at The Reserve. There is a water park on premises, but it is only available to the guests of The Grand Reserve and The Reserve.
7. The entertainment is almost non-existent. There is almost nothing going on during the day and the quality of the evening entertainment is below average. 

If you have a choice, chose some other resort. There are many better options available.

reviews.author: Julie L
reviews.title: I am stupid for coming to this resort!!!
reviews.text:
So today is my day 3 here at the reserve. I am taking the time to write this here at the resort because this place is SO bad ; First off, staff don’t speak any English. You try speaking to them in English mixed with broken Spanish and they look at you like you’re an alien. I dial 0 for help desk and the girl speaks Spanish and hangs up. Wtf??? I tried dialing 4 times and each time she just stops talking and I could hear her chatting with her fellow colleague. That is so rude. They have no basic manners let alone decent customer service. We were guaranteed two beds in our suite at the time of our booking and we got one bed. The room is huge and therefore the maids must not have enough time to clean it because I could smell dust on the towels and their linen and pillows smelled like a 50 year old man’s cologne.

On my second day I asked 3 employees where the Grill was. I got three different answers. Nobody working here knows anything. Apparently half the restaurants are closed. Casino is closed. Maybe because decreased business? Maybe because this place sucks

Food? This part is what made me angry the most. I’ve been to all inclusives at Cancun before and the food was amazing. Simply blissful. It was heaven. I should not have expected the same here for Punta Cana; I feel so stupid for coming here!!!! You have two buffets to choose from otherwise you need to make an appointment. The buffet is tiny and they really are stingy with the quality of food. This is a resort located in the middle of the Caribbean and I did not see a single fresh seafood like shrimp being grilled in front of you. They have the cheapest food, chicken and a bunch of sugary snacks to fill you up instead of real quality meal. They have the typical food you’d eat back in US, except they’re stale and tastes out of date. Like my pancake this morning was hard as a brick. Seriously? At the beach gabi buffet I order a beer and the waitress forgot my order or didn’t understand or something, I had to reorder and ended up getting it when I was done my meal.
Best tasting food at either of the buffet is pineapple and mango. And fried chicken. You know you can just pick a mango off a tree, right? You know it’s bad when the best food here at a tropical resort ends up being fried chicken. And fruit. 

My salad at The Grill had rotten avocados and eggs. They messed up my order; they gave me squid instead of shrimp. Best tasting thing they had there was....butter. Yep, the square butter made in USA. Bread was stale and old but butter made it better. My mom got a steak and they didn’t even ask her how well done. I got a chicken and it was half burnt. They brought out my fries so I asked for ketchup and the girl just half nodded and brushed past. It never came surprise! I gave up on the ketchup. 

I still have two more days to go and honestly, I am looking forward to going home. I feel gross every time I sleep in my bed because it smells so used and uncles bed and whenever I am hungry I don’t even look forward to eating. 

Pool is ok. It’s a bit dirty but it’s outdoor so it can’t be helped. The beach is like a 10 min walk from the reserve. I was told it be closer. Whatever good exercise right? Beach needs to get more towels or get cleaner chairs because their beach chairs are wet and have pee stains on them so having at least 5 towels is mandatory. And there are never enough towels. 

I feel bad for a few hard working employees there who don’t deserve this terrible post, but simply sad, this place is NOT vacation. It’s stressful. I already go to work for that. Gracias guys. Please; Go to Cancun. It’s much much better there. Here is scary.

reviews.author: MaybeTomorrow
reviews.title: Won’t recommend.
reviews.text:
If you want to relax and be treated well this is the wrong place. 

They do not care about you however they care about your money so please save some for another and good resort. 

They’re not organised, almost lost our luggages and they simply do not care at all.

reviews.author: roberto otero
reviews.title: horrible
reviews.text:
un desastre fui 8 veces y ne da lastima lo que quedo de el estuve febrero 2020 comida servicio 3 restaurantes habilitados uno cierra de vez en cuando a los otros 2 le cambian el nombre y la carta comi mal en todos poco personal poca comida y desayuno devaluado instalaciones abandonadas no es mas un 5 estrellas con suerte un 3 pensar que tenia 12 restaurantes , no tiene animacion despues de las 23 hs cerraron el casino y el bailable 
una experiaencia irrepetible 
por favor publiquen fotos nuevas y no sigan engañando a a la gente es un 3 o 4 estrellas coo mucho

reviews.author: GARDENIA YOLIMA S
reviews.title: Decepción del Hotel
reviews.text: Hemos hecho la reserva para una semana con las espectativa de estar un lugar mágico. La verdad el hotel como construcción es muy bonito. Pero es una pena el descontrol del personal existe casi más empleados que huéspedes pero no veo ningún control del personal cada uno va a lo suyo. Le preguntas a 4 empleados algo y cada uno te dice algo diferente. Los muebles y el mobiliario muy viejo y anticuado. Las lámparas de los restaurantes destrozadas y los muebles muy de batalla. No hay casi nada de actividades para los huéspedes y no existe ninguna información de las pocas cosas que hacen es una pena. Creo que falta una remodelación inmediata de la decoración. El personal necesita más formación de hostelería no saben ni limpiar un mesa algunos. Creo que la dirección no funciona como debería. Muchos empleados pero sin organización todo un caos. Es una pena porque el edificio y ubicación del hotel son muy bonitos. Pero la administración deja mucho que desear. Pensé que sería algo más especial. Lo peor es el aburrimiento que no teníamos información de actividades falta que piensen más en los huéspedes. La comida puede ser mejorable y la verdad que es una pena. Esta en comedor buffet y le pides algo algún camarero y se les olvida después está detrás de 4 para que te lo traigan. Todos los días el personal cambia nunca hemos visto a los mismo. Creo que lo peor de todo es descontrol de empleados es una locura les ves andar por todo el hotel pero no sé saben cuál es el trabajo de cada uno es un desmadre. Las camas muy buenas las habitaciones muy amplias   Espero mejoren pero seguro que nosotros no regresaremos. Ganas no nos quedaron.

reviews.author: Tig B
reviews.title: Resort showed no desire to help when my wife got sick from their food and uncleanlyiness.
reviews.text: We stayed and the Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen last year in Mexico the rooms were great and the food was incredible so we thought we would try Paradisus  Palma Real in the Dominican. Our room even though we upgraded to a suite was filthy when we checked in. Dried contact lenses on the night stand dust and dirt on the end tables, open coke container in the fridge, no hand towels, stained bed cover, leaking shower, torn door seal on the shower, and generally unclean conditions. My wife got extremely ill and could not fly home she had to leave the airplane because she could not stop throwing up. The hotel would do nothing to help plenty of open rooms but the would not extend us 24 hours they made me book online and pay for a new room and refused to help. We had to make our own arrangements to the airport even after their own doctor examined my wife and prescribed medicine for bacterial contamination or food poisoning. Made us pay the higher rate for the room and had nothing but denial that my wife's illness had anything to do with the hotel and food. The doctor prescribed Paramox a medicine for fighting food poisoning and other contaminations.

reviews.author: Carol A
reviews.title: Pédimo
reviews.text:
Calidad precio calidad, pésimo. 
Actividades para niños de 17 y 18 años no hay. El día que asistieron a clases de pintura llegando a la hora no pudieron asistir y’a que empezaron 10 minutos antes. Comida buffet todos los días lo mismo. La playa a 1 km hay que esperar entre 5 a 10 minutos que pase el carrito. 
En la página decía que todos los días champús de una marca los 5 primeros días así fue después, nada. Pague súper caro y la idea es no tener que reclamar por nada. He estado por lo menos en 8 hoteles en punta cana por la mitad de precio y no había tenido nunca un inconveniente. 
Bávaro Palace por la mitad de precio tienes mucho más, la misma playa.
Acá buffet básico total.

reviews.author: Karina Ramirez
reviews.title: Horrible !! NOS ROBARON y check in UNA HORA TARDE  y las habitaciones seguían sin estar listas
reviews.text:
Al llegar al hotel 11.00 am con mis padres y una bebe de 5 meses . Solicitamos entrar a una habitación por favor ni bien la tengan disponible . Nos dijeron que vengamos a la 1, no estaba luego a las 2 no estaba ok. Llego las 3 hora de check in, tampoco estaba . Luego nos dicen que 1 ya está que la otra falta aún, entonces fuimos a la que ya estaba, al llegar seguían limpiando esperamos 1 hora para que nos enteren la habitación (que seguían faltando cosas papel higiénico toallas por ejemplo) y recién a las 16 horas le entregan su pieza a mis padres. Al llamar a reclamar nos dicen que está SOBRE VENDIDO. Y que hacen lo que pueden entre paréntesis el hotel estaba vacío ! Obviamente si estaba lleno tampoco puede ser un motivo pero por lo menos un atenuante. Pero no vació. En fin la chica del cuarto nos dio una respuesta más sincera, tenían problemas con la provisión de toallas, no le llegaban y no podían entregar las habitaciones. Con todo el tema del check IN no nos entregaron las tarjetas de las toallas y caja fuerte. Llamamos a pedir que nos envíen y nos dicen que pasemos a buscar . Con lo que reclamamos que era una falla de ellos no entregar y nos traen las de las toallas nunca la de la caja fuerte . Por pereza nuestra también y por confianzudos (nunca nos tocaron nada en ningún hotel que estuvimos) tárdamos en ir a buscar la tarjeta de la caja fuerte. Ya tarde de mi billetera que estaba guardaba en mi valija me robaron 300 dolares . No esperamos ningún tipo de reposición por parte del hotel, pero si nos molesto cuando su respuesta fue que no creían que haya Siro su gente que ya era muy antigua . Cuando al hablar con una de las chicas de limpieza estaba 1 semana en el hotel. Y para completar al hacer el check out nos percatamos que también nos faltaba el FORRO de una valija . Eso ya es demasiado . Y no sabemos si falta algo más .. 
Malísima experiencia . Y muy mala respuesta por parte del hotel a nuestros problemas . 
Pero luego cuando te quieren vender su membrecia te  bajan el cielo y la estrellas . 
Karina Ramírez

reviews.author: Soozywong
reviews.title: Come at your peril
reviews.text:
If you think you are coming to a 5 star hotel, think again. What they advertise sounds appealing but even when you highlight their shortcomings and complain, they simply cannot deliver what they promise. Staff and management apologise relentlessly but do not have the training or capabilities to rectify anything. 

We had booked two rooms, one in the Beach Reserve (as this surprisingly is the only section of the hotel that affords a proper sea view) and the second for our daughter in the Reserve, which upon arrival we discovered was a long way from our room.  So we paid for an upgrade so she could be in the same wing as ourselves in the Beach Reserve.
Having flown 9 hours to get here and it being 9.00pm at night, we were looking to have dinner. Reception informed us that the restaurants are open until 10.30pm, so no rush. We went to our rooms to unpack, only to find that our daughters room (the one we paid the upgrade for) was in a disgraceful condition with broken light fittings, bulbs not working, a dirty shower, makeup on the bathroom unit, empty tissue box, a badly stocked minibar, broken air conditioning and a safe that didn’t work. We subsequently discovered at daylight that her room did not even overlook the sea despite being assured by management that it did. Our room fared a little better with only a safe that didn’t work. An engineer arrived to repair the safes and we duly went to get fed, by now it was 10.00pm. We went to several of the restaurants only to be told that as we didn’t have a booking we could not be fed, however we could wait until 11.00pm when the late night buffet opens or order room service and sit in our rooms that were below par!

In your room, as part of the standard facilities for Beach Reserve guests they advertise that you get dressing gowns, slippers, a choice of pillows, a choice of fragrances, a butler service (which includes making preferred restaurant bookings although this seemed to challenge the butler we were allocated) and turndown service, none of which we experienced without complaining. We were moved to new rooms where further lack of facilities were prevalent, this time our room had a broken light bulb and a bath with no plug! I am not sure what room inspection procedures they operate, but clearly this is not working. 

Despite informing our butler at 9.15am that our room could be made up, and then reminding him again at 12.00pm that it still has not been done, this didn’t happen until 5.30pm, by which time we were  back from the beach and had to sit on the balcony whilst it was done around us.

The special exclusive lounge facility, where premium alcohol is served, is only open until 3pm, during which time most people are on the beach, so when you return in need of a good drink, hard luck. Even during the advertised opening time the bar is often not manned and the fridges are chained closed.

When complaining to management, they are well trained in apologising but seem to think that it is quite ok to provide such poor service, and will 'verify' your issues, as if not believing your complaints.  We asked 3 times to see the General Manager, but on each occasion we were fobbed off with some underling, the GM being on the missing list. Only after losing my temper and throwing the Guest Relationship manager out of my room was I finally granted a meeting with the Hotel Manager (still not the GM).

There is no empathy from management and you are left with the impression that as a guest here you are actually an inconvenience, someone passing through and there will be someone else to take your place next week when you have departed. Nothing is personal, and no one cares.

Restaurants fare no better, with several dishes from the limited menus in more than one restaurant not available, and hopelessly disorganised seating, even when you have a booking. In Vento we arrived promptly at our reservation time of 9.00pm to be told when checking in that we would get our table in 15-20 minutes, this actually turned out to be 40 minutes before we were called in, and we then had to wait another hour before getting any food. We ate again at Vento on New Years Eve, where for this special night they implemented no dress code. Most guests made some form of effort to dress up, others simply didn’t care and were allowed in looking like they had just come from the beach, wearing shorts, a T-shirt and trainers. Again service was beyond slow, even with missing out a course dinner took two and a half hours, thus we missed most of the new year celebrations.  Aqua fared little better, when we ate one hour after placing our order we were told that part of our order was now unavailable, and it was 90 minutes before our apertizers were served despite the restaurant being less than half full! Having reported matters to one of the management team who happened to be passing he went away to see what he could do, only to disappear and not return! 

As compensation we were given a free meal at Passion, the hotels signature restaurant fronted under the chef Martin Berastegui, winner of numerous Michelin stars. Martin, if I were you I would remove your association with this restaurant immediately before your name and reputation becomes tarnished. I have never eaten in a signature restaurant where the service, rudeness of staff and inability to perform is so bad. The food, if you are prepared to wait and tolerate the dreadful attitude and inefficiencies of the front of house team, is however excellent, but to wait 90 minutes for your first course, serve your wine yourself, not be told what half the dishes contain, and watch other guests walk out in frustration without completing their dinner shows that they simply cannot manage here. I even went into the kitchen to see what on earth was going on! 3.5 hours for dinner is unacceptable added to the disgraceful service in a restaurant that was virtually empty as many other guests had walked out.

In fairness the buffet in the general eating area provides a variety of well stocked and presented dishes, along with a daily barbecue at lunch. Unfortunately you are seated in a noisy canteen like setting to eat your selected food. As Reserve members we are allowed to go to another part of the hotel (Gabi Club) where it is quieter and provides better seating, but the variety of food there is considerably reduced.

Management's excuse for these shortcomings is that they are extremely busy, yet they raise their prices during this period, thus providing “less for more”. They do have a number of excellent helpful staff who go out of their way to provide for the guest, but they are let down by others that project the misery of working here both in attitude and effort. Many of the staff complain about the long shifts and hours they work.

If you come here and were considering visiting the Paradisus shopping mall don’t bother. At least 75% of the shops are empty with all the big names having closed down leaving only about 6 shops and a bank still open,  it is now just a fast food venue, and perhaps someone would like to explain the need for fast food outlets in an all inclusive environment!

BE WARNED, should you decide to go on a tour of the Circle (a timeshare sale under a different name) you will enjoy a beautiful breakfast/ lunch in a upmarket setting and be shown nice rooms and promised superior service. Then you are handed over to the sales team... here comes the hard sell! We were offered to join the 'club' for a mere $280,000 and a service charge of nearly $5,000 per year over 30 years (a number which they conveniently place in small writing in the top corner of the page in the hope that you fail to realise this adds some 50% onto the main price) whilst they focus on some minor fringe benefits that they will throw in as a sweetener. For this you receive some enormous amount of points which can be redeemed in any of the groups hotels. Unfortunately they only have ONE Circle hotel and the Paradisus here is considered to be one of their best properties!

My conclusion is that this hotel is rotten from the top downwards, full of apologies for the shortcomings and inefficiencies but no idea how to rectify them. Staff are badly trained, appear to work such long hours that they lose interest and efficiency, and many of those those running the hotel have never experienced five star service, so think that a shoddy performance is parr

Sent from my iPad

reviews.author: Dark.Phoenix
reviews.title: Bed Bugs- Bad cleaning Service- do not go!
reviews.text:
-I stayed at the Royal Service Area.  My room smelled moldy.  When I asked room service to bring someone to clean the hot tub, they did not clean it.  I called room service 2 more times.  On the third time, I ran into the cleaning lady.  SHe didn't speak english and did not clean the tub.  Clearly The room service personnel didn't communicate 2 her my request.  She took a towels and wiped the tub, but did not disinfect it with chemicals.  

-Every time cleaning services came to my room, I noticed that they just did the bed and took the dishes away.  They did not disinfect surfaces or mop the floors, nor cleaned the tubs with disinfectant.  

-I noticed red bumps on my skin after one night.  I asked my butler to check the room for me for bed bugs.  He told me that he told the cleaning service to check 4 bugs.  However, the day after we left (yesterday), I noticed 5 red bumps in a line on my boyfriend's leg.    I immediately texted my butler and emailed the Paradisus.palma.real@melia.com.  Yicel De LA CRUZ (Guest Service Concierge) told me she forwarded the email to the Royal service, but I did not receive an email back all day today (Tuesday).  I need to know what I should do with my cloths if there is an infestation.  Also, the FUTURE GUESTS NEED TO BE INFORMED SO THAT THEY CAN CHANGE ROOMS/RESORTS.

-MY BUTLER RESPONDED QUICKER THAN MANAGEMENT DID.  HE SAID HE WILL CHECK HIMSELF WHEN HE RETURNS TO WORK THURSDAY.  I told royal service my concern before I left.  They did not contact me to reassure me.

reviews.author: pixie302009
reviews.title: Went Last September
reviews.text: My review was over the recommended number of characters so it never posted. I honestly dont want to get into details again but the stay was not good. The staff was not helpful or even nice to us, we were told multiple times with the kids we couldn't even get water at certain bars that we had to go to another one, restaurants didn't open on time, food was cold, we had booked a wine tasting and paid for it and was told we couldn't do it last minute because of a larger party, dinner reservations were made by us but never filed by staff, and on and on... will never go back.  They did give us a 5 night free stay because of our bad experience which was nice... but that was the extent of it.

reviews.author: Eugenia G
reviews.title: Pésimo
reviews.text:
El hotel es lindo, Buenas playas , comida mediocre en el buffet  (un poco mejor es  la de los restaurantes) pero lo más notable es lo poco profesional y la ineficiencia. Es sorprendente la poca capacitación que tienen.

4-5 horas para hacer el check in
5 horas para que alcancen unas toallas al cuarto
Otras 8 horas para que arreglen un problema eléctrico , luego de mucha insistencia

Hospedarse acá es un entrenamiento forzado a la paciencia.
Si quiere descansar y relajarse, no venga .

reviews.author: JayVid
reviews.title: Well built resort with poor service
reviews.text:
This is a real beautiful property on a lovely beach that is just very poorly managed like ship without a captain at the helm. Pros Of the Property 1. Beautifully landscaped property and lovely white sand beach 2. Good quality food. Especially Chef Singh And for the Cons.. 1. Poor service overall. For ex- Most times we went to the buffet for meals it was hard to find a clean empty table, hard to find cutlery. Had to go to other tables to get cutlery from there. We had people come and ask us for unused cutlery and once a guest even took a napkin and fork next to a person that was sitting at the table. If you want water or coffee at the table-good luck! 2. We went to restaurant reservation line the day we arrived and after 45 minute wait they told us that everything was full. Very condescending attitude like they were doing us a favor by letting us in to restaurants. Go to your reservation 10-15 min late and they won't let you in. Unless you're not a person of color and make some noise then they threw a few tables together to accommodate. Saw this a couple of times. 3. Spotty room housekeeping. When my wife asked the housekeep to make the bed, she complained of back pain. Took a dollar tip to get her to do it. Don't clean bathrooms or replenish towels. Made main bed but not second bed. Sofa bed was horrible. 4. When asked, Manager wasn't available for 2 days and by appointment My second stay at a Melia Hotel and so disappointing. . Between 3 families and $$$$ spent, Absolutely Thumbs down. 
I experienced that Caucasians were served and accommodated better than people of color here several times. Very sad. I hope that their management gets more involved. Ive stayed at many Riu resorts and they are run very well. With Managers effectively supervising and helping guests. Never had any of these problems there

reviews.author: ziriki
reviews.title: VACACIONES FAMILIARES DE FIN DE AÑO
reviews.text:
El hotel está bastante bien, si te gusta la arquitectura hotelera insulsa, cerca de la playa y con dos piscinas de dimensiones considerables.
Lamentablemente mi mujer y mi suegro tuvieron que volver a España por un problema familiar y, a pesar de ser una reserva directa, fueron absolutamente incapaces no solo de devolvernos el dinero de una habitación dos días, sino de tener el más mínimo detalle o atención.
La reserva de los restaurantes que no sean el buffet, por otra parte muy llano y con poca variedad, es una tarea imposible, a no ser que quieras perder tiempo de tus vacaciones discutiendo con empleados llenos de simpatía y cariño pero sin la más mínima capacidad de decisión y ejecución.
En resumen, si consigues abstraerte de la sensación de que te estan metiendo la mano en la cartera a cada paso que das, no te importa que las actividades resevadas no existan, no se hagan o se hagan una hora más tarde, si no te importa esperar el trenecito 1 hora para volver de un mall vacío de tiendas y compradores, o no te preocupa comer durante una semana lo mismo, ¡¡¡este es tu hotel!!!

Seguro que hay ofertas más interesantes en la isla.

reviews.author: Tin Hirbod
reviews.title: Very disappointed family trip.
reviews.text:
This is my first time all inclusive hotel. 
This hotel gave us very disappointing experience for all inclusive idea. 

Hotel itself is beautiful and room is nice. Some of the staffs are very friendly and good. Food at buffet are decent. 

Worst service is dinner reservation for restaurant. 
First thing I did is I tried to reserve the restaurants but no luck. So, I requested just only one night because it is my husband BD. They could not make it happen. At least they put us buffet at the Reserve. Very disappointed...
Always put you in waiting list and day of the reservation the restaurants are never available. Guest service told me walk around the restaurants and ask if they have availability. Is it a joke? 
Today is last day of the stay and still disappointed events happen. 
Beach has no towel and room has no towels too. I never had the experience with run out of the towel service at five stars hotel( that’s what they claim *****). 
If I can have negative for this hotel I will. 
I will not recommend for family vacation to this hotel. 
I will not come back again. 
We will try another hotel again so I will have a comparison.

reviews.author: mrjot005
reviews.title: Restauracja AQUA
reviews.text: To kolejny koszmar tego resortu. Kelnerzy przynoszą co innego niż zamówiłeś. I nie można tłumaczyć niezrozumieniem ponieważ władamy tak angielskim jak i hiszpańskim. Na początku popisali się idiotyzmem w postaci obowiązkowego obuwia krytego u mężczyzn. Rozumiem kiedy obowiązują długie spodnie ( tak jest na całym świecie i ja tego tez przestrzegam). Nie wpuścili gościa tylko dlatego, ze nie miał zakrytych palców u nóg. Ja miałem klapki z zakrytymi palcami i było OK! W tym hotelu idiotyzm goni idiotyzm a jedzenie w tematycznych restauracjach jest beznadziejne. Okazuje się ze najlepsze jest w restauracji z bufetem (o ironio losu).

reviews.author: D.M.
reviews.title: Do not become a member
reviews.text: Do not become a member here. They sell you on all of these exclusive benefits but it’s all a sales pitch they do not deliver on. Very poor service standard, severely declining room and food quality. Not worth all of the annual and trip fees!

reviews.author: Javier
reviews.title: te engañan con la publicidad que ofrecen
reviews.text:
Hotel demasiado caro para lo que realmente es.
A mi me vendieron que en el precio del viaje, tenía incluidos 1.000$ en golf, spa, cata de vinos y cenas privadas.
Eso es lo que me ofrecieron.
Mi intención era jugar a golf e ir al spa. Pensé, con los 1.000$ me compensa lo caro que es.
Cuando compré el paquete, escribí al hotel para cerrar el tema del golf y el spa.
Me respondieron con un mail, diciendo que solo tenía 15$ al día en golf durante 4 días para estancias superiores a 5 noches y que el spa no estaba incluido.
Es decir, solo tenía 60$.
Me sobraban 940$!!!
Cuando llegué al hotel, me dieron una habitación que olía a humedad y encontré un bicho corriendo por las sábanas. Habitación 2205.
Me cambiaron de habitación 3210 y ya no tuve problemas.
Pedí hablar con el director del hotel y me llamó una coordinadora de hoteles. Le explique el caso, con la documentación. Le explique que todas las personas que habían leído dicha oferta pensabamos lo mismo. Que había 1.000$ en bonos de gasto de golf y spa.
Esta representante de Melia me dijo que eran bonos de un 15% de los que cuesta el golf, spa, etc. Que la oferta estaba clara y que si quería me ofrecía un masaje de media hora a modo de compensación. Me negué y le expuse que estaban ofreciendo una publicidad engañosa ya que en la publicidad no se especifica que sean bonos del 15% de descuento sobre lo qu e gastas.
Se cruzó de brazos…
Me pareció que estaban engañándome a mi y todo el mundo con una publicidad engañosa, por lo que les voy a demandar judicialmente.
El personal del hotel, hasta que llegó esta señora, me daba la razón.
Dicho personal es encantador, te atienden muy amablemente y están dispuestos a lo que sea por hacerte la estancia agradable.
En cuanto al director del hotel, al cual no conocí y la susodicha coordinadora, lamentable.
Mi consejo es que se informen muy bien antes de contratar con Melia, en mi opinión tienen publicidad engañosa y abusan de la inocencia de las personas.
El hotel está bien, pero falta algo.. .
Creo que hay ofertas mucho mejores en relación calidad precio.
El personal dominicano del hotel un 10.
No recomiendo este hotel. Es mejor no viajar que alojarte aquí.
Sí lo hubiese sabido, no compro el viaje.

reviews.author: tecomento
reviews.title: Te roban de la habitación, el hotel un desastre y pésima la atención !!!
reviews.text:
Fuimos con mi familia. El primer día, en cuanto tomamos la habitación y fuimos a desayunar, le robaron a mis hijos de sus bolsos el dinero que tenían. Fue una empleada que tenía la llave de la habitación (de la genrencia nos dieron ese dato).
Pese que hicimos la denuncia correspondiente, no nos devolvieron el dinero ni hicieron nada para atender la vergonzosa actitud de inseguridad.
El hotel se ha venido abajo de lo viejo. Está lleno de cucarachas y mosquitos adentro de las habitaciones y en los restaurants.
La atención del personal no es lo que solía ser, ahora es todo con desgano, falta de interés y hasta maltrato en algunas oportunidades.
Una vergüenza que una marca como MELIA permita que esto ocurra en uno de sus hoteles. Fíjense lo mal que sus Gerentes tratan a sus huespedes... imaginen que si así el la línea directiva, cómo será lo que pasa abajo de ellos.
En pocas palabras: LADRONES + SINVERGÜEZAS = DESASTRE DE HOTEL!!!

reviews.author: jkass266
reviews.title: Family trip of 12 for a week
reviews.text: I am shocked and disappointed that after having an Hermès necklace stolen from our Suite management has determined that they will not reimburse me for it since no one admitted stealing it. Unbelievable right?

reviews.author: Daryl C
reviews.title: Poor choice.
reviews.text: Don’t expect any welcoming faces.  The people don’t seem to want to accommodate you.  They do what they have to do and don’t expect any more.  When you check in they try to have you upgrade your room and if you want a nicer beach arrangements you can have that too for extra money per day.  Now comes the best part...when you go to make reservations to eat they tell you they are all full and suggest you go to one of the restaurants that are not part of the resort and you have to pay out of pocket.  One woman was told she could go to a restaurant but they didn’t allow kids.  But what we found to be odd is when you finally get a reservation w one of the resort restaurants, they are not full.  There are empty tables.  Nice grounds but won’t be seeing us again.

reviews.author: DGO092182
reviews.title: I don’t recommend this hotel
reviews.text: I book this hotel for the reviews the I see over here,after a long research I disade to make the move and book  for family vacation wrong decision 👎 after call to find what can a room I will get they send me an email with the room specifications then when I arrive they give me a supposedly renovated room main door crack,not doors in the closet, not bathroom privacy whit two kids email back to then to get a awnser but still waiting is my first full day in the resorts and have to be here to August 31

reviews.author: Rosa P
reviews.title: Mi peor experiencia
reviews.text: Jamás vuelvo a ese Hotel, la espera, para entregar una habitación demasiado larga desde las 2 de la tarde hasta las 8 de la noche, para que te hagan la limpieza en la habitación casi hasta las 10 y porque llamaste desde la tarde, en la habitación cucarachas y también salió una del Buffet. Lo único bueno, es que los trabajadores eran simpáticos !

reviews.author: Jaime Cruz
reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: Horrible las atenciones, me hospede en la hab 5328, el aire no servia, la  comida ni podias comertele por que ni cuviertos aparecian este finde del 16 añ 18, hasta me retire del hotel al dia siguiente, la peor experiencia hotelera en mi vida, en este hotel. Muy mal

reviews.author: lda280
reviews.title: TOTAL FLOP!
reviews.text: This hotel is a joke! They sell themselves as a 5 star resort, but the service is nowhere near acceptable. Not only can you not book a restaurant for dinner (as they promise), but the therapist didn't show up for my scheduled massage. Worst of all, I was ROBBED by the staff while I was there. The security team didn't bother to help in investigating and the hotel showed no sign of courtesy, on the contrary, they accused me of doing this on purpose. The food in the buffet was disgusting - the whole family was sick! I wouldn't recommend this hotel for my worst enemy.

reviews.author: Cristian
reviews.title: DESINTERES POR EL HUESPED
reviews.text:
Somos una familia de cinco, dos adultos y tres chicos. Estábamos hospedados en las habitaciones 3423 y 3424. El primer día ya tuvimos problema con las reservas de los restaurantes ya que nos habían dicho que podíamos reservar en un mismo día para todos y cuando lo quisimos hacer nos dijeron que el sistema estaba lento y a su vez  no había lugar y nos dejaban en lista d espera (eso es = a nada) terminábamos comiendo en un buffet. Después de tanto Luchar nos reservaron en un restaurant llamado VENTOS que te daban un plato de 25 cm de diámetro con migajas de comida, UNA VERGÜENZA!  
Pero esto no termina acá de la habitación condensaba agua por las dos tomas, la de la cocina y la de la pieza empapando el piso de agua con el riesgo de que uno se levante y se caiga ya que el piso es mármol. Se llamó a atención al huésped y su respuesta fue: ESO LES PASA PORQUE APAGAN EL AIRE Y CONDENSA AGUA” esto quiere decir que si uno tenía frío en la habitación con 23 grados no  podía apagar el sistema de refrigeración ya que se inundaba todo o sino tenía que estar con campera. 
Tercer día, nos quedamos sin luz en la habitación 3423, nuevamente..... se llama a atención al huésped, vienen los técnicos desconectaron unos cables, conectaron otros y quedaron sectores del depto sin funcionar. No se volvió a llamar. El mismo día salimos a cenar, de regreso una tormenta muy fuerte nos impedía a nosotros y a otras familias llegar a sus villas ya que alguna estaban a 300 metros y más también. Luego de esperar 40 min a ver si paraba un poco de llover nadie se digno a recogernos para llevarnos a nuestras habitaciones siendo la 1:30 am. Llame a atención al huésped  para ver se nos podían recoger a los que estábamos esperando y la respuesta de ellos fue. "Los carros son descubiertos, igual se van a mojar.... y entonces??? A sacarse los zapatos, mi mujer los tacos, los chicos las zapatillas y a mojarse! quiero aclarar que no pasa por MOJARSE, pasa por el abandono al HUÉSPED. Hay más pero voy a nuestro último día. Tema gua caliente, si uno se quería bañar pasada las 00 hs o antes de las 12 am solo tenía agua tibia tirando a fría. Para esto nos habíamos levantado a las 7am  para estar bañados y listos ya que a la 10 nos pasaban a retirar para llevarnos al aeropuerto. Llamo a atención al huésped, me dice que deje la ducha abierta por diez min hasta que empiece a salir, pasaron 15 min. y vuelvo a llamar, me dicen que me mandan un técnico, pasan 30min y nadie aparece. Vuelvo a llamar y me dicen que él técnico ya había salido. Luego de 40min viene el técnico, abre la canilla de la cocina, hace un poco de circo y desaparece dejándome con agua fría. 
Conclusión: no nos pudimos duchar y nos tuvimos que ir así. A la hora de hacer el check out le preguntamos en recepción donde nos podíamos contactar con el encargado y nos dijeron que estaba en una reunión y que LAS QUEJAS SE HACÍAN VÍA TRIPADVISOR, le preguntamos el nombre a la persona de recepción y no nos lo quizo dar. 

A DESTACAR: MARIÉ Y SUS COMPAÑEROS DE ROOM SERVICE  QUE NOS AGASAJARON TODAS LAS MAÑANAS . ELLA VERDADERAMENTE SE INTERESÓ POR NOSOTROS Y HACIA HASTA DONDE PODÍA Y MÁS!

Y DE CORTESÍA POR LAS QUEJAS QUE PRESENTÁBAMOS NO DIERON DOS VINOS CON SUS RESPECTIVOS DESTAPADORES, LOS MISMOS SE DEVOLVIERON A ATENCION AL HUÉSPED YA QUE NOS PARECIÓ UNA CARGADA. 

Nos hubiese gustado que el Sr Domingo Beltré (Guest Service Manager) se hubiese contactado con nosotros para brindarnos algún tipo de solución, pero eso nunca sucedió

reviews.author: vuhienngoc
reviews.title: Bad experience in Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic
reviews.text:
should not stay in this hotel/resort. 
We stayed in this resort from July 07,2019 until July 14, 2019
Staff is friendly but food in buffet restaurant is terrible
It was extremely hard to get a reservation the same day in the restaurants, other than the buffet. We're not sure why, as the restaurants usually seemed empty.
night entertainment is good.
no coffee maker in my room
no cable TV in my room
no mini bar in the room as advertised.

reviews.author: Florencia
reviews.title: Pésima atención en los restaurantes y mal servicio de limpieza
reviews.text: He estado en una estadía de diez días y he tenido muchísimos inconvenientes con la limpieza, estuve todo un día con la habitación sin limpiar no teníamos toallas para bañarnos ni habían hecho las camas luego de estar 4/5 horas afuera de la misma, lamentable de parte de un hotel de 5 estrellas. Otro problema que tuvimos fue que en los distintos restaurantes tuvieron una pésima atención hacia nosotros desde el momento que no nos prestaban atención al tomar las órdenes, no recargaban el agua y nos servían con desdén una pena verdaderamente.

reviews.author: Maria C De Pena
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: Horrible experience. The food was cold, uncooked. I found cockroach in my room and the restaurant. The servers are friendly however the ladies dressed in black are extremely unfriendly. Reservations at the restaurant were a mess!!! The bathrooms were dirty. So many unhappy experience! I would NOT recommend.

reviews.author: jasmls12
reviews.title: July 2019 ..  hopefully updates to follow
reviews.text:
We have made this resort a regular part of our annual vacation planning over the last years and always enjoyed the property, people, food and particularly the extra amenities and services offered by the family concierge service.  

Unfortunately this year has been off to a bad start.  9 days before arrival we were informed our resort would be closed and they’ve shipped us off to another property.  They have not provided any details on the property, the rooms offered, or services offered in this new resort.  Most upsetting, the dedicated phone number and email established to address this ‘inconvenience’ all go unanswered and unreturned

With 5 days before departure now we are debating weather to roll the dice and see what we get when we arrive or cancel the vacation altogether.  

Very disappointed in the lack of professionalism (taking reservations for a property that is closed) and disrespect from this organization.

reviews.author: Daniela M
reviews.title: Não recomendo
reviews.text: Não voltaremos! Atendimento em geral muito ruim, desde a recepção até nos restaurantes, pouca atenção para com crianças e idosos! Tivemos problemas desde o check in com o quarto reservado até o último dia! Muito status e pouca qualidade de fato! Quarto limpo, hotel bem conservado, porém não vale o custo-beneficio!

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Reserve at Melia Punta Cana
reviews.text: Stay away, everything was a disappointment. We arrived only to find our trip had been down graded and wanted to move us to another area. Spent one night at the resort and the room we were given was full of both live and dead bugs crawling on the bed and all the furniture, air vent full of mold and the lovely aroma of pesticide. They eventually moved us to the Palma Real which was better but no compensation or apology for a day and a half of lost vacation.

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: I was so I'll (3 types of ECOLI)
reviews.text: I stayed at the Paradisus Reserve from June 6-9, 2019. Multiple people in our large group were very ill. On the 8th I began feeling very ill and I got progressively ill on the 9th traveling home. On the 10th, I was so sick that I had to go to the hospital. I just got my test results back which were positive for three types of ECOLI. No one seems to be able to return the travel agents call to resolve this problem. I only stayed at the resort and never left. I did not drink the water and did not drink any alcohol while there. I even used bottled water for brushing my teeth. It's clear that the safety procedures for handling food at this resort are very poor.

reviews.author: Dragon
reviews.title: Stay away, multiple illnesses
reviews.text:
My wife, young daughters and I vacationed here and regret ever going. My kids were extremely sick the entire trip... vomiting, fever, diarrhea, etc. My younger daughter remained sick for days after we got home and needed prescription meds. One of the scariest moments of my life seeing how sick she was.

Our experience, and the current headlines about DR resorts, should be enough to keep you away. But, in addition, the food was terrible. Also, mosquitoes attacked all of us and in fact, I had over 30 bites on one foot! Staff did not impress me except for one or two individuals. Most were not friendly and even argumentative. Totally miserable time. Nightmare vacation. Worst ever. And not cheap!

reviews.author: Debi H
reviews.title: We will not return to the Dominican Republic.
reviews.text: The service was very inconsistent. Vendors approach you on the beach constantly. The excursions booked through the hotel were a scam.  We enjoyed our time together as a family but will not return to the DR.

reviews.author: Don D
reviews.title: Worst Vacation Ever
reviews.text:
We have been to approx. 8 resorts and hands down this was the worst. I would not recommend going to this resort for the following reasons. 
1. Safe/lights/room card/telephone/fridge were not working when we checked in. It took 3 days to resolve all of these issues. 
2. This resort is all about up selling you. It took 45 mins to get into our room because she spent so much time going back and forth with the manager regarding up grades. In the end we paid $600.00 for them to shuttle us back and forth to another resort that had slightly better food. 
3. Staff stole my head phones. They have a turn down service which allows them to come into your room at night. This is random. It does not happen every night so I made the mistake of leaving my wireless beat headphone on the night table. They were gone when I came home that night. 
4. Food was cold, no variety. Same thing every night. Often food was burnt. Cooks would disappear for 5-8 mins at a time and create a long line up of people waiting to get food made. 
5. Buffet is the smallest I have seen out of the 8 resorts. 
6. They have a time share scam that they try to reel you into. Be careful, they say it will just be a few minutes of your time to talk about their new resort but they don't tell you what it is truly about. Thankfully we got suspicious when they had us sit down and start filling out information about our yearly salary, etc. and when we looked up people's comments, we realized it was going to be a 3 hour ordeal. 
7. No one to serve you drinks on the beach 
8. They have a tonne of people selling parasailing, jewlery, etc. which is common but at this resort there are 5X the people. In one day, I was approached by 14 people! It left me feeling uncomfortable and wary. I would spend my time avoiding them or thinking of ways to say no. They would sometimes try to guilt you out by saying they have had no sales and really need some help. 
8. I left my sweater on a chair in the lobby and within minutes is was gone and no one could tell me where it was.
