Thank God we didn’t take her up on the breakfast reservation because we later found out it was to push the timeshare that would have taken the entire morning (3 hours) and we were only there for two days/3 nights.  Here’s an idea... be honest if you want to try and get people to listen to your timeshare pitch,  don’t steal their vacation time.  Or an even better idea would be to figure out how to market it differently.

The room was clearly only cleaned in some areas and not others.  The air conditioning stayed on one freezing temperature no matter what we did to try and change it.  The shower which was dirty had one temperature of scalding hot water.  The slippers were clearly used with dirty feet prints  inside of them.  Don’t give up slippers if you don’t want to change them.  There was no hair dryer and when we went to speak to the concierge in our building she replied in a condescending manner that she would go to the room with us and show us where it was as she could not take our word for it.  When we went back to the room to prove there was no hair dryer we showed her the problem with the air conditioning and the shower.  Long story short... they never fixed the air conditioning and changed the problem with the scalding hot water in the shower to extremely low pressure with only cool water.  after that the shower was dirtier than it was when we got there and it was never cleaned during our stay.  The young lady that was the housekeeper looked miserable and never smiled even once.

If you want to eat in a restaurant for dinner... you need a reservation for all of them.  Good luck with that as we were told there were no reservations until Monday evening and we are leaving Monday morning.  After arguing about it we got a reservation for Sunday night at the Mexican restaurant for 8 PM.  Later on they did come through with a reservation for the Grill at 7 PM on Friday evening, I don’t understand why it was so difficult when there were plenty of empty tables throughout our entire dinner.  On Saturday evening upon coming back from the pool The concierge told me that she made us a reservation for the Mexican restaurant at 7 PM that night at a different restaurant at 7 PM the following night.  I told her that 7 PM is not good for us and we had already had a reservation for Sunday night at the Mexican restaurant at 8 PM.  She responded in her usual condescending manner ...saying well I changed it.  Excuse me... you didn’t pay for my trip so you should not be changing the reservation time that I made without asking me.  By the way,  there were empty tables at that restaurant as well.  The breakfast at the buffet was good but the staff seemed annoyed to get the beverages.  Last but not least, I asked the concierge if there was a bottle of wine for the room and I was told if I wanted wine in the room I needed to call  room service and they would bring me a GLASS of wine.  

I met no less than three other people waiting at the concierge desk with complaints of a similar nature during my three night stay.

On the upside... once you get away from The Reserve, and you will have to if you want to eat in a restaurant...The resort that is Paradisus Punta Cana appears very beautiful and well-maintained.  Also, there was an amazing happy guy serving drinks at The Reserve pool who came around to get your order.  They should promote him from getting drinks to being the manager of training and customer service.

Also there seem to be only kittens around... can’t help but wonder what happened to the older ones😬

This all being said, it’s a shame we stayed in The Reserve  section and not in the Paradisus section as I wouldn’t chance going back there.  Clearly the resort is mismanaged since they allow such poor customer service and lack of work ethic.

reviews.author: MKrebs
reviews.title: Worse food ever!
reviews.text: I've been in many Hotels and this is the one with the most horrible food I've ever had. I spent 5 days and the best I eaten was the Omelets. Not even the snacks were decent. I even tried 2 of the reserved restaurants and were as bad as the buffet restaurants. Paradisus Punta Cana & Paradisus The Reserve would NEVER see me there again.

reviews.author: LiveToWonder
reviews.title: Beautiful resort POORLY managed. Very disappointed!
reviews.text:
This is my very first time staying at an all inclusive resort. We stayed at the reserve, not knowing it was 15 minutes walk to the beach. Arrived on Friday for three nights. 
At the lobby we were told we got an upgrade since our room were not ready and he didn’t want to see us waiting :) there was an envelope addressed to the Johnson family in the room (maybe they didn’t like it and was passed on to us)
We wanted to maximized our staying, took a golf cart to the beach, by asking our ‘concierge’ to book for dinner, her response was ‘all the restaurants are booked for tonight and tomorrow’ REALLY??? Where can we eat?? Buffet. I said to her ‘It was a girls weekend and we paid a lot of money for an all incluye resort to eat buffet every night?’ She kept apologizing and mentioned the Italian and the hibachi were under construction, ok miss concierge there are 5 others!!! She finally gave us one for our first at the Grill.
The food was good, the restaurant was kind of empty, they could definitely sit more parties of two. 
Our first night back to the room, the AC was too cold for us, no hair dryer and the water in he shower was boiling hot. I called reception at 10 and was told someone will come in to help, I call three times more at 11, no answer, I ended up calling room service and finally was connected to the lobby and same thing... no one ever came. 
The very next day I asked my concierge to take care of these problems, the AC was never fixed till we left, the shower water got cold instead of warm. They sent us a drier. Oh... we got USED, DIRTY slippers. 
THIS IS ONE BEAUTIFUL NICE RESORT, well kept LANDSCAPE. But the people who work there are not friendly nor helpful and looking for tips at all time. 
I was told by the staff at the pool, the resort closes 3-4 restaurants when guests capacity is light. Buffet everyday....
I definitely advise travelers, if you want quality DO NOT pick this resort it’s a big disappointment.

reviews.author: jmk9911
reviews.title: HORRIBLE FOOD POISONING
reviews.text: Be advised I spent the last two days of my trip puking out of both ends. I couldn't leave the bed. The resort offered no apologies but said " they'd arrange transportation to a doctor" I wouldn't stay here for free. Customer service is atrocious. I contracted food poisoning from The grill restaurant.

reviews.author: CJ P
reviews.title: Absolutely horrible honeymoon experience!
reviews.text:
There were very few positive things to say on our honeymoon to this resort.

We were fooled when we arrived during the middle of the night and were greeted by Felipe who was very friendly and made us feel very welcomed. We then ordered room service and it came within 10 minutes (awesome). Anytime after that it took 35-40 minutes. We slept most of the next day since we got in so late. Once we woke up we went to go eat at the lunch buffet. The staff did not seem very welcoming and when you speak English they seem to have a "get your stuff and go" type of attitude. Of course from that point on I tried to speak as much Spanish as possible, but I am Greek/American and my Spanish is very limited. But then the times I did try to speak Spanish they seemed very delighted until they realized when they spoke so fast I looked lost and then the delighted look turned to a disappointed to have to deal with me look.

Don't get me wrong, some of the staff was very friendly and seemed genuinely happy to help you, but most of them were not. We went to the Casino a couple of times and Juan J Baez (bartender) was awesome! He was very friendly and even though we had a language barrier, we would pass our translator back and forth to communicate and laugh with eachother. The rest of the staff at the casino were very unfriendly. We tried to laugh and joke with them but they wouldn't even crack a smile. It was very uncomfortable and unenjoyable.

Anytime we would go to the front desk outside and ask questions they would just say a couple of words but not really answer our questions or point in a general direction and not really tell us where or just shrug their shoulders and disregard us but not try to find someone to assist us.

One day we went to the lobby and they had Frankelley come talk to us about resort coupons. He said we could go have a very nice breakfast at one of their other properties and get a coupon book if we just go take a look at the newest resort they will be opening "Circle". As a thank you for going to look at it, we would get a free breakfast and coupons to use at the resort. DO NOT FALL FOR THIS! We got there and our host took us to get the breakfast and showed us the new resort in progress then took us to another area where another gentleman showed up and they started talking about a TYPE of timeshare. So we got stuck there for half a day which was such a waste as we only had 5 days, but we lost one day due to our flight being delayed, a second day lost due to exhaustion from the delayed flight, and then this one. Not to mention, on the ride back we asked one of the guys from the resort how to get to Plaza Bavaro to go shopping and instead he said he would have us taken to a private store which was supposedly especially for the "resort guests" (owned by his cousin, but we didn't know) because they "are not aggressive" and we could shop comfortably and safely (a lie). I can't tell you how many times the price changed on the items were were interested in, until we finally said," either you tell us how much just this one item is or we leave with nothing."  They asked us how much we had with us to take all the other items that we had selected (like we are going to tell them how much money we are carrying on us). We finally ended up only getting two items which we were over charged for but we just wanted to get out. I was trying to rush us out because I could tell my husband was getting very upset. On the way back to the resort we passed by Plaza Bavaro and all the tourists seemed to be stress free unlike us, but my husband did not want to stop because he was so mad. So we really only had 2 days for our honeymoon which we couldn't enjoy because we got extremely sick to our stomachs and still are.

Then comes the worst part of our stay. We got up early in the morning to go to Monkey Land. I had locked my purse in our suitcase after counting the money inside that we saved to pay for our trip on my husband's credit card (5 $100 bills). When we got back from Monkey Land we went back to our room to relax for a little bit and change our clothes to go to the pool. I counted the money again and it was all still there (5 $100 bills). After the pool we came back and changed to go get dinner at around 6:30pm (counted the money again and still had 5 $100 bills) only this time, my husband forgot to put my purse back in the suitcase and left the suitcase and my purse on the bed. When we came back he stated that someone had been in the room and left us 2 chocolates on the bed. I had a bad feeling and walked into where our bed was and saw my purse sitting on the bed. I asked him if he had left it out. He said yes since housekeeping had already come (around 4pm) he figured it would be okay. I had a really bad feeling and opened the zipper pocket where I had stored the money. When I counted it there was now only 3 $100 bills. We called security and they came to the room to do a report. Our concierge that night was great in trying to console me as I was sobbing and I wish I could remember his name to mention how great he was, but I was so stressed out that I didn't remember. When they scanned the lock to see who else accessed our room they said "Monica" came in at 8pm to do the turn down service which nothing was done except for chocolates on our bed. Our trash can was still full in the sitting area. Well, those two chocolates on our bed apparently cost us $200. After they took our report they said they would investigate and call us in the morning. At 9am we woke up and still had not heard anything from them so we called. They said they will investigate and call us back. At 10:00 we were eating breakfast we went to the front desk and asked again. They then had a man come out and he said,"we questioned her and she says she didn't take it. This is the first complaint on her." Well, yeah, I don't know anyone who would say they stole something if asked and there is no video evidence. Plus, she was sneaky and only took $200 instead of all $500, probably in hopes that we wouldn't notice until it was too late (back home). The money didn't unzip itself from my purse and walk off. She was the only one in the room after we left. We even gave exact times that matched up with what they reviewed upon scanning the access log. Yet we are the ones who are out $200 and she gets away with theft. They said we should have used the safe and just shrugged their shoulders and basically just want us to forget it ever happened.  Our money was there everytime we counted it when we would leave and come back until that one time and she had been the only one in our room after the last time we checked and they confirmed it by checking the access log on the door lock. 

Do yourself a favor and try to find somewhere else to stay. We promised ourselves we will never go back there again. The property itself is absolutely stunning and some of the staff are stellar, but trust me, don't judge a book by its cover!

reviews.author: Wanderlust
reviews.title: Paradisus Lost
reviews.text:
It’s taken me a few months to recover and then reflect on my “vacation” at this resort.  I wanted to give it some time so that this writing and the attached photographs clearly reflect my experience.  Overall, the experience was a failure on the Melia brand - which purports to be luxurious,  but was at best ordinary, and at worst shabby. 

Upon our arrival, we were housed in the Reserve - despite requesting a beach-front room.  (This part of the complex is for families - not for a recently married couple.). Needless to say, I wanted some romance - and this area was the opposite of romantic.  

Upon finally moving us to a room near the beach, the issues continued.  The beach had non-stop hawkers of their wares all day.  

There was no one working at the resort to bring us a drink, but there was always someone telling us what a great and happy couple we were - and then to try to upsell us a time-share.  

The roads we walked on were literally crumbling.  

The “butler” assigned to us was not capable of doing the one thing we asked - get us a dinner reservation. (And, p.s. why is it so impossible to get a dinner reservation?  We are two people and were pretty flexible with times and restaurant preferences.)

The door fell apart and we wasted more valuable vacation time waiting for them to fix it and waited to get into our room. 

We made countless calls to get our air conditioning to work as it constantly went off without rhyme or reason.

The tiles surrounding our hot tub had big cracks in them and would have been dangerous had we touched them.  

Paint was splattered and messy.  

In sum: 

Food = tolerable - nothing special and some restaurants were so bad that I put down my fork after one bite and leave. 

Beach = pretty - but ruined by hawkers.

Pool = wet.

My advice:  

Take your vacation days and budget and choose somewhere else.

reviews.author: rx r
reviews.title: Never again.
reviews.text:
Travel date 9/30/18 to 10/7/18; room 2407 and 2408. 
I am disgusted by my recent visit to the reserve at paradisus Punta Cana. My child had a seizure experience requiring medical services. The resort "doctor" they sent to our room was no more than a poor medic with zero interest in the well being of a 7 year old child. The medical services on site is provided by HOSPITEN;medical provider who operates clinics and onsite resort medical services. The shady doctor with zero interest in patient care required a sick child to wait for medical services so that he had time to fill out paper work and setup billing. He than had us take a 30 min taxi ride to his company (HOSPITEN) clinic that took over an hour ride due to weekend local traffic. Overall the total cost for limited medical services cost 2500 us dollars. What makes me disgusted is the fact that there were other medical clinics 5 to 10 min from the resort. SHAME to you the resort doctor and the Resort for allowing your guests to receive such poor medical care. 
Both children are diagnosed with hand foot and mouth disease with severe blistering. I will never again return to your resort or any other MELIA property. I would strongly advise to other travels be aware of unscrupulous medical provider and services when traveling to Punta cana.

reviews.author: Parvin V
reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.text:
As an experienced travel agent who has familiarized myself with many Caribbean all-inclusives, I would rate this resort a 0-star.

Beginning with the lack of hospitality at check-in, and waiting 4-5 hours for our room, not only did we not feel welcomed but the people with family and the elderly didn't get their rooms quickly upon arrival. We requested multiple times in advance in email to be upgraded to better rooms but no one acknowledged it.

Its a beautiful resort but lots of walking, and there are no snackbars around besides the bars which weren't 24/7. It would take lots of time (like an hour) to go to your room, change, and go to the buffet (there was only one) to eat.

The food in the buffet was nothing special, and the a la carte restaurant reservations took few hours if you were lucky enough to get one. Once there, you had to wait 2-3 hours to get your food that you will just end up at the buffet tired and hungry.

Refrigerators in the rooms was never full unless you asked them. I had to ask for soap in my room. No small hand towels. The shower head was broken and would always fall.

There wasn't any entertainment besides one or two nights at the resort. 

I don't recommend this resort to anyone (which was overpriced to begin with) for a good vacation. I didn't really feel that we were on vacation. Their marketing is very misleading. 

PS the sunwings representative was never present and the bus to leave to the airport for our flight was a disaster.

reviews.author: Nima S
reviews.title: Worse service I have ever seen for a 5 star
reviews.text:
Went there September 4th-One hour wait for check ins, my bed was wet the first night, no hot water for the shower the entire week, water wouldn’t drain in the shower, asked for towels took longer then an hour, no smiles from staff. Buffet had the same food lunch and dinner everyday all day, pizza was good. One night I went to the bar @ 2:05 needed a drink but the bartender said can’t serve you cause bar closes at 2, hospitality nightmare. 
I know this is not in their control but the ocean looked like a swap from seaweed.
Save yourself money and go to Chic Punta Cana and get the vacation of your life.

reviews.author: Arshia G
reviews.title: Would not recommend it
reviews.text:
This is place was terrible... it took us 3 hours to check into our rooms, the mattresses were dirty, fridge were never stocked and upon ordering drinks for the fridge, they would only bring max 4 beers and waters at a time.... food was terrible, the service was slow, the majority of the staff were unfriendly... the oceanfront was covered in seaweed. The only positive aspect of this hotel was the cleanliness of the lobby and pool areas. 

Amongst our group, a few people had items stollen from their room. 

Do not come here.

reviews.author: nimahomayouni
reviews.title: WORST RESORT IN PUNTA CANA! DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME!
reviews.text:
We came to this resort with high expectations, my wife and I booked the Royal Service Ocean front. We came for my brother's wedding. We came with over 100 guests, and was expecting a high end experience, but instead came to the resort from hell. 
Let me point out all the issues:
1. Our room had a wet mattress, the door handle was broken, the ocean front smelt like someone forgot to flush the toilet in a public washroom. The safe did not work. Our luggage took over 2 hours to get to our room, the room smelt like mold, the fridge was never filled up.
2. The staff, oh my goodness, I have never encountered such rude and cheap behavior from the staff. Every two seconds all they would ask for, TIP, TIP, TIP. Well I love tipping, but you need to give me service for a tip, not just keep asking. It was so annoying. I was going crazy.
3. The wedding, we booked the beach terrace, which was close to Gabi Beach, but that same night, there were two other big parties, where our dj had to put the music to full blast, but it was still not loud enough to hear, as the other two parties were putting their music to full blast. The buffet at the wedding was worse than a 1 star restaurant. I didn't touch anything, and if fact the food in the whole resort was so bad, I actually lost 9 pounds when I came back to Canada.
4. The excursion team, who would book our excursions, were the most unfriendly cheap people. They kept trying to overcharge us for our excursions. That's when I decided to book directly with the company, instead of using these middle men to book with. Once again, all they would ask for was TIP TIP TIP. Oh my goodness!!
5. The bars would actually hide bottles and say they were out of the bottle. Especially with Black Label. They would say they are out, when I can clearly see from the mirror behind them, that there were bottles under them. LIARS!!
6. The Manager Domingo, worst hotel manager ever! I will be contacting Melia Head office for this. He is a complete Liar! Need I say more!
7. No one at this place spoke English! All they knew how to say was TIP TIP TIP. Well how about you give me my royal service I was promised, and sure I will tip.
8.My family was so embarrassed for our 100 guests, and all we were doing was calming them down.
9. I have never gotten into so many fights with staff in my life.

I will never ever ever ever book any Melia resort again! All they care about is money in their pockets, and treat guests like garbage! 

Not to mention having to calm down my brother, mother and father ever two minutes.
After over 6 months of research to find the right place for my brother to get married, we stumbled upon what we thought would be the best place for a destination wedding. But instead I felt Hell would be more luxury than this place!

DO NOT GO TO THIS PLACE!! I URGE EVERYONE THINKING OF GOING HERE, YOU ARE IN FOR A SPECIAL TREAT!!!

reviews.author: Arash
reviews.title: Terrible place ! Stay away - not a 5 star resort...
reviews.text:
The good: The grounds are nice and maintained well. The bad: everything else! 

Bad experience started with checking. We had to wait hours. Half the day was wasted. They are very unorganized and inefficient at taking people in. 

The beach is unusable. There is seaweed all over the beach and in the water. It smells disgusting, you cannot even go near the water. You could even smell it inside the resort! We went to other beaches outside of the resort and they did not have this problem.....

The rooms are dated. Some of the rooms smelled. Some were wet. Beds are terrible. Definitely not 5 star worthy. Also the bathroom and shower has glass doors so you can see others inside from the room.

The food was a joke. Same crap every day. Restaurants were even worst. Be prepared to eat garbage all week. They would not give us reservations for restaurants even though they were not busy, we walked in on a couple of them and they had many tables and seats empty, just didn't want to serve their customers! 

Service could not be any worst. The staff are all angry, rude, most don't even speak basic English. Even for a big tipper the service was just unacceptable. 

Excursions - the activities desk inside the actual resort scammed our group and refused to provide any refund. We did some excursions outside of the resort and those went well.

We also had a wedding and some group events that were ruined with poor planning, there was a corporate group that interfered with ours.  

There is construction going on in parts of the resort, including the front entrance. We could hear construction in the room at times. 

The exchange rate at the desk was ridiculous. They charged a 30% fee. What a joke!

The Casino which is a just small room with 2 tables is 100% rigged. Specially the black jack table. We caught the dealers CHEATING multiple times, which resulted in a fight and us leaving the Casino and never returning. 

Multiple people got ear infections from the poor water.

The whole place was pretty much dead and we still received poor service and quality. Don't want to imagine how much worst it is during busier times. 

Stay away this place is not worth the money they are charging. Seriously.

reviews.author: Sam B
reviews.title: Worst Experience Of A Hotel Ever
reviews.text: Worst resort experience I've ever had in my life. To start they gave me the wrong room twice they wanted me to initially sleep on a rolling bed for a week then they gave me a double room which smelled like paint after a night of sleeping in that and hours of going back and forth they gave us the royal service room. There is nothing special about that room at all couldn't order fresh juices didn't bring me liquor at night and to top it all off a lot of us got sick from the late night hamburgers that we ordered I guess they left it out all day and fed it to us. Apart from that they only had one buffet which was the same food over and over and the quality was far from decent and all the restraints were booked and the food wasn't even good when you got there. The service was horrible they just look at you and smile and not even ask what the problem is or try to help they just want more money from you and walk away. if you want a cab to go somewhere Make sure not to use them they will charge you 10 times the price that it actually cost overalll there is nothing positive that I can say about this resort except it looks nice but that docent cut it for a quick summary for you guys. FOOOD BAD SERVICE BAD DRINKS BAD SCAMMERS ALOT OF wouldn't reccomend people to go here save yourself the time and look for anotherr resort in Dominican. only thing that made it bearable was the 100 friends that came out for the wedding the rest was garbage.

reviews.author: Soheil A
reviews.title: Horrible Place, Do not go
reviews.text: From the moment we got there to the moment we left it was nothing but disappointment after disappointment.  First of when we got there it took them about 4 hours for them to get us a room, ok sure it happens, but it kept getting worse, the beds were moist, the place was a mess and had to get room service to come clean up immediately.  The staff and management was absolutely horrible, rude and inattentive. All the arrangements for the wedding were flawed with no remorse from the staff.  They purposely would turn up their music when we were having our wedding party which was planned waaaaay in advanced and yet we were blamed for it all and management told us we had to keep it down not the other party that just popped up out of no where.  I'm 100% sure the staff was making fun of us in Spanish as we had some people in our party who spoke spanish and hey I also understand some Spanish insults myself.  The casino, wow now that another story, the rules of blackjack seemed to change on a daily basis and everywhere I went i was harassed by some guy trying to sell me necklaces or rings and would not take No as an answer. Food was horrible, either over cooked or under cooked and extremely slow service, I could finish my whole meal before I could get a drink. All the excursions were scams and we were constantly being lied to, for example they would tell us speed boating for 2 hours but it was actually snorkelling for an hour and speed boating for 20 minutes, which most of the boats broke down in the middle of the water and barely got to drive them. It seemed like everyone was just lying to us to get an extra dollar out of us, we booked a yacht party and they tried to give us another broken down boat that wouldn't even fit our 57 people and had to challenge them for about 30 minutes before they gave us the yacht we had initially paid for.  Ive been to many resorts all around the world including this which was my third time in Punta Cana and i can tell you if it wasn't for the group of people I was with, I would have cut my vacation short and left by the third day and this was the worst resort I have ever been to...PPFFFT 5 stars, yea right

reviews.author: Antonio M
reviews.title: Paradissus 5 day stay aug /2018
reviews.text: Royal services inefficient ,frustating, misleading and deceiving.Advertised as 5 stars resort is far from it.Food quality and choices substandard for 5 stars; getting reservations for the restaurants a challenge,drinks included only three beers budweisser,corona and stella,no Presidente in bottle,only one scotch,included wine undrinkable, we booked 12 rooms ; two rooms tv didnt work ,one room sofa bed broken and water leakage in shower light ;one room safe broken ty and had to complaint twice about music from discotheque being to loud at 3am;one room had to call security twice for loud noise.The one thousand credit for use in the resort is worthless , a gimmick to make you use paid services.

reviews.author: Marcootz
reviews.title: Absolutely Trash, Do Not Recommend
reviews.text: This place is trash, DO NOT believe all those 5 star reviews,  I have been to Dominican and surrounding countries many, many times before, and have never experienced a resort like this before.  In short the Paradisus Punta Cana is extremely overpriced provides horrible service and garbage quality/selection of food.  Specifically this whole resort is setup to hustle you out of every dollar, everything is extremely overpriced here, the staff are very unfriendly, miserable or just rude to you, buffet food is all just recycled crap day after day after day with no variety, restaurants are even worse, the excursions are extremely overpriced and just horrible experiences (broken equipment or lie about amt of time or what/where they take you).  The room was older but tolerable however they didn't get that right until the third try, so about the only thing i actually did like were the aesthetics/layout of the place but the experience was so bad it completely takes away from that.  I don't like to complain, but the way we were treated and experience I had over the course of the week there it has to be said, even if i turn 1 person away from this place I've done my part.  If your dead set on going to Dominican try the Hard rock, i have stayed there before and it was much better, otherwise go to Mexico and save yourself the disappointment

reviews.author: Frank J
reviews.title: Paradisus palma real crap
reviews.text:
Arrived on Sept 6. Waited an hour for check in, and got to room was a mess waited another 2 hours for them to clean the room. Went to restaurants waited an hour just to be served. The service was horrible in the buffet looked like they didn't even want to be there. One chef was always angry with guest. The beach was never cleaned of the sea weed on it, yet all the resorts we cleaned. Not enough staff to cater to everyone. Yet one bartender "Fernando" and always had a smile on his face and took care of all 95 of us. We thank you Fernando at the walk up pool bar.

I would never come to this resort ever again.

reviews.author: Cecilia S
reviews.title: RESTAURANTE OLIO, malo malo
reviews.text:
Hoy cenamos en el restaurante  Olió, primera vez que cenamos acá y lamentablemente debo decir que fue todo malo. 
La reserva la teníamos a las 20:30, nos hicieron pasar a la mesa a las 21 hrs. Nadie nos indicó que la entrada era buffet y debíamos ir por ella, nos trajeron nuestros platos a las 21:40, fueron 4 platos y todos regular a malo. 
Mi pato en particular milanesa con una ensalada de hojas verdes y no se que mas... Bueno la milanesa regular y venia 1 hoja de lechuga sin aliño. 
A los demás acompañantes que habían pedidos pastas les ofrecieron queso parmesano cuando estaban terminando sus platos. 
La verdad todo muy mal!!! Para no volver.

reviews.author: OxC
reviews.title: Оценка 0
reviews.text:
Отдыхали с семьей в прошлом октябре. Из плюсов: хорошая уборка и игровая для детей. Дальше одни минусы:

- сам резерв не стоит своих денег: старые номера, далеко от пляжа, еда в буфете такая же как и в обычном.

- русскоговорящая сотрудница Виолетта сказала члену нашей семьи сколько дать на чай бэлбою (ее слова « дай на чай папу долларов») Во-первых в ее указаниях никто не нуждался, а во вторых, это уровень хостела, а не пятерки. А также при разговоре, с другими русскими туристами, выяснилось, что Виолетта не всем объясняла как забронировать рестораны которые входят в стоимость, но необходим резерв. 

- пляж был с огроменный кучами водорослей, которые никто не чистил вообще.

- Кульминацией был разговор с замом генерального мэнеджера по-поводу дрели во время обеда в буфете резерва. Женщина вела себя непрофессионально, не могла толком объяснить почему нельзя остановить ремонтные работы во время обеда. Абсолютно неадекватное поведение, которое не соответствует занимаемой должности.

Ко всему прочему хочу добавить, что сами цены на резерв меняются часто при это на сайте указывается что «осталось 2 номера» и т. д. Мы забронировали номера за несколько месяцев по спец цене и наличие номеров было лимитировано. Через какое-то время эти же номера стоили в 3 раза дешевле и тоже с надписью «спец предложение, осталось 2 номера». 
Менеджеры отеля пытались откровенно втюхать какие-то программы мелиии. 
Как резюме: непрофессионая работа менеджмента, непонятная система ценника на номер.

reviews.author: carlos c
reviews.title: Terrible!!! Do not book here!
reviews.text:
Not sure where to start, several irregularities with this resort. But in summary: Terrible customer service, lack of empathy, and POOR Management!

The resort grounds are beautiful. However, the rooms are dated.

There was a party of 30 guests, I booked a two connected suites for my family in order to have my children close to us. They booked them on a different room, far apart; when we questioned the front desk, they did not care and said there was none available. When asked for a manager they finally admitted they had them available but an extra charge. 

They will not accommodate us, even after showing paperwork reflecting the two connected rooms were booked originally.
The front desk manager did not care at all!
Our first experience on lunch time at the buffet, hostess were rude, food was very mediocre and there was a mouse in the bathroom!!!
Cheese and food was kept at a low temperature.

6 people out of 30 got sick and one ended up in the hospital (Food poisoning).

The Resort has a medical office that do not carry the basic emergency items, no IV, no pedialyte, etc. Their business model, pay $275.00 for a visit, they cannot treat you but will refer you to a hospital. They did not care that people got sick because of their food, $2,000 spent after spending a day on the hospital.

PLEASE DO NOT BOOK HERE!!!!!

reviews.author: davida7979
reviews.title: Didn’t live up to the hype!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the reserve for 4 nights and 5 days. The resort is beautiful but it fell short on the overall. The food was ok, the best meal was Aqua. Be aware the main pools are very deep for a resort pool and nerve racking for parents, make sure to bring a float. We booked the family concierge one bedroom suite. When we checked in our concierge was suppose to meet us but he didn’t. After we unpacked we had to request multiple times for him. The concierge utilize an app to text and communicate with the guest which I will say was nice however our concierge didn’t always fulfill our request. We had asked for multiple things that didn’t get done and when I spoke to him about it he got snippy. 

Our room was nice but we had a hard time getting our room cleaned. We were out of our room by 9am and didn’t return until 4 and it still never got done. We had requested multiple times to have our room cleaned and it only got cleaned once on the last day.

Needless to say we won’t be returning.

reviews.author: Cary G
reviews.title: Paradises Palma Real resort, Punta Cana, DR
reviews.text: Very poor resort.    Poor service, terrible rooms, mediocre food.  Room infested with mosquitoes, took three days to get a wash cloth.  Closet space practically nonexistent.   Water is not drinkable.    I have a long list of problems with this place.   Not recommended.

reviews.author: Bigdog528
reviews.title: Expectations not met and yours probably won't be either
reviews.text: Grounds are beautiful, that's the end of the positives. We stayed in Royal Service Suites July 22-27, 2018. The rooms are rather dated. The 1st morning when we awoke, there was a huge Palmetto bug the size of my thumb on the night stand next to our bed. I had to flip it into the jacuzzi tub and push it down the drain with an umbrella. The reason they don't post ANY of the restaurants menus online is because there aren't many choices above  a buffet level cuisine with the exception of Rare. Even Royal Service exclusive Palazzo had mini portions and ingredients as fillers not mentioned within the menu items. So we couldn't eat, actually ate a bag of Doritos for dinner one night. Then the all inclusive bars, where do I begin. No one waits on you anywhere outside the bar tops, no one bringing drinks around the Adults Only pool even. You have to go to a bar to order, minimal amount of alcohol in a small paper cup is what you get served. Oh, did I mention the grounds are beautiful? Butler service, they make all of your dinner reservations in advance for your entire stay and you can't get into a restaurant without a reservation. So you are stuck with going to the restaurant your butler made reservations for without ever asking where or what you want to eat. THEN, there were 8 of us, 7 out of 8 became ill on the 2nd day, vomiting and diarrhea, some continued when we got home and the doctor said we got food poisoning. Probably from the little child that was walking along the buffet tasting things and then not liking them and putting them back or some other way. Do not drink the water. only drink  from a sealed bottle of water, before they serve you water from a pitcher at every restaurant. I probably have more issues but I don't want to rant on and on. 4 Royal Service Suites, 8 adults trying to have an enjoyable get away, what a waste of money and a total depression.

reviews.author: paulopM5632FK
reviews.title: BRASILEIROS FUJAM DE LÁ!!!
reviews.text: O resort apresenta apenas 03 pontos fortes: academia, silencio a noite e estrutura externa luxuosa. Suites com diversos problemas recorrentes!!! Funcionários educados, mas querem receber gorjeta para te atender bem. Alguns funcionários são irônicos e chegam a fazer cantadas baratas as Brasileiras. All inclusive regrado!! escondem alguns tipos de alimentos. Bebidas que deveriam ser servidas quentes estão frias e as frias quentes. Faltam opções de alimentos. Pude fazer a comparação pq fiquei 7 dias neste resort e 5 dias no Riu Palace Bavaro que além de mais em conta observei que os funcionários são mais educados, a alimentação como o café está diponível a vontade, alimentação no Riu é mil vezes melhor. Caso queiram conhecer punta cana vão ao Riu Palace Bavaro que até a praia é mais linda!!! Pode perguntar que tiro todas as duvidas..

reviews.author: timswiftrealtor
reviews.title: Book elsewhere, don't upgrade not worth it
reviews.text: The pictures looked great, the reviews were mixed - no we know why.  It's a dated resort - 20 years old and ready to close and be torn down by reports on site.  We upgraded expecting "Royal Service" - an assigned butler - gave us a phone to contact - so old I phone that is useless to say the least.  Response time poor, getting dinner reservations at times requested - no advantage.  Food quality fair - The steak house - worse meal so far - plate arrive with a slab of meat and 4 slices of steamed veggies (2 eggplant).  My partners meal wasn't even what he order and waitress could not comprehend simple English.  Feel more disappointed by the day - here till Saturday.....Our Advice - choose a different property, cancel your reservations and pick differently.  Rooms are clean, if you want all you can eat and drink and don't care (or know) about quality - by all means come on down.  Staff are good but need to be followed up on to get anything done.  Our expectations were high and now disappointed. An expensive lesson.  Don't make the same mistake.  People from the midwest seem to be enjoying themselves. The ocean was inaccessible the first three days due to piles of seaweed on the beach

reviews.author: shotka33
reviews.title: The service is awful!!!
reviews.text:
Don’t get scammed by paying extra for the royal service you don’t get anything extra. First off we get there and our room is not ready for over 2.5 hours. Check in is supposed to be at 3 we did not get checked in till after 5:30. We check in and are told if we upgrade to the “royal service” we would get a kid free section, premium drinks, fresh fruit drinks, pool service..... blah blah blah. We paid the extra $300 and got nothing. My husband made a memo that it was my birthday when making the reservation also told the women that originally showed us around the resort also guest services and the man that brought our suitcase up and no balloons were put on my door. It is impossible to get dinner reservations anywhere even though you walk into the restaurants and they are completely empty. I asked to exchange a dirty wet towel at the pool and the guy told me he only had a couple towels left and refused to exchange my towel. The waiters would drop food on the floor while taking your plates and not bother to pick it up. Room service came to our room at 10:30 at night to clean. Lights would do off in the room for no reason. Hot water would not work the phone did not work. I asked for a coconut and was told to come bad the next day or pay $5 🤔 I thought I already paid an extra $300 for the “royal services”. We complained to guest service, the manager (that was either not there or in a meeting everytime) and the women that was supposed to be assigned to help us and got nowhere. We were only there for two full days thankfully (4 days three nights). Huge disappointment I felt so bad my husband tried to do something nice for my birthday and it was the worst vacation ever. The hotel is beautiful but the way they treat their guest is aweful. We finally spoke to a manager upon checkout and he said that their was nothing he could do and we should of complained earlier! We did complain earlier no one cared!!!! He told us to take it up with the company we booked through and maybe they would do something or they could upgrade us the next time we came. I would not even go back to this place if it was free. We both got sick from the food and the service sucked out of everyone that worked there maybe one or two workers were pleasant and helpful. 
BTW the section they reserved for royal service which is supposed to be kid free is not enforced anyone can go, if they are kids or did not pay for the upgrade. We decided on this hotel because of the wonderful reviews we read yet anyone we spoke to that were guest all had the same feeling we did about the food the service and the hotel!

reviews.author: Lina G
reviews.title: Stay away from it.
reviews.text:
Nothing works, no maned management, for my surprise it changed a lot from 7 years ago.
Lack of maintenance, lack of refreshment in the refrigerator.
Pool bar is very slow, pool bathroom is dirty and the door was broken.

reviews.author: Bianca F
reviews.title: No vale lo que cuesta
reviews.text:
Señores,

Este hotel no vale lo que cuesta. La calidad dw la comida es terrible. Los restaurantes malos, las habitaciones viejas.
La variedad del Snack bar es super pobre, no hay coffee shop!

Mi familia vino de viaje, creyendo que iban a un buen hotel, y ha sido una decepción total, para acceder a "un mejor servicio" hay que contratar el royal que de por si es aun mas caro.

El hotel es viejo, no se los recomiendo!

Realmenre

El B

reviews.author: Markitoss4
reviews.title: Nightmare in Paradisus
reviews.text:
There is no point in spending all this money, you can go to a cheaper resort and get better service and amenities. Maybe something will work over there. We have been to Punta Cana resort multiple times, however this was our first time in the Palma Real Resort. The first day was a living nightmare. Shout out to Marielle, and Aura for never responding back to our texts, after they told us to call them if we had problems but did nothing but lie and deceive us by never responding and making up stories.  At check in we weren't given enough towel keys for the family. Likewise, on our way to the rooms we were greeted by a nonfunctioning room key (many people that we have talked to say the same thing). We keep telling them about it and all they do is come open the door for us, rather than fix the problem. They claim they fired their head engineer, but every other staff member we ask has never heard about that. Our other family members consisted with the same issue. Once we entered the room we "loved" the TV from the 1940's, completely open bathroom area so everyone could see you use the restroom, nonfunctioning toilet handle, and completely useless safe. As we waited THREE hours for our bags, we were fed up and went to go talk to them as we wanted our stuff. They claimed that we never gave them the room number, but they took our bags before we were even given it. Restaurants were terrible, such as Olio, Aqua, Brisas, and the Buffet. 

Olio: A supposed, Authentic Italian dinner. Filled with nothing but greasy food and bad staff, and the driest salmon ever. The salmon was so dry, I was ready to put some moisturizer on it. The appetizers were decent but nothing Italian, along with waiting an hour to get a drink, you’ll be lucky if they ask what you want to drink. There is nothing authentic about the food as it is almost contaminated with butter and hoarded with Bacon. Desert was hard as a rock, as I believe it was just a simple cookie. They told us it would be impossible to get a table at 7, but it remained empty throughout the night.
Brisas: They told us it would be impossible to get a table at 7:30, but it remained close to empty throughout the night, as we were the only family there. The guy recommended to order four plates of everything as it would be quicker. Guess what, it wasn’t. We were their almost all night, for hours waiting for the food. At the end of the night we weren’t brought half the plates. Overall the food was decent, and the guy never brought us water. Just prepare for the wait of your life.
Aqua: It’s pretty bad when a waiter is recommending you not to order certain things, that’s how you know the food is terrible. A restaurant in the reserve that claimed to be the best and the fanciest. However, many people were seen in shorts and t-shirts. They easily lacked staff, and since the kitchen was clear, you could see only 3-4 people working the large restaurant. The man never asked for drinks and took nearly 35 minutes to ask what we wanted to eat. The bread was hard and inedible, and so was half the items on the menu (it is the most complicated menu I have ever seen). DO NOT ORDER THE FALAFFEL, IT IS ABSOLUTLEY DISGUSTING AND NOT COOKED. Burger wasn't even cooked well, and the food lacked major flavor. The staff was even worse, as they were the most lost people at the resort. They have no respect for allergies, as someone asked if the fish came with bacon and he said no. However, the fish was covered with pieces of bacon. Ruddy, he was amazing. But besides him, staff was rude and poorly trained. There are random candles all over the table, that don’t even turn on.

Buffet: The buffet is the SAME THING EVERY SINGLE DAY. Sushi which is somewhat alright. They make the weirdest rolls. Chicken rolls, spicy chicken rolls. They have an obsession with chicken.   Bread is always hard, and the food always just doesn’t taste right. The consistency kills me. The fruit is never cut right, and people hoard the mango like they have never eaten it. The pasta is drowned in butter, the bakery people never hear you, and there is a major problem with people hoarding food, it isn’t even that good though. The eggs are always cold and watery. Getting a table is kind of hard for big groups. Get prepared to sweat to death and never get poured a refill of water, and you need a treasure map to find utensils.
Random Stories: At the buffet, a very drunk girl in her late twenties was trying to climb over the extremely high wall, putting those around her in danger if the platform fell. The staff watched her and didn’t say anything at all. Than she came to our table and said some rude things. How could the staff not say anything? 
One of our family members was awaken at seven in the morning by the sound of construction and drills, along with the smell, of a strong lead paint. How does the hotel allow for construction that early in the morning on a Sunday?
We were awakened at 2 in the morning as the TV turned on magically, but of course it wouldn’t turn off and the volume was nearly at max. Maybe if they invested more money in the TV’s there wouldn’t be a problem. You don’t understand until you see them, they are extremely old.
The mall is just the same shop copy and pasted everywhere with prices ten dollars higher than they are in the States. The gym has few machines, with a weird floor pattern and it is also dirty. They don’t allow kids in there for some reason, which I find terribly stupid. 
They have this overly large projector in the main lobby, for the world cup. When we went to go watch the game, the projector was in black and white, and there was static all over the screen. Half of the left side of the projection was cut off, and there was no sound at all. How disappointing.
Overall, the staff are just a bunch of liars, and people who won’t fix the problem until you yell three times, management are completely terrible (a worker here told us they are extremely cheap) the food is HORRIBBLE, and cleaning staff don’t come till 3oclock to fix the room. Seems like they need to stop firing their head engineer. They are constantly trying to PUSH TIMESHARES ON YOU, as if you haven’t already spent enough money. I know it is their job, but the people selling cigars, jewelry, and other types of beach excursions; but if you say no one time, they will come up to you every five minutes and ask you again, and the prices are OVERLY HIGH. Its just annoying when you are trying to relax, and have the same guy come over twenty times. We were even told by another person at the resort, that the men on the beach were selling illegal drugs, and that is unacceptable for such a “prestige” brand such as the Punta Cana resorts. Something truly should be done about that. Likewise, the shows are all really bad and extremely underfunded as the Lion king show was a source of nightmare for kids with the terrible costumes, along with nobody being able to hear anything. Their version of the Broadway show, STOMP was a complete joke. The night club, “red lounge”, is almost completely empty all night long. It I nearly impossible to get a pool chair as crazy people are coming out at 3 am to take up a large sum of chair that they won’t even use. This is very hard for us as we had a baby with us and were forced to sit in the sun with the baby some days. The restaurants are very poor and not worth the price that we paid. Shout out to Luis for being the best bartender at the pool. But I must reiterate just how poorly the service from the manager Aura and Marielle was, I truly don’t understand how they can lie to our face, and still have a job. A lot of restaurants are very empty, so I don’t understand why management makes it so hard to get a reservation.

reviews.author: JiHyong B
reviews.title: Beautiful Property, Room for Improvements
reviews.text:
1. Check-in: On average, there’s a 45-50 min wait with long lines for check-in. There no sign or order for the wait line with people traveling in groups, and guests just chose one of the 2-3 lines and were scattered in front of the front desk. The process seemed like it’s half paper-based and manual. When we gave them our names, the front desk staff looked through a pile of papers to find our names. The process seemed inefficient and slow.  We also traveled with our extended family members and the resort gave them the wrong rooms which had guests already staying in there. 

2. Information: At our check-in, we were given two room keys and beach towel tickets and nothing else. Staff provided no information regarding restaurants, amenities, directions, activity schedule, etc.  No welcoming greeting or even a smile when we started our check-in process, contrary to our excitement and joy for finally arriving at the resort after long hours of travel. LOL  If they cannot have the front desk staff explain the guests what amenities they can enjoy and what restrictions they should be aware, maybe they should provide this on a TV channel, including daily activity schedule. So the guests can look it up anytime they need to during their stay. 

3. Room: Clean, spacious, and well-maintained, however, the sleeping area is wide open to the bathroom/shower/bathtub, which made it quite inconvenient with no privacy.  When families were sitting by the beds/sofa, they could hear every single organic sound that came out of anyone using the bathroom. There is no wall between bathroom and sleeping area.

4. Daily Service: On our third day, they ran out of hair conditioner, and when we asked for more, they simply said, “There isn’t any.” 

5. Poolside Restrictions: If you (family with kids) grab kabanas in the royal service area which has no sign that says, “Adults Only”, they will move you. It is understandable to have a separate section for adults only, but they only have one giant pool, and I’m not sure how this is considered as a “separate section”. The only shallow area is the “Adults Only” section for small school-aged kids. Our families and other guests who didn’t realize that it was the restricted area were kicked out eventually. 

6. Beach: Seaweed fiesta. In order to get to the water, you have to walk over a big pile of seaweed, but I’m not sure if this is something the resort can clean up or not. 

7. Dining: Wait staff were busy, but after sitting down with the food, our family waited for 10 minutes to get our silverware and napkins. One staff walked right by our table, and we asked for utensils, and she just rolled her eyes and said, “This is not my section.” as she walked away. Maybe they can have an area where guests can grab additional napkins and their utensils without having to wait for someone. 

8. Money Exchange: Resort does not have enough smaller bills on hand, so be prepared before you go. This was probably my fault but there was a section called “Exchange” where I thought I could exchange $20/$50 bills with smaller bills to give out as tips.  They asked me to talk to the bellhops and they again told me to go to a bar and ask for smaller bills. 

9. Keys: On the 5th day of our stay, our room keys stopped working. Both my husband and I were carrying each and kept them in separate pockets from our cell phones. When I approached the front desk for help, the staff held up a hand towards me with an index finger up as she is still facing elsewhere.  I just walked away and approached another staff for help. According to them, their system was down, and they could not reset our keys. So we were locked out of our room for 45 minutes with wet swimsuits in the lobby while they scrambled around to get a master key. Since the keys couldn’t get reset, we had to call them every time we needed to get back in our room for the rest of that day.  

10. Overall: Clean and beautiful properly with disappointing customer service. I would not recommend this resort to anyone at this point. At least when we shared our thoughts with a few staff, they said they are aware of existing issues/concerns with customer service and they’re looking to improve them. We were also invited to the new $300 million property “The Circle” presentation during our stay. This new resort will be open in December this year. It is great, however, maybe they could have invested a fraction of that $300 million to staff training and education and revamping customer service/operations within the existing resorts. Staff were always on the phone checking with someone who has authority to provide approvals. I’m puzzled why this can’t be computerized and more streamlined. It would have been a perfect vacation if we had good experiences with customer service, but things just happened one after another, not only to my family but to others whom we met there.

reviews.author: Jackitoss
reviews.title: Bad hotel
reviews.text:
I traveled to Punta cana several times, usually we have a great time.
The “Meliá” company is getting really bad.
Check in at the hotel was quickly.
The nightmare start when we need to get in the the room, the electronic keys did not work and until today, 2 days after they have not fix the problem.
The safety box inside the room doesn’t work.
I already call like 8 times, but you always get the same answer, “ so sorry, I will sent you somebody to fix it.
It took 4 hours to get our luggage to the room.
Food so far not that great.
For the restaurant reservations is another headache, you have to go to the lobby at specific  (10:30 am )
and was nothing available.
We went to the Casino looks so old and dirty.
Went to the pool, and was not towels available.
Never again will come to this hotel

Worst management , it just to be excellent.

reviews.author: evan1429
reviews.title: LADRONES EN ESTE HOTEL
reviews.text: En este hotel existen ladrones, recientemente asistimos a un congreso de médicos especialistas y a tres de mis colegas le robaron en sus habitaciones dinero. Una pareja fue asaltada dentro de su habitación en medio de la noche tremendo susto se llevaron. Cuidado cuando lo visiten no hay seguridad. Olvide mencionar el celular de otra de la doctoras fue robado en uno de los baños. Este hotel daña la imagen de los hoteles en mi país.

reviews.author: jessiquitavasquez
reviews.title: LADRONES POR DOQUIER
reviews.text: Se celebro alla el congreso dominicano de oftalmología en diferentes habitaciones de mis colegas se realizaron robos por parte de el personal ya que las puertas no eran ni siquiera violentadas. Robaron dinero, celulares y otras cosas. Lo mejor del caso es que el hotel hace caso omiso a las denuncias y no se hacen responsables.

reviews.author: N M
reviews.title: OMG.  Bad luck for us...
reviews.text: We are still staying at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana.  Last name get was the worst night I have ever had on a vacation. We are staying in building 40 at the Reserve. At 3:00 AM I was awakened by running water. I thought why is my husband in the shower and got up to check. I walked two steps and fell on my butt and slud across the room into the paneled doors (on marble floors, mind you) This woke my kids up. At this moment my husband shouts "Our room is flooding!" So, yes our room was flooding. Water was pouring from the ceiling over the toilet! Then we opened our door and saw hot, steamy water pouring into the hallway. At 3:30, my daughter and I walked to the pool cabanas to go to the bathroom. At this point we had seen two people, our concierge desk lady and a maintenance guy. My husband went to the pool to get towels and we started drying up the floors. By 5:00 we we're exhausted from picking up wet things and suitcases and tried to go back to sleep. At 8:00, Paradisus staff came in our room and started clearing out water. We left to go to breakfast. Our room has had water running into it for three out of the last 4 days. Beautiful resort, love Omar our family concierge...otherwise our room has been a nightmare. We are so disappointed. Wait...icing on the cake...my husband's excursion got cancelled last minute this morning, too!  ! 3 more days of adventure ahead....we will keep you posted.

reviews.author: agrosso0929
reviews.title: Not for kids, one of the worst all inclusives we've been to
reviews.text:
We booked a vacation through Orbitz on June 9th 2017. The description on Orbitz and the search criteria we used was specific for a kid friendly hotel. We have a 2 and a half year old and a 5 month old. Kid friendly was the most important criteria we had. This hotel even offered a concierge to help with kids(which we paid an extra daily fee for).

The hotel was very misrepresented. Upon arrival we had to load into 2 vans to go back and forth from the front desk to our room. That’s 2 kids and a stroller in and out of a van every time we needed to go somewhere. There was no place we could safely walk a stroller without encountering steps that we had to lift the stroller and carry it.  There was only 1 restaurant less than a 10 minute walk and everything else we had to take a shuttle and/or golf cart ride for. I had one arm holding a stroller and one holding my son. The road we had to walk was dimly lit and had multiple vans and delivery trucks. The same went for the beach, it was a 10 minute( if we were lucky) shuttle down to the beach and other restaurants. One night we had to wait over 30 minutes to get a ride back because there were so many people waiting for rides. Also we were not allowed to eat by the pool which meant every meal we had to take the kids out of the pool, dry everyone off(since the buffet was indoors), walk the stroller about 200 yards and up several steps. The bathrooms had no space to change a diaper so every diaper change required us walking back to our room.

The “family friendly” staff was not helpful at all. Every restaurant needed a reservation. Upon arriving we had to give them a list of where we wanted to eat and the times for the week. Anyone with kids knows between naps and feedings there is no way to plan and predict every day a week in advance, so we had to wake up the kids just to have enough time to catch a shuttle to get something to eat. The process and logistics of this hotel were horrible.
Our family friendly room was adjacent to a highway and the main entrance with delivery trucks every few hours and overnight. Nothing like diesel engines starting to wake up the kids day and night.

We checked in on Monday the 25th and checked out Wednesday morning the 27th. Ended up staying at Now Onyx which was AMAZING

reviews.author: Graciana U
reviews.title: Deficiente
reviews.text:
Estuvimos alojados del 12 al 18 de Junio con mi marido y nuestro bebé.
El ascensor no Funcionaba así que tuvimos q trasladarnos con el coche alzandolo en las escaleras.
La puerta del baño en la habitación hinchada teniamos que hacer mucha fuerza para cerrarla y se golpeaba al cerrarse.
El primer dia fuimos a reservar para cenar en los distintos restaurantes y nos dijeron que el 17 no habrían varios de estos por temporada baja.
La primer mañana al dirigirnos a la playa nos encontramos con que la misma estaba inaccesible x las Algasss!!!! Mas de un metro de altura y olor nauseabundo. Según los mismos empleados, llevaba 2 meses así  (nadie nos avisó con anterioridad). La semana anterior nos alojamos en el Grand Palladium Pallace y ellos limpiaban TODOS los días asi que si pudimos disfrutar del mar. 
Durante toda la estadia no pudimos meternos al mar. Lo irónico del caso es que el hotel vecino Melia que es d la misma cadena tenía redes de contención y las algas NO entraban.
Por esta razón la piscina estaba todos los días con gente y NO había reposeras con sombra disponibles ya q son muy pocas las Palapas y los huéspedes las reservan muy temprano en la mañana.
Hice Todas las quejas con el gerente de recepción Wally Peña y con Domingo el encargado de Relaciones Públicas, para lo único q sirvió es para q nos den acceso a la piscina de Reserve. Y nada mas nos resolvieron ni siquiera la puerta del Baño. PÉSIMOS anfitriones.
La Limpieza muuuy deficiente cuándo ingresamos a la habitación la ducha tenía pelos de la anterior estadía.
El jabón de ducha tuve que pedir q lo repongan a la supervisora de areas públicas ya q teníamos una chapita de jabón desde nuestro ingreso! Y le mostré la suciedad del inodoro que tenía días.
En las comidas en el Buffet Naos y en el desayuno faltan mozos para servir bebida.

Lo mejor: la calidad de la comida. El gerente de AABB Martín muy esmerado.
En la piscina the Reserve excelente atención del concierge Felipe.

reviews.author: Margie C
reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text: Much need renovations under way as resort is outdated. Rooms are nice though. Construction next to room. Moved me...construction again. My relaxing vacation turned into No sleeping in. One buffet restaurant equals all inclusive. No snack bars or even fruit bowls. All other restaurants closed. Front desk could care less if you have a problem. They are all about fees. Ie: Room service is all inclusive. Only 10 minutes after you order, they call you and tell there is a service charge if you want your food you pay. Late check out? $20 per hour.

reviews.author: cami0125
reviews.title: Seaweed 4 feet high!!!
reviews.text: Hotel, grounds and most of the staff is nice but the beach is horrible!! You cannot even swim in the water. Dump trucks and diggers all day long on the beach trying to remove the seaweed. Now I know it an act of nature but I spent thousands , unable to swim in the caribbean that I waited so long to see:(

reviews.author: taral221
reviews.title: No Power and a Foaming Toilet
reviews.text:
We “upgraded” to the reserve after hearing how horrible the regular rooms were from our travel companions. We traveled with a group of 70 people. 

We were not told the reserve was mainly for families and we traveled as a couple. The staff should have suggest the royal service instead. We had a small shower and large jacuzzi tub which we didn’t use. The carpet was stained and the room was turned over late in the afternoon when we wanted to prepare for dinner. 

We had one day without power from 10 am-5 pm. During that time the humidity soaked into our bedding making it wet. Of course that was the day the room was not turned over because housekeeping came when we had to get ready for dinner. It was also the same day that our toilet spewed foam (see photo). When we finally did get to sleep that night at 1 am due to the toilet mess, we slept in a wet cold bed. 

The water main also broke when we were there and several of our traveling companions were without running water for quite some time. 

The service at all of the restaurants, aside from Passion which was excellent, was horrible. If we did get water they rarely refilled it. The majority of the staff was not helpful when we asked what activities were available or if we could get something particular. Room service shouldn’t even be listed on the sheet as when you do call and order they don’t deliver it. Activities that were set for certain times never happened and when asked why they didn’t have that activity that day we were told “the time has passed” even though we had been waiting at the pool for it for several hours in advance. 

Apparently you also receive a coupon book at the reserve upon arrival. We did not receive it and only heard about it through a fellow guest. Had we had that coupon book we would have saved at least $80.  

To say we were disappointed is an understatement. We will not be returning.

reviews.author: barbieriml
reviews.title: No vayan! Es una ESTAFA
reviews.text:
Para los que no quieran sufrir una ESTAFA, NO VAYAN!! Estoy aquí desde el 12/6 al 18/6 sin poder ir al mar ya que la playa está llena de algas, al punto de tener entre 5 y 10 metros de las mismas en la orilla. Una semana antes estuvimos en el Palladium Palace y nos pudimos meter al agua todos los días y con una playa limpia , pero aquí es imposible . 
Porque una estafa? Porque los empleados del hotel nos dijeron que están así hace más de 3 meses y a la hora de reservar no existe ningún aviso de la situación. La piscina está ok pero con pocos lugares para estar a la sombra, al punto de que mis hijos tuvieron que ver varias peleas por la reserva de reposeras 
Vinimos a PC a disfrutar de la playa y no a sufrir una ESTAFA

reviews.author: QueenVictoriaBoston
reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text:
I don't know where to start, I can't believe what a horrible stay I recently experienced at the Paradisus Palma Real.  I had picked this resort based on the positive reviews I read on TripAdvisor (of which I am a 12 year member and a top 2% contributor in the state of Massachusetts).  I have traveled to the Caribbean countless times over the last 20 years and have never had an experience such as this.  It is by far the worst review I have ever had the displeasure of writing on TripAdvisor. I feel that I need to share my terrible experience because it is completely unacceptable that I paid so much money ($3,200.00) for my stay and I was expecting to experience 5* service - which this was absolutely not. 

I booked this vacation for my husband and I as well as our friends (a married) couple and we were really looking forward to an amazing beach vacation, only to have the most horrible experience we could have imagined.

Problems we encountered:

Check-in: we arrived at 3:30 pm only to be told that our rooms weren't ready and that we needed to come back in an hour (even though we were the only 4 people checking into the place).  We requested rooms on the same floor as our friends (only to find out later that we were 3 building apart).  Rooms were on the 3rd floor with no elevator - only 1 elevator in the lobby and it was out of service (this was a problem for me as I have trouble with my leg).  This was shameful.  When we were finally getting rooms assigned they tried to "upsell" us on an ocean view room for an additional $1,825 for the week. Once we declined, at that point it was obvious they were no longer interested in going out of their way to welcome us.  We received absolutely no "orientation" to the resort, no map and no beach towel cards (as we were later sent back for them to the front desk by the women at the towel hut). My friend was given a key to a room that was still occupied and was very embarrassed to walk in on people who were not fully dressed.  When we finally got to our room it smelled like vomit and I called the front desk to complain.  I was told that they would send someone to “refresh” the room but they would not agree to move us stating that there was no availability (even though we later found out that the resort was at approximately 50% capacity).  Our room was also not the Jr. Suite with a King Bed which we paid for, but had to separate double beds instead.  When I called the front desk I was told that someone would come and move the beds together.  They did after several more phone calls to the front desk it took them two days to finally come by and take care of it. 

The Shower: had absolutely no pressure in it and just trickled either cold or scolding hot water.  It took forever each time to set the dial just right in order to use it and not get burned.  The towels and robes were old and overused. The second night of our stay the toilet leaked heavily and I called the front desk (from our phone that didn't work well and only had static) to complain.  They sent someone to our room while we were at dinner.  The toilet continued to leak and made a loud noise all night only not to function properly in the morning.  It would not flush.  Again we had to call for service and wait, and wait and finally my husband took the cover off and fixed it himself as we wanted to be on our way and not continue to be stuck in our room (using up our vacation hours waiting).  We also noticed that the cord was ripped out of the lamp on the bedside table and remained "live" under the bed.  This must have occurred when they moved the beds together.  The balcony door did not have a functioning lock on it and remained unlocked throughout our whole stay, this is by all standards a serious safety concern, but no one else seemed to care and they said “it’s no problem” no one will get in.

Dinner reservations: while waiting for our rooms to become available I decided to book them for the week ahead.  I requested a 7:30 pm reservation for 4 people every night irrelevant of which restaurant came in which order.  I was quickly told that there was not a single 7:30 reservation at any of the restaurants the whole week!  Can you believe that?  This must be the Paradisus/Melia way of pushing clients into the Royal /or Reserve category where you get a butler who would make these reservations for you.  After spending a whole hour with the young lady I was miraculously able to book 7:30 reservation for the next 5 nights.  Our first evening the only time we could get was at 9:30 at RARE stake house.  The restaurant had hardly any guest and yet we weren't served our dinner until 11:00 pm and the food was luke-warm.  Terrible experience.  The waiter kept disappearing for 10-15 minutes at a time and just kept saying the food is coming.

The Restaurants - the food was very mediocre, lacked any kind of presentation or sides.  Aqua, at The Reserve was the worst.  My husband ordered a main course shrimp dinner, and he literally got a dozen small shrimp swimming in a pool of oil in a small cast iron skillet - that's it!  My friend ordered steak and that's all it was, a piece of meat on a plate.  This is what constitutes a 5* resort restaurant?  Dinner at the Peruvian restaurant was very disappointing as well.  At one point they tried to "upsell" the lobster dinner for an additional $32 a person, we later noticed that they were grilling lobster tails in the buffet that evening - all you can eat for free - what a racket!  All of your restaurants are very mediocre, just a lot hype and limited reservation availability to make the client think that they will be missing something if they don't get in.  The buffet food was the same every day and things were being reused from lunch to dinner all the time.

The drinks:  we don’t typically drink (and don’t take much advantage of that feature in the all-inclusive package) however, we were set on enjoying a cocktail at dinner.  My husband ordered Grey Goose vodka with cranberry juice only to be “yelled at” by the bartender that our green bracelet does allow us to have Grey Goose (which must be considered top shelf liquor).  Once my husband gave the bartender a $2 tip all was fine.  This is not disclosed anywhere on the Paradisus/Melia website that you are not privy to particular types of liquor.  I understand if we wanted a high-end bottle of wine, but a regular drink, this is just ridiculous – again not 5* rating worthy.  We continued to run into that situation every single night.

Food left on the stairs in buildings:  there was always dirty dishes with food left-overs left on the stairs in the building that would remain there for most of the day.  We noticed small lizzards running around near by and this was very unsanitary as they can carry bacteria around.  No one bothered to pick this up for hours.

TimeShare Presentation - The Circle: on the first day at the resort we had a young lady approach us who tried to talk us into going to one of their "Circle Membership" presentations for which if we agreed to attend she would gift us with coupons for a free massage. She said that the resort was only at 50% capacity as it is off-season but they like to make it look like they are super busy all the time.  We declined and she later harassed us by calling our room several times during the week to see if "we could help her out" by attending.  This is completely unacceptable and goes way beyond a hard sell.   We came on vacation to relax not to be harrassed into buying a membership.

Stomach virus:  all of us were having extreme stomach pain and diarrhea starting our 3rd day in the resort.  This unpleasant issue continueed for a whole week after we returned from vacation. It could possibly be the ice or the fresh fruit/salad. My husband finally had to contact his doctor's office out of concern because this problem was so severe and lasted for such a long time. 

THE BEACH - this is by far the absolute worst part of the vacation. It is horrible, murky and full of seaweed....you cant see your feet when standing in 2 feet of water. I believe that Melia/Paradisus and Expedia go to great lengths to hide the fact how big of a problem the seaweed situation really is.  Nowhere on the Paradisus/Melia website does it disclose this information - this is an extremely deceptive practice which prevents the consumer from being aware of this tremendous issue.  The whole reason we selected this resort and went to the Caribbean was to enjoy the beach (we are not pool people) but this problem is cleverly disguised.  Paradisus/Melia does not properly clean/manage the seaweed and therefore we were faced with several feet of it on the beach on the daily basis.  Not only is it horribly unattractive and is a deterrent for going in the water (the fact that there were hardly anyone swimming in the ocean the whole week we were there should have been a dead give-away) the other problem is that there are sea lice/fleas and tiny crabs that live in the seaweed.   I was severely bitten by these tiny fleas and crabs and had a terrible reaction and an incredible rash all over my arms, legs and feet.  This caused a lot of burning and itching and I was unable to sleep at night.  It completely ruined my vacation as I had to stay in my room for several days and treat it with a medicated cream.  I have contacted Expedia, as the tour operator (that advertised and sold the hotel with a 5* star rating) and made a formal complaint, which I was assured will be fully investigated. As you can see from the photo (attached), there was absolutely no one swimming on the Paradisus Palma Real beach due to the horrible seaweed problem.

Luggage pick up:  the night before our departure I called the front desk to arrange for luggage pick-up but once again, no one came and we had to call in a panic that we would miss our bus pickup. Since there are no elevators in the building and we were in building #5 it would have been extremely difficult for us to do this ourselves.  A bell boy finally came and we just made our bus after running behind him.

I feel that the resort/experience was not as advertised and critical information about the seaweed problem was not disclosed and it is absolutely not a 5* resort.  

Traveler beware!

reviews.author: JillianLynn2018
reviews.title: Stay Away
reviews.text:
It all began when we arrived to our room. It did not resemble the pictures online whatsoever. We had the junior suite. The air conditioning was barely working and it looked and felt dirty. The only good thing in the room was the two Budweiser in the warm fridge. I opened the balcony which was on the first floor and a cat ran in our room.
