My boyfriend is extremely allergic to cats so I called the front desk and demanded a change of room and asked why they have cats in the property! (I personally don’t mind them but not on my vacation.) The woman didn’t understand what I was telling her so we proceeded to the front desk. When we finally found an employee that understood us we where able to upgrade to “The Reserve” but had to pay. She told us they had no cats on the property and that it was strange we seen one. 
The bellboy took us to our new room which I thought “wow, this is beautiful as soon as I walked in” then a second later I screamed bloody murder as I seen a huge cockroach run across the floor. The bellboy quickly stepped on it and said, “don’t worry, this is the only one” 

1.) Beware of cockroaches. They are everywhere. 
2.) No one speaks fluent English. They know the basics just to get by but you can’t have a full conversation with anyone. I believe I spoke to the manager the first day to change rooms and that was rough. For example....I asked where the beach/ocean/Aqua was. I was told there was no ocean around..and that it was far far away...I also asked for an iced coffee...I got ice in a cup and hot coffee in another..I couldn’t help but laugh. 
3.) cats/kittens everywhere. They are crying outside your room at night..if you eat at a restaurant outside they are by you begging for food. It’s so sad. They look terribly sick and diseased. 
4.) bring bug spray. Everyone’s ankles where bit up. I even seen a woman on the beach with bits going all the way up her legs to her butt.
5.) food is horrendous. Same food at the buffet everyday. I actually lost weight because I couldn’t eat anything which never happens when I go on vacation. They leave chocolate milk and regular milk that are in cartons out all day without being refrigerated. I asked why they did that and they said it was normal!!??? I told them it wasn’t normal and that we would get sick. They treat milk like it’s pop. They leave cases out all day in the lobby and each building. 
6.) seaweed is awful. Apparently it only comes in two months out of the year..so don’t go May-June/July. We walked the beach both ways and weirdly enough our hotel beach wasn’t as bad as all the others. Workers where out every morning trying to clean it but they couldn’t keep up. 
7.) they told us when we arrived golfcarts /trolleys come around every 5 mins to each building to pick people up since the property is so big. It’s not 5 mins..it’s 20-30 mins..so we just walked everywhere. 
7.) alcohol was more watered down then Mexico’s which I didn’t think could be possible. 
8.) Like I said before, we upgraded to “The Reserve” there are so many upgrades you don’t know what pools or bars you’re aloud to go into. It’s ridiculous and was a waste of money but we had to get out of our previous room because of the cat incident. 
9.) Staff started to ignore us on the 3rd day.(we stayed 7) they stopped coming to our table to ask if we wanted coffee at breakfast ect. Or on the beach they stopped asking if we wanted drinks. 
10.) room service..they pick and choose what’s available that day. I asked for Mac and cheese one night and they said no but they had penne pasta which they use the same noodles...
11.) we had to ask for room service to come clean our room. Some days they didn’t come until 7pm.
12.) I thought it was strange that when we upgraded we got presidenta beer in our fridge instead of Budweiser. You pay more and get a crappy beer. They only give you two a day..you have to request to get more. We found out the last day on the beach we could have had Budweiser the whole time. They don’t advertise it..you have to ask. 

We would never go back to Punta Cana. Everyone we spoke to said the same thing. We go to Mexico(Cancun,puerto Vallarta, ect) twice a year and we have had our share of bad resorts but compared to this...Mexico is heaven. I really wanted to love Punta Cana but it was absolutely the worst place we have ever stayed.

If I had to say something positive about this resort it would have to be the grounds. ( besides the cats and cockroaches) The palm trees, flowers, ect was not bad.

reviews.author: 364abl
reviews.title: Not Luxury at all!!!
reviews.text: Dead roaches in our room. They came and removed the 1st one that was huge! Didn't even act like it was a problem. Food isn't good! Prepare to spend 2 hours if you make reservations to eat. No other food but buffet at lunch! We ended up switching to another room at midnight because we found dead roaches beside and underneath our mini fridge. The mattresses on the bed were absolutely disgusting! Visible signs there had been bed bugs before on one mattress. They were stained with big yellow spots.  The rooms look like they haven't been dusted in 2 or 3 weeks. The phone was even dirty!! Room service charges $5.00 every time you order something and it is very gross!!! The property outside of the rooms is beautiful! We hardly had any shower pressure! Our tv barely worked in our 1st room that we had. The hairdryer looked terrible!!! The toilet barely flushed in the 1st room. We were harassed daily about the Melia club until we finally just listened to what they said would take 30 minutes took 2 hours. When we said that it wasn't for us the girl would not take no for an answer and got the manager to talk to us. I had to tell her very bluntly NO!!! My kids were very tired and hungry at this point. We were never told that we couldn't swim next door at the Reserve.  The kids can swim and eat but not the adults. I guess you are suppose to sit and watch. The whole trip was unorganized! They dropped my daughters and my food at dinner one evening and it was still on the floor when we left dinner. It wasn't fit to eat!! I had to have Outback delivered! We sat at the Hibachi Grill for 45 minutes before the cook started to prepare the food. The quality of the food was poor. The main pool is in need of some TLC. I was asked to take a water spin class and when I walked over there were no more bikes available.  The instructor just looked at me. Be prepared to be harassed the whole entire time that you are by the pool and the beach! They want you to purchase activities and jewelry.  There is no relaxing.  You had to pay extra for 2 other restaurants that they have and kids are not allowed in a couple of them. That would be understanding if there were more restaurants on property. The ladies in the gift shop look at you like you are going to steal something. We went over to the Reserve one night to walk around and check it out. This was before we found out about the swimming and eating issue at the Reserve. My soon looks up and there is a guy with a machine gun just standing there looking around. They are building a new edition next door. My husband asked about the situation and was told they had to have people there with guns because of theft issues after dark in the Dominican. We tried to make the best out of our trip but it wasn't great! The Paradisus in Playa del Carmen is not like this at all!!! We will never stay with the Paradisus again. They don't seem to care! I woukd recommend staying somewhere else if you are traveling to this area! I would never post something like this but my concern was not addressed as I requested. This is not a classy resort at all!!

reviews.author: Maxsand
reviews.title: Hotel no respeta reservas. Yo no me arriesgaría.
reviews.text: Vamos a comenzar por decir que el hotel está, en estos momentos, mintiéndole a muchas personas, argumentando que no es su política la sobreventa. Porque, la verdad sea dicha, las cosas por su nombre: sobrevender parece ser una estrategia de ventas de la Cadena Meliá en todas sus variantes. Solo es cosa de que usted revise las opiniones negativas en TripAdvisor para este y otros Paradisus by Meliá y Meliá resorts. En esta ocasión, y con reservas realizadas y pagadas hace 10 meses en su sistema de bookings, y a 24 horas del check-in, cuando además ya están pagados los boletos de avión en Business Class y organizada la vida familiar para la escapada, Paradisus Palma Real informa, ojo, informa, no se excusa ni acepta que es una falta grave, que "hemos sobrevendido y usted no tiene cupo en nuestro hotel". Esa es la información a un repetidor hace 10 años en Meliá en el Caribe, que celebró su boda en el Paradisus Palma Real, momento en el cual les llevó 50 invitados. Y ahora, al pedir una explicación, la gerente, Adriana Romero, inoperante y soberbia hasta decir basta, ofreció una solución absolutamente insatisfactoria: cambiar a un complejo de menor calidad (lo que se rechazó porque por algo se reservó y pagó en lo que se CREÍA era mejor calidad) o una semana a usar en un año.  Por supuesto nada de boletos de avión para esa semana y menos aún hacerse cargo de las multas de USD$400 por boleto de Business. Tras DOS horas de discusión en la que literalmente y riéndose Adriane Romero dijo algo así como "demandemos, pero debe ser en Palmas de Mallorca", aceptaron a regañadientes  devolver el dinero si y sólo si el afectado firmaba primero un acuerdo para no demandar en corte. Un abuso. Yo hace años que dejé Meliá porque esto es habitual en ellos (lo hacían siempre en Cuba en los 90), pero me pareció oportuno dejar esta información para todos los latinoamericanos que consultan Trip Advisor, porque si esa fue la respuesta dada a un abogado litigante chileno destacado, me imagino los abusos que pueden cometer con cualquiera de nosotros menos avezados en temas de negociación. En lo personal, hace años que opto por cadenas menos fastuosas, pero con una atención de primer nivel al pasajero y una recepción de brazos abiertos a los que somos repetidores. Como le dije a mi amigo: esto, en un Luxury Gran Bahía Príncipe o un Iberostar en régimen Gran Prestige JAMÁS le habría pasado. Yo hablo directamente por whatsapp con el gerente del Iberostar al que más voy (Iberostar Costa Dorada) y los problemas, como él dice, "son míos, no suyos, usted viene a nuestro hotel a disfrutar". Así que, ojo: Eviten The Reserve at Paradisus by Meliá. Y si insisten en ir a Meliá, NO USEN su página de reservas, háganlo a través de una agencia. Así, cuando les pase esto (porque eventualmente les va a pasar, créanme), al menos podrán demandar compensación de la agencia de viajes que se los venda.

reviews.author: Thomas D
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: Was so excited to book my honeymoon here... booked it back in October of 2017 and my honeymoon was in May. A week before we arrived they said our oceanfront suite was no longer available and that we were being moved to another resort with a garden view... wow I was in shock the only thing offered was a couples massage and an excursion... terrible!!!!

reviews.author: Kayla H
reviews.title: Not a great time in Paradise - Paradisus Palma Real
reviews.text:
My Husband was very ill - we suspect some sort of food poising - it lasted about 12 hours the second day of the trip and on our 6th day we couldn't even leave the room because he was so sick. * we didn't drink any tap water during our stay*

During Dinner at VENTO - he had a STAPLE ( yes like one you would find in an office- but larger... it reminded me of one you would see in a cardboard box) in his food. The response from the hotel was that they wanted us to come back and try it again.

We stayed at the reserve 4 years ago and had a great time - one of our favorite things were all the great frozen drinks that we could get - made fresh. The Bars ( other than the one outside of Fuego) were all using predone mix for pina colados and daiquiris which was disappointing. Also When we stayed previously, our dinner at Fuego we had the option for surf and turf- which is now a $40 upcharge per person if you want it. 

The quality of food/drinks seems to have declined - everything felt cheap.

reviews.author: southern706
reviews.title: HOSED!!!
reviews.text:
Hosed!!!

Paradisus Palma Real is a very nice resort with quality food and drinks on a beautiful stretch of beach BUT… THEY HOSED US BIG TIME!!!

We booked and paid in advance for a family suite in the Reserve as part of a group of five families.  About two weeks before the trip -- and without asking -- the resort moved us out of the Reserve and into the Paradisus.  The rest of the families were all in the Reserve as booked.  

Instead of an equivalent room, we were placed in an older room with a musty smell.  The best part was the view.  Rather than a nice view of the lovely Reserve or a beach view, we were directly facing a construction zone. It was literally right outside our window.  I don’t mean in the distance, it was directly below our balcony.

It would have been nice to wake up to birds chirping or the waves breaking on the beach.  Our daily wake up call was the very loud noise of heavy equipment cutting a new road right outside our bedroom window.  The most enjoyable part was the amusement park ride we had every day when the heavy equipment made the furniture and patio doors shake.  The entire room was shaking including the floor.  Apparently, the new construction will be more stable than the existing building.

Clearly, this was an involuntary major downgrade in room category.  I would have been happy to pay a significantly reduced rate for the obvious downgrade or be given a partial refund.  However, they wouldn’t budge.  We paid for a high-end room in the exclusive Reserve and got a dump room.  A swap to an equivalent room is one thing but this was the Motel 6 at a Ritz Carlton price.  At a minimum, they should have given us a courtesy upgrade on the room for moving us away from the rest of our group.

We complained every day.  Our travel agent in the USA and the vacation broker they used complained also.  No refund, no relocation to a better room, no nothing.  They offered a bunch of useless vouchers that required me to spend money to get $25 off in the resort shop, etc.

Our patio door was missing the rubber strip at the bottom.  The gap allowed mosquitoes to freely enter the room. The rubber strip on our shower door leaked water all over the floor.  We had to use a full bath towel to mop that up every time someone took a shower.  Both were reported several times but nothing was ever fixed.

One of the assistant managers met with us several times.  Everyone was very nice but it was all lip service.  After six days of complaining, we finally got a private dinner on the patio right outside one of the restaurants.  That didn’t “cost” them anything.  To get that, I had to sign a waiver relinquishing my rights to sue for compensation.  While I had reservations about signing it, it was clear that if I didn’t take something now, then I wasn’t ever going to get anything.  Since this was on our last full day, there were no other options.

For the record, multiple families were complaining since the construction impacted many guests.  This issue was not an isolated one and they knew full well what was happening.  Management had clearly chosen a strategy of be nice to the guests but don’t give up anything.  

We met with our travel agent upon our return to the USA.  Our agent and the broker worked tirelessly to rectify the situation while we were at Paradisus.  One would think that industry insiders could persuade a resort to take better care of their guests but even they were unable to do so.  

The agent couldn’t believe that they were putting guests in a construction zone at full price as most nice resorts either close the rooms adjacent to construction or offer them at a discount.  The most telling comment was from the owner of the travel agency who has sent families to this resort for years.  She said that the resort has just become too greedy.

The bottom line is the resort hosed us.  You should spend your hard-earned money at another resort that actually gives a flip about their guests.

reviews.author: jorgegrv
reviews.title: Pesimo
reviews.text: Pésimo servicio no me vuelvo a hospedar en este hotel, no cuenta con ascensores para las familias que lo necesitamos, los restaurantes no se encuentran acondicionados para las familias con coches de bebe, no hay música en la playa, el personal es muy poco servicial.

reviews.author: José E
reviews.title: Bajo la calidad de antaño
reviews.text:
Vine hace un año y no es lo mismo! Te limitan comida y tragos. La verdad que me desilusionaron. Traje a 12 amigos y no fue lo que esperamos.
Se noto el cambio de administracion. 
Nos paso lo mismo en todas las intalaciones... en pocas palabras no es un all inclusive

reviews.author: Nereragain
reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Do not visit this resort. We went out to dinner and left the do not disturb sign on the door. When we came back someone had left chocolates on the bed. We were wondering why they had came in. The next morning we were packing to return home. The safe would not open.  We called the front desk and a few minutes someone came to tell us that security was called because we left the safe unopen. This was not true. Money was missing but how do you prove it. We went to the front desk and the manager would not come to speak with us. So my question is: If you came into a room with the do not disturb sign on the door why would you go into the closet? Never again!

reviews.author: Sassy081417
reviews.title: Bad Rooms & Worse Food
reviews.text: I am currently at this hotel and we are hold up in our room, counting the hours (40) until this experience ends. We are on a rewards trip. Typically we stay at 4 and 5 star hotels, so I'm a bit spoiled. This trip is FREE, so you would think it would be fine. Nope... I wish I had stayed home. The property is tired. The rooms are shabby and feel dirty. It's like they stuck a bunch of doors in where they don't belong. Example our closet doors are old sliding glass doors. The power goes off periodically. The sinks don't drain. Light bulbs are burned out... etc. this is our second room. The first room had too many issues to count but a non-working safe was the final straw. The free food is terrible. It's all very bland and unappealing. The salt and pepper shakers are all clogged so you can't even season it. Nothing tastes like it should... it taste like fake chicken and fake burgers. All the breads are stale. The omelet guy can't make an omelet.... just BAD! The best thing I've eaten is mac and cheese which taste like kraft. I like kraft so that is good. Ordering that for dinner tonight. The beach is pretty but no security from the locals trying to sell JUNK. Sat at the pool today to avoid them but there is no breeze so came back to the room. Our group consists of nice Americans who are well dressed. The other guests here are mostly disgusting and covered in tattoos. There are tons of children and our group is all adult. They had three weddings yesterday which were all competing with their music. Kind of sad for the brides. The one nice thing I can say is that the staff is amazing and could not be nicer. I feel bad trashing the place because the people are so wonderful. That being said... I would feel bad if I did not warn people to avoid this resort. That is, unless you are looking for a cheap cruise like, spring break experience. I'm clicking my heels... "There's no place like home!"

reviews.author: WunderKid S
reviews.title: My phone was stolen on a beach
reviews.text: We spent 5 days in this beautiful resort a year ago and I'd like to warn anyone who will stay there during Easter/ Passover time.  THIS PLACE IS NOT THAT SAFE as you can expect. In the first few hours that we arrived my phone was stolen from my pant's pocket on the beach in the club members area. We tried to contact with resort staff and security, but it seems that nobody care and when I asked to call police the staff member convinced me that Police  will not care because of God Friday.  This spoiled all my vacation.

reviews.author: Carlos D-M
reviews.title: Hotel 5 Estrellas? mas bien diria 2 o 3.
reviews.text:
No se por donde empezar,pero lo hare por lo mas evidente. El hotel esta abandonado, las habitaciones estan para tirarlas y los muebles no digamos.
El servicio ha empeorado notablemente, y ya no obtienes nada si no das suculentas propinas. Si es un todo incluido, todos deberiamos ser tratados igual, y no es asi.
Por ejemplo en la playa. Te dicen que hay un turno rotario, pero yo no consegui estar en primera linea en 7 dias, pero otros con propinas si lo consiguen. 
El botones, 20 minutos esperando a llevar las maletas, y al final las tuve que llevar yo. Reserva en restaurantes mal realizadas, teniendo que cenar en mesas diferentes 6 personas (no hablo de 20 pax). La calidad de los vinos, digamos que muy mejorabes, supuestamente franceses pero embotellados en Italia y los tintos estaban siempre calientes.
Y lo de las copas mejor no hablar. Refrescos de botellas de litro, abiertas no se cuando, tonicas inexistentes, etc.
Eso si, todos preocupados por tus quejas, pero nadie hace nada. 
Como soy socio, y ya he pagado los USD 25.000, ya nada les importa, solo intentarnos vendernos otro paquete de USD 90.000 para el Circle, otro engañabobos.
En fin, si Melia trata asi a sus socios, no se que hara con otros clientes.

reviews.author: heyginny618
reviews.title: Make sure you get what you paid for!!!!!
reviews.text: BEWARE...BEWARE....BEWARE.....my husband booked specifically though the hotel web site - Hotel & flight package. Our reservations were for THE RESERVE - we have stayed in the other part of the hotel and picked this package only because it was for The Reserve. We arrived at The Reserve and were told we didn't have a reservation, even though I had a print-out that said our booking was for The Reserve. I showed my reservation and I was told we booked through a third party and that they (the hotel) were not responsible for what room we were booked into. We were told at The Reserve that it wasn't their problem it was to be taken up with the people who booked the room. Today I spent about 1 1/2 hours on the phone trying to get some sort of compensation for not getting what we paid for. Long story short this reservation was done through Melia so they lied or were misinformed at The Reserve when they told me it wasn't their problem. I am currently waiting for some sort of compensation because we never would have booked to stay in the non Reserve part of the hotel. When booking The Reserve make sure that your room is in that part of the hotel. Staying in The Reserve affords you many perks that you do not get in the other part of the hotel!!! Absolutely gorgeous property but make sure you get what you paid for!!!

reviews.author: Francine F
reviews.title: Worst and worst
reviews.text: We were putting in a room when we arrived to the the resorts I’m telling you paradisus is not the same anymore don’t waste your money , to make story’s short because the room wasn’t comfortable they connected two beds together we requested a change. We end up forgot a beat head phone in the room, we call  guess service to report my husband left the beat headphone we still haven’t get an answer I’m hoping who ever take it rerun it back , this is unbelievable

reviews.author: K6695EKdavids
reviews.title: terrible customer service ruins vacation
reviews.text:
The Good:

The Paradisus Palma Real (Palma) was a good value in that it was significantly cheaper than some other resorts I looked into booking in the last week of February 2018 in the Dominican. There is some truth though to the saying that you get what you pay for.

My room was somewhat dated. The night lites on the headboard were both broken. Several channels listed on the satellite TV service also wouldn't work properly (no sound and/or picture). That being said, the room was clean and I was more than satisfied with it and it had all the amenities one needed.

The restaurant selection was somewhat limited and the food was, for the most part, slightly above average but nothing to write home about and definitely not 5 Star quality. Evening entertainment was typical resort stuff - very average in that regard. The Casino apparently has been reduced in size to about 20 slot machines, a couple of BJ tables, a Craps table, roulette and Caribbean poker and is only open at night.

There was a very bit of seaweed (weedy type as opposed to mucous type) on the beach but it was mostly dried seaweed and there wasn't that much in the water so it really wasn't an issue and could be largely ignored. There was a wide variety of water activities available (some included in the package price and some not). The golf course, which was a typical resort friendly wide open affair, was well maintained and had 27 holes which provided some variety when playing multiple days.

The Semi-Bad:

They use a reservation system for both the restaurants and the golf course. Some might appreciate it while for others it might seem like work on a vacation having to plan specific mealtimes days in advance. Additionally, they preferred you only booked golf 2 days at a time (other resorts I have been too allow you to book golf for your entire stay in advance). They also charge a "cart" fee of $65-75 US dollars which in reality is a green fee because it applies to each person in your group and is on the high side for an all-inclusive resort. Additionally, the shuttle to the course is only once an hour so if you finish your round at 1:05 pm and want to hit the beach you have to wait until 2 pm for the next shuttle back to the hotel. There's really no good excuse for the shuttle not running at least every 1/2 hour.

There is only one store on the resort with a very limited selection of snacks/beverages/cigarettes. Luckily, there is a shuttle that runs every 15 minutes to a mall just 5 minutes away (and next to the golf course which has hourly shuttles only) that has a plethora of stores, including a grocery store and pharmacy and 3 brand name restaurants if you want to eat off the resort.

I had to call often to get my mini bar replenished with pop and water as they didn't seem to regularly replace the pop and water I had drunk. That being said, they did respond promptly when called.

If it wasn't for the terrible customer service experience I am going to describe below I would probably have rated the Palma as average to slightly above average and recommended it to others. But, unfortunately, I can't do that.

The Terrible:

I had brought $300 US with me. On the 2nd or 3rd day there I went to buy some small items at the only store on the Resort property (apparently managed by a 3rd party). I paid with a $100 US bill and received four $20's US and change in return. Unbeknownst to me, as I wasn't paying close attention, one of the $20 bills had been taped back together. When I tried to use it at the nearby Mall the clerk refused to accept it. So I went back to the resort store and explained the situation to them and politely requested they exchange the bill for me. They refused on the basis that they had to know which cashier had given it to (I had told them it wasn't't anyone working currently). They explained that the other cashiers worked opposite shifts and asked me to come back the next day so see if I could recognize the cashier when that crew was working. Though I thought this completely unnecessary I remained polite and patient and agreed to come back the next day. The next day I couldn't recognize the cashier either and they said that unless I could provide a receipt to prove my purchase and allow them to review the security footage to confirm the transaction they would't exchange the bill. I told them I couldn't do that and requested they review the tapes themselves to find the transaction. They agreed and told me to come back again the next day. 

When I did come back the next day they produced footage of someone that didn't look anything like me buying a lot more items than I did. This appeared to me to be an attempt by them to claim that my story was fabricated and I wouldn't have gotten the bill from them to justify them not exchanging the bill. At this point it was obvious the situation was not going to be resolved and I told them I was going to speak to hotel management.

That caused a bit of a stir as they called ahead to tell their side of the story. I ended up dealing with Domingo the guest services manager. Domingo was great. Even though he initially reiterated the store's request for proof after I advised him the bill was legal tender and acceptable at any bank as way as making the case that security footage wouldn't really prove anything because it wasn't of good enough quality to see tape on the bill he agreed to have the bill taken to the bank for me (instead of me having to spend the time and money to do so) and asked that I come back an hour later. This whole conversation lasted 5 minutes and the situation was resolved. If the staff at the store had any customer service skills at all they would have made the same offer initially instead of requiring me to come back 3 times and refusing to do anything.

I'm giving both the store staff and Domingo some slack here because they both wanted verification (receipt/bank acceptance) as opposed to just a straightforward exchange but we were dealing in a foreign currency so I can accept they wanted to be sure the bank would take it. But refusing to help me at all, as the store staff did, was totally unacceptable.

If the story had ended here because Domingo was such a gentleman and professional I probably wouldn't bother to mention the whole incident. It's what happened next why I will never stay again at the Palma and can't recommend it to anyone.

The next day I used the resort ATM to get Dominican money. I went to the Resort Casino to exchange it for US dollars. I then tried to pay for something at the Resort store using one of the $20 bills I had gotten from the Casino. The cashier examined the bill like she was a Mint employee. She refused to accept the bill claiming it was to old or some other nonsense. It was quite obvious that not only was the store never going to help me to begin with with the original $20 bill they now considered me the problem and didn't want my business despite this all being entirely their fault.

I immediately asked to speak with a hotel manager and was referred to a pleasant and emphatic young man who was the front desk Supervisor. When told the story and shown the bill in question he agreed there was nothing wrong with it and that I shouldn't have been treated this way. I asked him 2 things. Speak to the staff at the store and give me some token form of compensation. He said he would look into it and come back later.

When I did come back he said he had spoken to the store manager who had held an impromptu staff meeting and that this wouldn't happen again. Furthermore, the store manager was supposed to contact me to apologize. He was non-committal when I asked for token compensation again, politely I might add.

I never was contacted by the store manager and never received any token compensation. I will never stay at the Palma again because of this highly insulting situation which they didn't handle very well and failed basic customer service 101 in the pro

reviews.author: Mo C
reviews.title: Nightmare, robberies, run down rooms, bad service
reviews.text:
Please do not spend your money here.  
Too many things to list but I have traveled a lot and stayed at many all inclusive resorts and other wonderful places.  This one is not one to visit.  We were robbed, safes don’t work, rooms are not in good repair, doors don’t lock, no working coffee pots for the entire stay, watched two men break into a room and rob that room.  Food is just edible.  Nowhere to order food unless you go to restaurants when they are open.  Dirty pools, angry, resentful staff, plumbing is failing in rooms.

reviews.author: precioush32
reviews.title: Just when I thought I would until I saw the GREED
reviews.text:
First let me say I've been a member since 2013. I've been to this property 3x and have had a wonderful time the 1st and 2nd. The 3rd, I was thinking this is great, I see alot of changes and improvements. They have a new program called the circle and I was considering it being that I was so impressed with all the newness!!! So two things happened today that make me second guess what I initially felt.
1. I went to the circle (new program) to get my account summary, so I could look it over myself to see where I was and to see if I could afford more. Well, when I went to get it, the manager had it in his hand. So, naturally I stick my hand out to get it and he puts his hand back. So, he only wanted to give me the first page with my name and information but not the other 2 pages. He took the first page off and gave it to me, being that the three were stapled together. I was confused why he didn't want to give me MY paperwork. So, in frustration I attempted to gave the first page back. With an attitude he gave me the other 2 pages. I went on to look at the account summary and saw that I only had 17 months left to pay the remainder of my balance. Now, I know why he didn't want to give it to me.
Pure Greed. This is how you treat your members. I don't want no part of it. Greedy

2. Greedy casino people. The machine malfunctions and they don't know how to use the machines. They didn't want to give me my money that was owed. Greedy. They don't understand English well. Don't hire people who don't understand English or don't know how to read it. The machine clearly stated what was owed to me but if you can't read English you can't be of customer service. Greedy. It's a shame. There are cameras all around the place but no one took the time to see what actions happened at the machine. Instead, would look at me as if I was trying to get over on them. Really, $11.30!!!
 
The Greed is real, I guess my $11.30 helped the circle, lol.

reviews.author: Stacie P
reviews.title: Most disappointing trip
reviews.text:
We traveled as my husbands bonus trip (he’s in sales) so we were with at least 30 other couples. Every person we talked to had the same experiences. It started with our room not being ready at 4pm when we finally arrived, mediocre buffet food at most restaurants, rude staff, horrendous language barrier ... you expect some but most servers didn’t understand “decaf”, royal service was a JOKE... our butler told us he made dinner reservations only to show up and there are none. This happened to many others and often they were told “sorry not my problem”. There is no food service at the pool or beach. In fact our butler told us food is not allowed at either place. Our adults only area had young teens. Rooms are very dated, only 3 tv channels are English, our bathroom mirror only had 1 out of 4 lights working, electric outlet in bathroom would not hold hair dryer plug, our butler never checked in with us we always had to reach out to him (he was over booked with guests IMO). I could go on and on ... the best part? My husbands co paid for this, had we paid ourselves we likely would be demanding a refund. 

Pros: Yhi Spa... amazing especially Matilde.
Beach and water is beautiful.
Passions restaurant AMAZING although not part of the all inclusive it is TOTALLY worth every penny.

reviews.author: globalmessenger
reviews.title: Mother/daughter getaway
reviews.text: The worst most convoluted service. Starting with they didn’t have our reservation since we made it via Expedia. I guess they don’t like that. Then there was no room at the Reserve where we had booked so we had to stay elsewhere on the property. By the time we got to our room it was two hours and five people later. And it appears that everyone’s looking for a tip even though it was their mistake that took us through five people!  And this place is expensive. Our first dinner reservation: they didn’t have it even though our concierge insisted they must. The restaurant turned us away without alternatives. Can’t figure out why the restaurant reservations are such a colossal mess here. You can’t make them until you get here and then the times and restaurants you want are all taken. We booked a massage but they failed to tell us that the girls hadn’t shown up until we were waiting for 40 minutes! For three days our room wasn’t serviced when we returned from the beach at 4pm. And on and on.

reviews.author: zal f
reviews.title: Bad costumer service
reviews.text:
I booked a full stay all inclusive for 5 days for a junior suite true booking.com and I entered 2 person's however at checkout it somehow haven't asked me to take make sure if it is 2 person's so it ended up only confirmed for 1 person very weird because who is going to book a full suit for a single person
Then when I arrived thy didn't wanna add my wife only if I pay additional 250 per day for my wife and when I showed them that even if I will now go back to booking I will pay the same price for 1 and 2 person's they said they don't care and they can't help me and I need to pay them the additional fee I called booking and thy said that in normal places this would be fixed easy by the hotel but in my place there was no one to talk about it and the workers don't care less to help me and I ended up paying always double the amount and no one to talk to and I couldn't even cancel my old booking because thy won't give me back the money this is very unfortunate and bad service in my eyes and no good costumer service at all very bad

reviews.author: Amziefly
reviews.title: Moldy resort room 1074
reviews.text: Staff did an amazing job cleaning everyday so there was no visible source of mold, but she the air was thick with it. If we wouldn't have brought our own sheets I have no doubt I would have been more sick!!  After being there one day I developed severe sinus congestion and severe bronchitis. Every morning I was worse. We spent our days away from the room which helped me clear but it didn't resolve. I have washed my clothes 6 times and they still smell like mildew. I'm pretty sure the dry cleaners will not be able to get the smell out of my dresses that were hanging in the closet. If you stay here and have a moldy smelling room DO NOT hesitate to ask for another room!!  A person with less than perfect lungs, or having allergies to mold could have life threatening effects given the severity of my reaction and I have neither of those things. My vacation was not good because of my health.  It's been over a week and my lungs are still not fully healed.

reviews.author: elvn
reviews.title: Buyer beware
reviews.text:
I don’t often write reviews, but as I lay here awake on my last night with some strange generator noise outside the window, I can’t help but vent a bit. 
 
The pros and cons:
Cons:
1.  Room not ready until 530 pm. I’ve travelled to many resorts and this is something that I have never experienced. As this was my first time with kids, we needed a room to get them all settled ASAP. Moreover, we had Royal Service. Haha. What a joke. Normally you are greeted with a nice hand towel and drink at other resorts. Am I missing something? Did others get greeted differently??

The first room they gave us had a horrible musty smell. Anyway, off to another room we went and I hoped for the best. 

In between all this, we ate some horrible food at Gabis buffet. Oh and btw, no one mentioned that it would take 4 hours to get our bags so I had to keep running to our bags to get baby food. 
And for those of you who know how big the resort it, that’s a long run to the front. Apparently Vladimir thought it was fine,and the room would be ready very soon. 

2. The food is some of the worst I’ve ever had. 
I can expect a meal or two to not be to my liking, but literally EVERY SINGLE meal was awful. For such an expensive resort, I can’t understand what went wrong?!!  I have no food allergies and I’m not picky by any means. Even the pancakes were mushy in the middle. Im not expecting Fairmont level food but dear goodness, I ate mostly bread. Kids meals were awful. My son barely ate and he is an amazing eater. 

3. Diarrhea: I have it, my two year old has it and my 7 month old has it. I’ve taken my kids to Mexico and Greece and never experienced such an awful GI bug. Now grant it the resort may have nothing to do with this, but I can’t tell if it’s the food or something infectious. 

4. Rolling power outages. As I stayed in the room with all the sick kids a fair amount, I can attest to the power coming and going MANY times a day. Thankfully we only lost AC
for one afternoon, but of course as you all now I have a baby, and of course it was during his nap that I had no air conditioning, so guess how that went with no AC: CRAP. I have NEVER had a resort not have continuous power. 

5. The rooms are just pitiful. Drips from the ceiling with constant wet floors, where I just slipped and almost hit my head. Because of the drips. What is dripping, I’m not sure? Here are some awesome pics. Does this look like a 5 star bathroom. 

6.  Awful alcohol, poor mini bar, and they charge for room service even when you pay for the all inclusive???!!!

Pros:

Honestly, just the weather. The resort is too big for my liking. 

Oh wait, and the gym that I used twice before I got sick. 

Please if you’re a mum, don’t come here. You need to have an amazing room, mums. You will not. This will bug you to no end.

reviews.author: beachgbr
reviews.title: If you like mice
reviews.text: If you like mice and bugs this is the hotel for you! First night the safe didn’t work and had cockroaches. We had to stay in the room while they worked on the safe so our first night was shot. Second night the mice came. The resort did nothing to resolve any issues they just pretend to not understand or say they are sending someone then no one shows. The spa lost our reservations so we had to pay twice, the spa receptionist was very rude. The WiFi in the rooms doesn’t work. And now we are at home with weird bites and having stomach issues.

reviews.author: Nicole J
reviews.title: Would NEVER stay here again
reviews.text: First off,  the staff is INCREDIBLY rude.  This is everyone from the front desk, to the bartenders.  Food is mediocre and very repetitive as far as options.  There were renovations going on all over the property.  People on ladders, places roped off that you had to work around.  The smell of paint was horrible and was all over the entire resort.  You could even smell paint when you were dinning in the restaurants.  Not many things for older children and teens at night.  It supposed to be all inclusive, but they charge you every time you order room service, and if you want to go to a few of the restaurants on property as well. Also, there was only lower end quality alcohol choices. I would spend my money elsewhere, even if it wasn't "all-inclusive".

reviews.author: Douglas T
reviews.title: Want to throw your $$money$$ away. GO HERE !!!!
reviews.text: After visiting this resort 8 times, we saw it drop dramatically in every possible way you could imagine. It's as if they were advertising STAY HERE and we guarantee to DISAPPOINT you in everyway possible. Because we stayed there multiple times, staff that we began to know told us that the new management did not care about the staff on the front line and were abusing them. NO GUFF !!! This resort use to be a paradise and now it's THIRD WORLD. There is nothing worse than watching staff who are being treated inappropriately by BAD MANAGEMENT. So we won't blame the bad taste in our mouth that the resort left us with, we'll blame the management and corporation who obviously want the MUCHO DINERO'S but will make sure that they SKINP on every necessity that can make for a wonderful vacation. SHAME ON YOU PALMA REAL

reviews.author: Jacqueline M
reviews.title: Not as expected
reviews.text:
Rooms need total renovation.  Poor service.  Staff acted rude and had bad attitude towards the guests as if you were not paying for the service.
Boni  and Eugenia were the only hotel staff who were friendly and tried to make our stay better.
Do no t stay in this hotel, it is not 5 stars.

reviews.author: barbara2223
reviews.title: Only For Families
reviews.text:
I requested Royal Service and the only thing I received was terrible service.   I am recovering from a serious illness and was told this was for the ADULT only swimming pool.  This was note enforced. Didn’t care that the only thing I requested ICE was not in my room that I had to go each day to make my own dinner reservations each day far from my room.
But that the employee are so nice they do not want to tell people that the private pool was private. I became the person who told them. It was the most unsatisfactory hotel I have ever stayed

reviews.author: G j
reviews.title: NOT WORTH THE MONEY !!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Reserve at Paradisus Punta Canca for New year's eve. We were thoroughly dissatisfied. First of all, the concierge would push you to make reservation for dinner at places which are not sought after. The food is really bad ( the sushi place is an exception). The italian restaurant is a joke. The Fueglo is one which had decent food. The Vento was also below average. The breakfast was so crowded - we could not get a table to be seated for over 15 minutes and had to stand in line. The room we got was just above the dance floor and I paid a premium for this !!!. They were partying till midnight every night and had loud music blasting. Overall I paid a premium for the Reserve ocean front room and had to deal with this loud music just below my bed. I will not recommend this place to anyone. There are much better places to stay and you can pay half this price !!

reviews.author: kennedybek
reviews.title: Epic Disappointment, Choose Somewhere Else
reviews.text:
We booked this trip through our travel agent for 17 people for our parent's 50th Wedding Anniversary. Being together was enjoyable, but the resort was not 5 star quality by any means, not anywhere in that vicinity. The management was the worst anyone in our family has ever experienced. An agreement of a refund of one night for three of the rooms was finally reached, but honestly that didn't begin to cover what it should have because dealing with the problems ate up almost my entire trip. Here is a breakdown. I would read carefully so maybe you could avoid, but ultimately our whole family would beg you to choose somewhere else.

-Arrive Christmas Day: Bell hop goes with us to the rooms with our luggage. Keys do not work so he uses a master key and tells us to get new ones at the front desk. This happens for our room and our college kids room. Both of our rooms have empty beer cans under the bed, half finished soda and water bottles and mini bars that are basically empty. I notice tattered rugs and walls, curtains, mirrors that look worn and stained and not in ways that would be like that because of the hurricanes.

-Later that night we get new keys made. Our room key works. Our daughters' room doesn't. One daughter goes back to the front desk and is told someone will come. They sit outside the room for an hour. We were trying to reach other via cell phones but had issues. When we finally did and my husband and I discovered they were still sitting outside their room, we went back to the front desk. No one seem concerned and just wanted to make a new set of keys. We demanded someone come to the room with us. He did and keys wouldn't work so he used his master key. I explained the leftover food and drinks and that the room phones weren't working. I didn't feel comfortable leaving the girls in the room with no phone in case of an emergency and no room key, but we did after we were able to get their cell phones working reliably.

-Day Two - as each member of my extended family arrives, the problems continue. Room keys not working, getting sent to the wrong rooms. My brother and his family had two rooms. One they were informed wouldn't be ready until after 8pm because they gave the guests a late check out and couldn't kick them out of the room. My sister and her family didn't have their rooms ready either, but their wait was only till about 5pm. Note no one was asking for early access to rooms. Everyone arrived after 3pm. 

-My husband and I met with a manager (Care Team) Vladimir who said he would be responsible for the rest of the trip to ensure our problems were resolved. Being that so much time was spent with room issues, non-working keys, used beer bottles, etc Vladimir said he would arrange all our dinners for the rest of the trip. We provided him with the restaurant requests and times. That never happened. The first restaurant had no record of our reservation and after an hour wait with young kids, Eugenia assisted our family and did so for the rest of the trip. My sister and her husband speak fluent Spanish and Eugenia is from Toledo Spain where my sister used to live. They connected and we had dinner plans covered from there on. Nothing Vladimir did in regard to this happened. Our thanks to the lovely Eugenia.

-When my parents arrived on 12/26 they had similar issues with the room keys. Within the first evening they had to have the key redone multiple times each time requiring a back and forth walk from the lobby to their room. At the end of the evening around 11p, they left the lobby bar and had the front desk make a new set of keys. They went to their room, and it didn't work again. Walked back to lobby and were told someone would meet them at their room. No one came. My parents did not get into their room until 1:30am!!! This is seriously terrible.The resort owners and management should be horrified that they would treat guests like this.
 
12/27- My parents spent until almost noon with someone repairing the lock on their room. Everyone in our family was dealing with other issues that morning so it wasn't as if we were leaving our parents to handle this on their own. And note the keys kept intermittently working for their room for the rest of the trip so we estimate between 7 to 10 other trips for new keys for their room alone.

My bother's second room did not have a working deadbolt lock and actually if you turned the handle on the outside of the room you could just walk in. For the entire duration of the trip this was not repaired, even though we kept contacting Vladimir and the front desk about it.

-My husband and I met with an entire team of management from the resort. We explained all of the issues in detail, were told repeatedly that they were sorry from the bottom of their heart and to please know from here on out everything will be taken care of. We requested some compensation for the issues (4 rooms, one night each). We were told someone would get back to us. When going to our room to get ready for dinner that day (remember this was the reservation that ended up not even existing although Vladimir kept saying it did) I discovered there was no running water in our room. Back to the front lobby we went. Vladimir and his manager were there and came to our room. Soon after water was returned. Then we were told that they spoke to corporate in Spain and what they could do is give us a private dinner for our family. Seriously, we already have dinner included in this trip. I was at this point I was spending 75% of my time at this awful resort dealing with all the issues. That doesn't include the time every other adult on our trip was having to deal with also. I was just doing the bulk of it. My husband and I said the dinner offer was unacceptable. (Note throughout this we were in touch with our travel agent who was in communication with the resort management.) 

-Later that night my husband was cornered in the lobby and presented with a legal document that stated they would refund two nights at the resort, but he had to sign the form right then. Kevin said he needed to have a copy of the document to review it, but was told they wouldn't make a copy so he asked that they text a pic of it. Eventually he received a partial pic, but it certainly didn't include all of it. Our travel agent advised us not to sign it as it was unusual and that she was working with the travel group and resort to figure out an agreement. We then were stalked by management for days. Literally waiting for us outside places and putting on a lot of pressure.

-Issues continued..rooms not cleaned, mini bars not stocked, broken ironing board with a disgusting stained cover, broken phones,no hot water, painting walls with no signs so paint got all over daughter's shirt sleeve, tattered beach chairs, low quality food, cheap liquor, and it goes on.

-To top it all off, my parents needed a new set of keys again the final night. (Also note, the entire door lock system was completely replaced on their door on 12/27, which obviously did nothing). At 10:40pm they went to the front desk to get new keys.They went to their room and keys didn't work. Walked back to the front lobby and were told someone would come to the room to fix it. No one came. Back to the lobby. The man working at the front desk told my father that it was unusual that the keys weren't working. (Note that they informed us there was a system malfunction the first day 12/25 but it had been fixed resort-wide by 12/26 so anything but unusual). My father's response was that it wasn't unusual as it had been a problem again and again over the trip. The response to my father was "Don't speak to me in that tone of voice." Honestly, I cannot even believe this was said. My parents never yelled or probably even raised their voices while dealing with all theses issues. When they finally got someone to let them in their room it was 12:40am. TWO HOURS. Second time this trip that they couldn't get into their room until 1am.

-The management of this resort is in no other words THE ABSOLUTE WORST.  I spent an exhaustive amount of time trying to deal with this and ensure a wonderful time for our family despite everything. Our travel agent and the travel company spent significant time also advocating on our behalf. Of course, I wish this place had never been recommended by them in the first place.

-There certainly were some lovely people at the resort including Eugenia who arranged our dinner reservations, Maximo, a photographer who took great family pics for my parent's 50th,Theresa,one of the housekeepers and a couple others who I wish i could recall their names.

-No explanation of a faulty key system accounts for taking two hours to get guests access to their rooms, tattered beach furniture, unclean rooms with food from previous guests, rude management, so many empty promises and so many more issues it is too exhaustive to print.

I have never written anything like this before, but this situation absolutely deserves it. Like I said in the beginning - Don't stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. If you have to, read this so you can be aware of the problems.

reviews.author: Reetu D
reviews.title: Poor value for the amount you will spend to stay there
reviews.text: Very disappointed with the poor room quality.  Expect to hear your neighbors at all hours.  You should also understand that there is a "caste system" and those who pay more will get better treatment, restaurant reservations, etc.  I will not be going back.

reviews.author: Pathfinder745549
reviews.title: Painting while having dinner
reviews.text: We came to paradisus 2 years ago, we came back with the thought of finding what we left and we were very disappointed to see areas being painted a day before Christmas while people are dining.  There are families including ourselves on vacation and workers are spray painting while people are dining, only a few feet from us.  A big compressor stationed in the dining area is the music good the night.  I decided to go to the lounge area were I was greeted by a painter touching up the furniture , to my amusement a couple sat down in the same spot only to get paint in there clothes.  The emplyees are very nice, but management could use a but more of common sense and avoid this work in high season.  This will be my last teip to any of there resorts.   This place is a bit pricy and didn't expect this.  Save your money and go to your local town construction site to get the same experience we are having.

reviews.author: kelockhart
reviews.title: Very disappointing
reviews.text: I know many people have given this hotel high ratings but our experience has not been a positive one. From the moment we got here the service has been poor. They insisted on delivering our bags to the room and said it would be 5 minutes. 1 1/2 hours later we went back to the front and found our bags still outside. A concierge took us to a bar and said he would be back in 3 minutes and he never came back. We left after 30 minutes. We had reservations at Fuego. The restaurant was not busy yet we ordered and over an hour later our food did not come. Finally we left and went to the buffet. We are in Building 38 and it is in pretty rough shape. These are pictures from today. We travel often but this trip is a Christmas gift to my children who are I. college and I cherish my time with them. I am so sad about the conditions but making the most of it.

reviews.author: Patrick J
reviews.title: Not as good as other Paradisus locations
reviews.text:
Stayed at the reserve section. During check in, we were asked to pay extra money in order to stay in the room we booked (2 beds vs one bed) for four people (2 adults 2 kids)
Told by the front desk it is the quietest room of the resort but we got waked up every night by loud party music out side of the window at 2AM.
Wife fell into the flamingo pool when pose next to a bench for picture. No warning sign or rails along the pool to alert people. Dangerous rocks in pool can cause serious injury. 
Room condition is horrible. Not 5 star but more like 3.5 star. Room is big but lack of maintenance. Shower jet head fell off at the first time use and no repair was done.
Making dinner reservation is painful with a process belongs to last century. need to bring paper work to check availability and make reservation. 
lots to post but don't want to waste more time to remember all the bad experiences there.
If there is something keep me stay there is the crew at Gabi Grill. They were fantastic. Other than that, nothing worth to stay in memory.

reviews.author: Jonathan S.
reviews.title: There are thieves among us!
reviews.text: I guess this is really my 3rd time writing this review and I have no idea why its continuously deleted.  Well I will make this one short and sweet and straight to the point.  Someone who worked at the hotel stole my AMEX card and ran up a tab that I couldn't believe at the 3 local gas stations.  It made me feel very unsafe and vulnerable being in a foreign country.  I felt like my best interest was not taken seriously.  It pretty much ruined my entire trip.  I was offered some concessions but I guess this is the part where I need to not say what they were, but I will say this.  I travel to places with the keen understanding that I will be safe and protected at all times no matter what especially since I'm paying top dollar.  This incident was the highlight of my stay knowing that the people who decided to take my credit cards knew my entire itinerary of what I was doing through out the day.  Its sad...but what is needed is definitely some extra measures from this hotel to provide a safer and more secure environment as to how they need to handle customers information.  With that being said, I will NEVER go back until these measures are corrected.  So if ever at this hotel, be very careful to who you talk to and whats written down and how they collect information from you.

reviews.author: Javier L
reviews.title: Marketing puro para venderte como exclusivo un cuatro estrellas del montón
reviews.text:
.
Lleno de obras, de barro de camiones de empleados maleducados que te intentan dar abrazos y chocar la mano a la voz de hola familia.
En fin nada funciona como debería. Es todo fachada.
Llegaba el dueño y parecía la mili; todos pintando y blanqueando el lugar. El all inclusive que vale 100 euros por persona y día es lamentable, peor que un menú del dia de cualquier bareto de tu ciudad.
El mantenimiento es calamitoso, las puertas y ventanas cierran mal, la calidad de la construcción, de los acabados y de los muebles es pésima. Las toallas viejas y así casi todo.
es un all inclusive y los alimentos son pésimos, Todo sabe igual, da lo mismo el Teppanyaki, el buffet o el steak house, todo sale de la misma cocina central.
Las bebidas no son premium y los vinos lamentables a 100 euros por persona y día.

reviews.author: Anthony F
reviews.title: Most boring vacation
reviews.text: As the Caribbeans are supposed to be a happy place,  where people go to have a great time. The Paradisus Palma Real is a resort where you can sleep for your whole vacation.  No music during the day at the swim up bar pool. No music at night. If you like going to bed at 8 this place is for you, just not for me.

reviews.author: Viejoby
reviews.title: This hotel stinks!!!!
reviews.text:
The service is very bad, bad attitude from almost 100% of the staff.
No lunch or snack bar they just close everything from 2 to 6 pm and tough luck is the attitude of the employees.
The room’s maintenance needs a lot of improvement.
The checkout was a pain we could not even get the invoice done correctly.
The pool hours are absurd, kids tough luck again.

reviews.author: Andrew Monda
reviews.title: I'm going to hope that this place & its service was this bad due to off season ?
reviews.text:
First and foremost.. I'd like to say... this resort is best suited for a family with kids. I did not realize the extent until I found myself next to crying and/or screaming babies during each and every meal. If you are looking for either a romantic, or quiet, or a "party" type resort.. please look elsewhere.. 

There were many issues which made this stay less than pleasant... here are some of them...

Dining -  out of the 13 or so Restaurants... 3 of them are not included in the all inclusive package, and all but 4 of the rest of them were closed indefinitely (Would have been nice to know this before I booked).   
   One might think that dining is at your own discretion... one would be very mistaken. You cannot walk into a restaurant without a reservation which can only be made 12 hours in advance, and most of the time, they cannot accommodate you at the restaurant nor the time you wish. Make sure you make all your reservations for your stay as soon as you check-in! Also... you cannot make reservations by phone, nor the concierge in your building... you have to walk to the (restaurant-concierge) desk outside of the buffet.  There is a 1 restaurant limit per meal.   As far as the food itself.. I have no complaints,  it was OK... nothing special... you can't get any good steak cuts or lobster pieces without paying a hefty premium. 
 
Alcohol - It was mostly easy to grab a drink throughout our stay... just keep in mind that the vodka is limited to SKYY or Stoli.. anything top shelf is either an additional charge or part of their "royal service" which we also did not know about nor were we explained at check-in.

Service/Staff - The second we checked in.. the concierge asked us if we wanted any alcohol or items to be sent to our room.. We asked for a bottle of Vodka... it never arrived.
  The first night of our stay... we notice a puddle coming from the bathroom (AC unit in ceiling/roof had been badly leaking. We called concierge.. they came promptly to fix the unit... had to come again the next day...  however, it was never fixed.. We ended up shutting if off for half the day to avoid condensation... so really.. they never should have given us a room with a broken AC in first place, or... should have at least asked us if we would like to switch rooms to one that does not come with a slip & slide.
Also.. the location of the room... although close to the pool.. had less than zero view, and was a third floor room. There is no elevator... and three flights of stairs with bags can be quite the workout...so I'm guessing if you are immobile or geriatric.. you would want to request ground level room.. or maybe a pre-workout ?
 We also experienced 3 random power outages during out stay (which you can't blame the hotel for) but still very inconvenient... especially when I'm sitting on the toilet and it's pitch black.

Entertainment - The hotel.. for the most part.. was kind of on the boring side... It would be nice if they had an itinerary, daily briefing, or at the very least a chalkboard.. we were completely in the dark about any and all activities and usually had to ask more than one employee what was going on before we got an answer.  We were told that the "Melia App"  had all that information.. however... I downloaded it and rendered it useless... maybe it was down ?  
    The Saturday night beach party was the highlight of the stay... very skilled dancers and a great all-around show... in fact... the dancers / entertainers really went the extra mile and were very friendly. This also goes for most of the bartenders and waters around the Gabi Beach Club, and the staff of "the grille"
 Also.. to get to where the "entertainment and most of the restaurants and the actual beach are... you need to take a trolley/golf cart, which really comes every 15-20 minutes or a 10 minute walk from your room.

Now for the icing on the cake.. checking out... A process that should have been instant.. took over 30 minutes.. as apparently the credit card machine was down during check-in.. so they had to run my card again while I was leaving.. but it was down this time as well.. so the concierge had to walk with me to the main lobby (through outside pouring rain) so they could run my card in their back office.

Hope that helps with your decision.. this is knowledge I would have wanted to know before booking.

reviews.author: TStr8
reviews.title: Huge resort. Terrible food & service.
reviews.text: This was a family vacation with two children 4y & 6y. The rooms are really far away from the main area. Reservations for restaurants were impossible to obtain. Main food at buffets were bland and boring. Pools were freezing. Beach was nice size, but a lot of selling going on down there. Security is a joke here and no English stations on their televisions. Smoking in main bar was a large disappointment.

reviews.author: mrlgator
reviews.title: Do Not Stay Here
reviews.text: The most unprofessional hotel. Booked a room in March, paid in full, non refundable rate. Check in was fine, when I checked out of my room the front desk told us that we needed to pay for the room AGAIN because they made a mistake on the room rate. They held us hostage and refused to let us leave the hotel until we paid for the room a second time.  If the hotel made a mistake call us in advance and let us cancel our room before we fly thousands of miles.  They pretty much shook us down.

reviews.author: Lara C
reviews.title: TRAVELERS BEWARE, ADDITIONAL FEES AT CHECKOUT
reviews.text:
I've just returned from a 3 day trip to Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. I attended a wedding and booked my room using the link provided by the hotel management. **The room was booked directly through the hotel, not on a third party booking site** My reservation was made for one room with two adults. At the time of booking I was charged a flat, nonrefundable rate for an all inclusive weekend (prepaid). There was no mention anywhere of any additional, mandatory fees. 

Upon checking in to the hotel, I was told I owed additional money. I showed the attendant my reservation confirmation, which showed the prepaid rate for two adults, and I was able to check in without paying any additional fees, as the attendant agreed it was a mistake. 

Upon checking out of the hotel I was told I would not be able to leave without paying an additional fee of $270.00 for "all inclusive services". I was told the hotel made a mistake and I was not originally charged the correct rate. The hotel was now charging me the difference because the rate they advertised was incorrect.

I was essentially stuck at the hotel until I agreed to pay this fee, because no taxi service will take you to the airport without a checkout card provided by the hotel. I watched several guests go through the same ordeal upon checking out and all had no option but to pay the fee. 

It's also worth noting that I paid for an extra night on my reservation because I initially planned to arrive a day earlier. Since the rate was considered prepaid and nonrefundable, I was not able to change my dates and had to pay for the extra night. Understanding that it was my mistake, I did not argue the extra night. This is one of the reasons I find it unacceptable that the hotel then charged me for their mistake. 

I plan to dispute the charge with my credit card company since it should not be legal for a hotel to market a specific rate, charge a prepaid amount, and then not allow you to leave the property without paying additional fees.

reviews.author: Traveler1
reviews.title: Will never come back here
reviews.text: I am one that reads a lot of reviews and understand some people have different experiences.  In my case, I was duped by a non US company and I think you all should know to stay away.  I booked my room online and paid in full for my reservation.  I had my receipt and all that said “paid in full.”  When I arrived, they told me this was only a 50% deposit and I owed another half.  No one would read my email or listen to me, all they wanted was my credit card.  There was nothing I can do, so I gave it to them and tried to enjoy my stay.  I have some positive things to say but I’m not because they ruined it.  This is total extortion and I will never return.  Go somewhere else or at least an American company who understands how things run.  Attached are some fun things I found in my room.  Not worth the expensive price paid.  Bug on bed, dirty sheet, someone’s leftover coffee grounds, ripped carpet, and patchy water damaged roof.  These people should be ashamed of themselves.  Spend your money elsewhere, please!!

reviews.author: Blanca P
reviews.title: Hotel PARADISUS palma real
reviews.text:
Decidí pasar en el sector Royal Service mis vacaciones para tener la tranquilidad que me vendieron, cobraron.  Al llegar al hotel y luego de hacer el check in, compruebo que todo el hotel está en obra con golpes desde las 8 am y el sector de Royal Service invadido por obreros que hablan a los gritos y hacen imposible estar en ese sector. No hay toallas a mano, nadie pregunta si queres tomar algo. En la playa hay un sector ocupado con las cosas de construcción y cómo si eso fuera poco nos informan que a partir de mañana cerrarán el sector por lo cual el lugar tranquilo y soñado deberá ser suplantado por la pileta comunitaria con niños. ME SIENTO ESTAFADA, en ningún momento el hotel me aviso en las condiciones que se encontraba, ni siquiera al momento del check in. El resto del hotel también está en reparaciones, lo cual hay que cambiar el uso de las instalaciones. En el buffet no hay gente en su lugar de trabajo, faltan jugos, no hay quien te sirva las cosas del mostrador, etc. El servicio en las mesas es pésimo, al momento de desayunar las mesas están preparadas con cuchillo y tenedor, no cambian los cubiertos y no hay un lugar donde tomarlos, sirven el café sin cuchara o sea hay q revolver con el dedo. Mi opinión es que el SERVICIO ES PÉSIMO , ya estoy harta de escuchar la palabra DISCULPE, aunque cabe destacar que la arquitectura es hermosa

Blanca perez

reviews.author: Aline Tatiana G
reviews.title: Aburrido!
reviews.text:
Después de 3 años volví al Paradisus Palma Real porque para mí era el hotel de mis suenos. Pues bien, ERA!
Que tristeza, que decepción. Desde que llegamos la atención era cualquier cosa, jamás nos ofrecieron o nos informaron sobre los otros servicios o habitaciones superiores que tienen en el hotel. Con gusto cambiaría, porque la nuestra era antigua y fea. Las almohadas de plumas olían muy mal. Nos asignaron una concierge que se llamaba Reina, que al 2do día que le dijimos que no participariamos de su reunión de venta porque ya la habíamos hecho, no nos hizo más caso. Jamás nos llamó ni nos entregó los cheques que lo fuimos a retirar el último día porque un huésped nos dijo.
No tiene vida nocturna. Es aburrido y a las 10 cortan la música. Tienen Un noche de Jazz (en serio alguien se va a Rep. Dominicana para escuchar Jazz?) casi nos dormimos. No había música. Tuve que irme hasta el Shopping y comprar un Speaker para escuchar música.
El equipo de animación es excelente, pero eso de solamente hacer clase de danza todo el día es del pasado. Nadie quiere hacer y no hay interacción.
La comida: Mucho para no tener nada. Repetido en todos los sectores. Cucarachas y ratones había en el buffet. Reclame dos días consecutivos a dos personas diferentes y como no obtuve respuesta me pareció que era algo común. Un asco! No coman nada frio, porque Era ahí dónde siempre estaban.
No pierdan su tiempo con los restaurantes a La Carta. 
Mi consejo es: Busquen otro hotel!

reviews.author: queenangeln
reviews.title: Terrible.
reviews.text: Please do NOT come here unless you want your belongings STOLEN FROM YOUR ROOM. I stayed here for 4 days and on the last night, I came back to my hotel room to find that my entire WALLET with cash, ID, credit cards and my iPhone have been TAKEN FROM MY ROOM!!!! Unbelievable. I saw other reviews of this hotel warning me of this, I should have listened.

reviews.author: Pat_and_Girls
reviews.title: One of our worst family vacations
reviews.text:
Few words about the resort :
- one of the first resort built by Melia in DR, even with a good maintenance, you feel that the resort need rest
- the Reserve itself is quite far from the beach and since the Gaby Bar is under maintenance you need to go to the beach for every meals except if you enjoy eating in a blind room during your vacations...
- the room are ok if you are lucky, in our case we had to change due to noise coming from the city all night long
- the service is just ok in average, I mean some guys are very helpful and very nice, some are let's say just not motivated to make you happy. The service in Mexico is just night and day
- the food is ... let's worth the famous all you can eat for $3...in other words Terrible with a specific reward for Mole with the worst "mexican" food I've ever ate
- the beach is full of sea weed so you can look at it but do not try to swim
- golf : the Resort tells you that it's included they just do not mention that you pay €65 for the cart so considering the poor quality of the golf course, you can play elsewhere !
As a conclusion : 
- food : horrible
- beach : not good
- resort : just ok
- golf : not good
- service : ok
- weather : nice
Next vacations : elsewhere and likely not with Melia !

reviews.author: Irene W
reviews.title: Nightmare
reviews.text: Everything was bad.  Everything.  I can deal with bad, the beach is there.  What I could not deal with was the lack of security.  No dead bolt locks on the inside of the room.  Hotel personal would wonder in when they pleased, caught my beau but naked coming out of the shower.  Even better they would leave your door wide open when the room was unoccupied.  There is nothing worse than being scared due to lack of security in a foreign place.

reviews.author: Marcel C
reviews.title: Buena Estructura, pésimo servicio
reviews.text:
El hotel está ubicando en una excelente playa tropical y tiene buena estructura. Sin embargo, el servicio es malísimo! El motivo de mi reclamo: tuve un ataque terrible por mosquitos (algo esperado por estar en área tropical!), pero la asistencia del hotel fue NULA. El cliente que pague por la asistencia médica de 150USD. No fue una "ataque" simple... creo que las fotos son aclaradas! Además intentan vender paquetes adicionales y se olvidan de informar sobre los beneficio ya previstos. Ejemplo: área exclusiva en la playa! En fin, tienen un potencial que no saben cómo explotarlo! 
Ps.: el médico que brindo la asistencia (tercero!) no cobro la consulta, no por intervención del hotel y si por buena voluntad!
Amigos: atención al hospedar en el hotel

reviews.author: Jose Manuel T
reviews.title: No vale la pena
reviews.text: Estuvimos 9 días con el servicio family concierge. Luego de haber visitado varias cadenas en punta cana y otros lugares, no me parece que el servicios que contratamos estuvo a la altura de las circunstancias. La comida con poca variedad, te moris deshidratado antes de que alguien te traiga la bebida, 100 mozos para diez mesas y nadie te atiende, muy pobre la organización. La habitación no fue gran cosa en función del precio. El hotel lejos de la playa y te pasas tú vacaciones esperando el trencito. Los shows medio pelo. La atención (a excepción de santos, y la conserje Stefany Ruiz) muy mala. Comunicación descoordinada todo el tiempo todo el mundo te informa algo distinto. La zona de chicos muy básica y con pocas actividades. La pileta de chicos dos toboganes viejos y nada más. La playa sucia llena de algas que jamás nadie limpio. La gerente de family conciergee, cada cosa que reclamamos nos dió respuestas negativas y tuvo una actitud que demostraba que le molestaban nuestras inquietudes. Pagamos el servicio más caro y a todo el mundo que iba al Paradisus y lo terminaban pasando a the reserve que sale el triple, super injusto para quien contrato The reserve. Por desgracia nos tocó el huracán María y por 4 días   estuvo el 90 por ciento del hotel inutilizado, e inundado, no vimos mucha proactividad   en limpiar las piletas y la playa dsp de los  destrozos, y la atención durante la crisis fue lamentable, nadie sabía que tenía que hacer. No vale  la pena. Mejor Iberostar o Barceló y más económico.

reviews.author: As100419
reviews.title: Who is rating this hotel...
reviews.text: Let me tell you first this hotel does not fall into the category of a four star hotel.  The buffet area is old, the food is so bad and there's flies flying around on the food, I went and told one of the guys there was a fly on the food and he did nothing, did not remove the food from buffet.    The rooms bathtub and walls had old soap attached to eat, looked dirty.  Nothing to be compare with a 4 star hotel this maybe fall in the category of a 3 star.  The family concierge lady was very nice and helpful, but the food and the condition of the buffet area and rooms is bad.

reviews.author: Z_pal
reviews.title: Absolutely the WORST Vacation ever!!
reviews.text:
I would give this resort a Zero if I could. My family recently stayed for 4 nights at The Reserve at Paradisus Punta Cana and all I can say is that it was the WORST vacation experience of our lives! Our vacation started off poorly and ended up being more of a tortuous experience than a vacation.  We decided to try this resort even though it was on the pricey end based on other reviews we saw & it was featured as a great resort through JetBlue Getaways,  however after our experience I can honestly say it was a waste of our money & time, there is nothing to desire about this resort, the food, & it's staff. We booked the 2 bedroom family concierge suite and if I have to say anything good it would have to be our family concierge Sandra. She saw what was happening & tried her best to help but she could not compensate for so many negatives. The resort is aware of everything that happened to us and has taken no real accountability for our experience.  We arrive at the main Reserve lobby around 1 pm, I provided the check in attendant my phone showing my JetBlue reservation details (vacation #, with our names).
