The only pro is the Kids Zone - my boys loved it.
Besides that, I wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone, unless you plan on buying into everything they try to sell you. Will NEVER return to Paradisus resorts.

reviews.author: Manish R
reviews.title: Deranged incompetent staff will terrorize your kid
reviews.text: This was a truly awful experience.  I'll start by telling you the most egregious incident of the trip.  On Valentine's Day, we were trying to get our kids fed at the buffet before our grown ups dinner.  At 6pm 8 kids and 5 adults were sitting at the same long table we sat at for lunch. A staff,- Geraldo Del Rosario- abruptly announces, "This section is closed you must get out!" I told him no- no one has told us that and we've been sitting here for over 30 minutes.  He walks over to a different section and points to a sign "You can not read- this sign says it is closed!" I told him if the section we were sitting in were closed, that sign would be here"  He picks up the sign, storms over and slams it in front of our table.  He then walks off and turns all the lights off, terrifying the children.  I try to go after him but he has run away.  I turn the lights back on.  He sneaks back and shuts them off again!  After much effort, I got this cowards name-Geraldo Del Rosario - and told him I was reporting him for harassment.  He then has the nerve to ask me in a threatening manner what my room was!!! The children understood this to be a thread and asked if he was going to try to kill us in our sleep!  The next day, we saw him again and this time, he did NOT have his nametag on- presumably to continue to commit evil acts against kids and adults with anonymity this time.  This is the type of smarmy character Melia Co. chooses to have as a manager- be warned!  This is pure hell.

reviews.author: Travelingfeedback
reviews.title: Didn't make it due to Zika Virus
reviews.text: Tried multiple ways to get ways to get in touch with the hotel, customer service and their parent company, Melia Hotels International to cancel our reservation due to becoming pregnant before our trip. I experienced a lot of run around, and ultimately dead ends. Our trip is in a week and this has been the most frustrating experience when it comes to dealing with customer service. No one can help process a cancellation. Think twice about staying on Melia properties, if there's any chance you need to change/cancel your plans.

reviews.author: Steve F
reviews.title: A beautiful woman with an ugly personality.
reviews.text: Everything looks so beautiful, including our room. However, on the first day, the TV didn't work properly, the drain for the jacuzzi wouldn't stay closed, the light next to the mirror was coming off the wall and was barely hanging there. The next morning, all of a sudden I heard water running and checked our bathroom. Dirty water was leaking down from the room above us. After they supposedly fixed the problem, I had to clean up the mess myself and then tried to use the shower. The shelf was loose and wouldn't hold any shampoo, etc. Then the drain to the shower was clogged and wouldn't drain. Next the TV locked up (second TV issue) and wouldn't change channels or shut off. They finally came in and shut off all the breakers in order to shut off the TV. During one of the days we were there, Housekeeping came in and made the bed and took all of our towels. When we came back from the beach the bed was made but we didn't have any towels to be able to take a shower before we went to dinner. The Internet service was at best extremely slow and most often nonexistent. Last, there was a definite language issue. No one really understood English and communicating all these problems was extremely difficult. Called the Customer Service number to find out where we could get something for sunburn for my wife and after being transferred to a couple of people no one knew what the word "sunburn" meant. I had to look up the translation on the Internet, which took forever, and finally they knew what we needed. We never really received a satisfactory response on any of the room problems or an apology.

reviews.author: n77
reviews.title: food poisoning
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, my wife and I got food poisoning at this property.  We never left the property so the source had to be food or water from the resort.

By the third day, I had abdominal cramps and felt weak.  Mild diarrhea followed shortly.  It wasn't terrible, but I lost my appetite and it lasted a few days.  I felt improved by the end, but some occasional mild diarrhea and cramping has persisted even 10 days after the trip.

My wife also got sick by the sixth day.  Her case was also initially mild with cramps and mild diarrhea.  However, by day 7 and 8 she had severe diarrhea and vomiting.  Fortunately, she improved after these 2 difficult days and has almost recovered back to normal at this point.

Fortunately, neither of our 2 kids got sick.

The resort was otherwise good, but the food poisoning ruined our trip and we felt sick even upon return home, so I can't justify giving a review of greater than 1 star because of this.

reviews.author: Anacaysan
reviews.title: dirty and old very disappointing!
reviews.text: i arrived yesterday with my husband ,after paying 700eur per night our room was not properly cleaned, walls were dirty,bath are old, oxidated doors.. we complain in the morning and the only solution was to upgrade to royal by paying extra 150eur per night!! not to mention we lost 3h to do the change room and pack everything again...it is really dissapointing, definetly the hotel is not worth the money we have stayed before in iberostar and excellence wich have much better price/quality.

reviews.author: Ora F
reviews.title: It was pretty, pretty poor.
reviews.text: Significant maintenance issues, including water leaking into our room from the bathroom in the room above us, Yuck! Significant communication issues with staff when trying to explain or ask for something.

reviews.author: palefs
reviews.title: SON UNOS ESTAFADORES
reviews.text:
El hotel ofrece y cobra servicios que al final no brinda, dan excusas para la no prestación de los servicios cobrados.

Si vienes con pago de la semana a través de servicios como RCI, te cobran al llegar la tarifa máxima, es decir, lo que pagaste en RCI se pierde totalmente, porque incluso te cobran más que si te presentas al hotel sin reservación.

Adicionalmente, saldría más económico hacer la reserva desde un servicio como booking.com

Mi recomendación es buscar otras alternativas en Punta Cana. Que entre los hoteles 5 estrellas hay gran variedad y con mejores precios. 
Porque aquí después que te roban en la recepción, pretenden volver a robarte vendiéndote una vaina que llaman Club Meliá, que supongo persigue que sufras del Síndrome de Estocolmo y hasta les agradezcas que te roben.

Ah, cuando reclamas quieren comprar tu silencio con una cena en un Restaurant de segunda, como para matarte el hambre. No lo recomiendo en absoluto.

reviews.author: S8397OXmariat
reviews.title: Very bad hotel.
reviews.text: The rooms are so old.  Cheaper hotel and cost like the best.  The Internet is terrible. So boring. The casino is bad. That food is good but the drink is poor quality, even if you pay for the best packet. Really bad experience.

reviews.author: Cristina P
reviews.title: Muy decepcionante!!!
reviews.text: No os podéis imaginar los contratiempos que hemos tenido en este hotel, algo inimaginable por las referencias que teníamos sobre el. Nos alojamos en The Royal Service de Paradisus con vista jardín, la habitación no es que sea espectacular pero es amplia y confortable. El problema fueron todos esos pequeños detalles que hacen que una estancia sea inolvidable o que la recuerdes como un desastre. Para empezar la cisterna se nos estropeo y tuvieron que venir 5 veces para terminar sin solucionar el problema ya que fuimos nosotros mismos los que tuvimos que solucionarlo con nuestras propias manos, la limpieza de la habitación es escasa y día sí día también se les olvidaba reponer las toallas, las amenidades del baño, el agua del minibar... La ducha tampoco funcionaba correctamente, la tele vino el chico de mantenimiento dos días consecutivos porque se nos apagaba y no había forma de encenderla así que estuvimos todo un día sin televisión. Y de las excursiones ni hablamos porque nos han tomado el pelo como han querido. Nos llevamos muy mala sensación por parte de todos los empleados porque no nos daban soluciones a ningún problema, te quedabas con lo que te tocaba y punto. Y eso que teníamos a una persona encargada de que todo estuviera en orden y totalmente a nuestra disposición, pues tampoco supo hacer su trabajo. Parece ser que como en este hotel el cliente es de una vez en la vida les da igual que tu estancia sea buena o mala.

reviews.author: Carolina F
reviews.title: A PIOR e mais caras Ferias da minha vida!!
reviews.text: Não é nada do que você compra. Nunca fui em um resort tão ruim. Fomos muito mal tratados. Os garçons dos restaurantes cingiam q não te viam.  O não eralimpo ,  ficava sujo, o freegobar  não era reposto. Tinha q pedir pelo amor de Deus para se ter água e conseguir jantar num local decente.

reviews.author: Victoria R
reviews.title: No volvere
reviews.text:
Hotel malisimo no parece que sea un Melia,  los siete dias que estuvimos la cisterna rota y saliendose el agua, ni ponen ni reponen los detalles del cuarto de baño, eso si teniamos nuestra cucaracha, la bebida malisima todo marcas de alli y poco profesionales los camaremos, la comida lo mismo los siete dias lo mismo y los restaurantes muy justitos, un hotel aburrido y el arquitecto se lucio con su obra maestra y el mobiliario de todo a 100 o de Ikea, no veo nada positivo.
No Volvere.

reviews.author: janeryf2015
reviews.title: Uncomfortable sofa beds, toilet no working properly, if you don't buy the membership the services are terrible.
reviews.text: No recommended, Victor from club Melia in paradisus is very neglect, toilet in my room not working, I have to ask for a mop to dry the floor, cause the room service didn't come, beds uncomfortable. Food was good.

reviews.author: Robin L
reviews.title: Disaster after disaster after disaster. No replies to emails, run the other way, FAST!
reviews.text:
Hotel: Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort (5910)
After four attempts to contact there complaints department. We have given up trying. Maybe they will respond to this.
My wife and I have just returned from a disastrous stay at the Paradisus Palma Real and below is a summary. This was not a good experience. 14 nights/days of problems. First room 1044 shower had no no hot water it took two days to fix, no plug in sink, when it was replaced it did not work. Patio door of its runners. Toilet flush came off in my hand, tried to iron a dress the iron dumped water all over my wife's dress, again two days to replace the iron. Tv would not turn off at night.... They have hidden the power cables so you cannot even un plug it! Hairdryer was faulty. 
After 4 days they moved us to room 1065. We had a group of friends in for 7 days from the USA ,so they roomed us close together. Back to our room 1065, noisiest room ever there is a service area beside it, and a service road behind it, and Dom Rep vehicles believe me are never the quietest!!!! Again we had problems with hot water, we had to run all the cold taps for 10 minutes before the hot water would run hot, this was typical for all our group 6 rooms in total. 1064/1069/1053/1068/1074 Also our new room was smaller than our first. Bare in mind Our trip from the Uk cost us $6000 with airfare. Our group was also beset with problems, one room had $50 stolen, another had bleach left on the dresser, leading to a ruined dress. Another had a water leak through its ceiling and when they moved them, the alarm clock in the room next to them went of for an hour at 2.30am..... That's just the rooms. The first weekend we were there the place seemed nice and lively, 6 restaurants open and all bars open. Apparently there were 250 insurance agents in from Michigan. Unfortunately they left after 3 days and the resort died! When I enquired with the guest services manager Domingo, he said, because of low occupancy they do not open all the restaurants and bars......where does it say that in the brochure. Most nights we had to beg to be able to eat in an air conditioned restaurant, as most we were told were closed for maintainence. Believe me the novelty of sweating while eating soon wears off. Three nights we did not eat, seeking  the sanctuary of our rooms air con, that did work well. There was a bar called the Avenue bar, open our first three nights, lively, dancing, in a breezeway, comfortable, some great cocktails guess what........never opened again! Closed for 10nights straight. One night they allowed us to eat in the Royal service restaurant, an upgrade area as a sorry they did not do very well, sort of thing. When we arrived the lady on the front desk could not find our reservation. We had to stand there like the poor relations for 10 minutes while it was sorted out, thanks a lot. We ate in one restaurant called Rare, my partner became ill. We ate in restaurant Fuego a restaurant with no air con, the fans do not work properly. The beach was deluged in sea weed (2ft high) and was not cleared properly till the last day of our stay. On check out I was presented with a $1080 up charge for the room change, when I disputed this I was told by the only guest services person on duty Vladimir that if I did not pay it then the reception staff would have to pay it instead. Blackmail or what! I asked to speak to a senior manager only to be told none were available, at lunch I believe. If you don't get a check out slip then you can't get your case. ......! Vladimir promised me he would organise a credit from Melia, just email him when I get home. Again I have done this 3 times, and wow no reply. My last meal lunch in the beachside buffet. I had a hamburger, the last thing I ate for 24 hours as I never eat when I fly, guess what food poisoning, and so it goes on and on One of the towel supervisors called me in Spanish, Seinora, I am a married male, she giggled with a co worker thinking I did not know what it means. It means a un manly man. Generally though the staff were great, trying there best to help. I have tried to find someone to complain to everywhere to no avail. If anyone can help, please get in touch. Our group of 12 payed almost $30,000 it's just not good enough, Thomson, Costco's and Melia should be embarrassed. I await your response Robin Lewis

reviews.author: ruben M
reviews.title: PEOR IMPOSIBLE, LUNA DE MIEL
reviews.text:
He ido a Punta Cana 3 veces y este ha sido sin duda el peor hotel en el que he estado, desde el primer dia un descontrol terrible. Me cambié de Paradisus a The Reserve y después de pagar más de 400 $ iban de mal en peor, total que me han hecho que mi luna de miel no fuese la esperada. Allí todo el mundo dice que si y después el descontrol es máximo.
Pd: Aún espero un detalle por luna de miel, después de reclamarlo a los 4 vientos.
No tengo palabras para explicar todo lo que nos pasó en ese hotel, pero contaré una para que se hagan una idea...
Nos encontrabamos la puerta abierta de nuestra habitación cada vez que volviamos, entrabamos con miedo.
En fin yo no he escrito nunca una opinión aquí, pero esta no podía dejar de compartirla con gente que tenga pensado ir a Punta Cana.

reviews.author: MiamiBeach2002
reviews.title: Food poisoning the whole trip
reviews.text:
The property was decent, but I hardly left the room.   I was sick from the food almost immediately.   They say don't drink the water in Mexico, but no one told me to not eat the food either.  This is a sure fire was to light your money on fire.   
This place is germ infested, filthy and disgusting.   
The services sucked, the staff was rude.  I would never ever stay in a Melia hotel ever again.  
Save your money, go someplace else.

When we arrived the  lady on the front desk could not find our reservation. We had to stand there like the poor relations for 10 minutes while it was sorted out, thanks a lot. We ate in one restaurant called Rare, my partner became ill. The staff are great but the problems are just to many. Our group of 12  payed  almost $30,000 it's just not good enough, thompsons, and Costco's should be embarrassed.

reviews.author: NataliaSiper
reviews.title: Marketing agressivo, suíte errada, péssimo atendimento
reviews.text:
Programamos nossa lua-de-mel com muito carinho.
Pesquisamos na internet o melhor hotel custo-benefício em Punta Cana. Encontramos muitas avaliações positivas sobre o resort Paradisus Palma Real, fizemos a reserva para o Royal Service e de uma suíte com vista parcial para o mar.
Chegamos à noite e não pudemos "conferir" a vista. Ao amanhecer, fomos para a janela e ficamos muito decepcionados ao perceber que a nossa vista era para o jardim do resort e não dava para ver o mar de nenhum ângulo.
Conversamos com nosso mordomo, ele não resolveu o problema.
Tentamos por TRÊS DIAS resolver essa questão com outros funcionários do hotel que simplesmente ignoraram nossa solicitação. Somente no quarto dia de desgaste e reclamação é que nos transferiram para a suíte correta, que havíamos pago mais caro por ela. Mas, as decepções não param por aí...
Ofereceram-nos participar de uma reunião em troca de descontos em passeios (que, diga-se de passagem são caríssimos! Os mesmos passeios em Cancun são bem mais econômicos). Assistimos à palestra que era uma tentativa de venda de cotas para o clube Meliá. A palestra é muito longa e desgastante. Explicamos ao vendedor que não tínhamos interesse em adquirir cotas de clube, pois estávamos em lua-de-mel, queríamos aproveitar a viagem. O vendedor, um espanhol, foi EXTREMAMENTE INSISTENTE E GROSSO! Até mesmo o seu gerente (um francês) nos agradeceu a atenção e disse entender, porém o vendedor enfurecido encerrou a reunião dizendo que as pessoas da minha cidade são "pão-duras".
Um dia, ao chegarmos exaustos de um dos passeios, pedimos um sanduíche em nossa suíte. O funcionário levou o sanduíche e pediu que avaliássemos o seu atendimento no site do hotel. Pedi pra ele me informar o site, mas ele não fava inglês. Dei meu celular para que ele abrisse o site, ele abriu a página do TripAdvisor marcou todas as notas máximas e começou a escrever, COMO SE FOSSE CLIENTE, sobre o hotel. Fiquei enfurecida e expliquei pra ele que não faria avaliação nenhuma antes da estadia acabar (mesmo porque já tinha tido péssimas experiências). Ele enrolou muito para sair do quarto, fazendo uma chantagem emocional, implorando para que eu avaliasse o hotel no TripAdvisor. Achei um absurdo e descobri o porquê do hotel ser tão bem avaliado no site: OS FUNCIONÁRIOS TE CHANTAGEIAM E IMPLORAM PELA MELHOR AVALIAÇÃO NO TRIPADVISOR!
E não acabou por aí...
Pagamos pelo serviço Royal Service, tínhamos uma praia privada com atendimento de garçons. E, acreditem: não consegui ficar nas choupanas da praia nenhum dia! O garçon reservava os melhores lugares para quem pagava gorjeta pra ele!
Fui questioná-lo por isso e ele falou que se eu quisesse aqueles lugares que eu deveria dormir na praia! Um garçom, o de menor estatura de todos, muito grosso que a partir do meu questionamento não quis nos atender mais.
Fiz questão de ressaltar todas as características dos funcionários que nos atenderam mal para que alguma providência seja tomada.
Não recomendo este hotel para ninguém! Nunca tive tantos problemas em outras viagens que fiz.
Falar que o lugar é lindo, paradisíaco e luxuoso é o mínimo que se espera ao se pagar por uma estadia tão cara.
O Meliá se preocupa muito com o marketing, que acaba sendo agressivo, ao invés de se preocupar em capacitar melhor seus funcionários para que não estraguem a reputação da rede.

reviews.author: bigpeel
reviews.title: Stolen wallet
reviews.text: This will be my third attempt at leaving a review. It keeps disappearing. In short, wallet was stolen and returned next day minus cash. Either from gift shop or room ( while we were sleeping!) wouldn't allow me to watch cameras. Was told I out wallet in pocket. Went directly to room where belongings were laid on dresser. Turn down service comes in late. Deadbolt your door. Our friends had smaller items taken from their room as well. Basically this review is much more abbreviated just because I'm tired of writing this story. Just go somewhere else. Vouchers are a joke. People are friendly, but who can you trust??

reviews.author: patrick e
reviews.title: Would never come back
reviews.text: Came here for a five day stay and wound up in the hospital immediately after returning to the U.S. Appendix had to come out swollen colon, 3 day stay.  The restaurants are terrible. The food is inedible. You actually have to ask yourself where can we eat? Not where should we eat. The safe in our room was broken so they upgraded us which was very nice. Our butler was great for dinner reservations but that's really all he did. The spa was very nice however very expensive for what you get. If you return to use the water spa they do not give you a locker the next day. Let me be specific we spent 1,000$ the day before and gave a 200$ tip and couldn't use a locker? Give me a break. Don't .. DO NOT go to passion this was was the worst dining experience I've ever had. The island is beautiful but the mounds of seaweed make the water unapproachable. Don't stay here, don't go to the DR. You could go to Aruba for the same price. Will never return.

reviews.author: Joao O
reviews.title: Nunca mais
reviews.text:
Observem que não
 há respostas em relação ao ocorrido...simplesmente ignoram sendo complacentes com o ocorrido...reitero que não é uma resort confiável em relação a segurança....São 8 meses sem nenhuma resposta oficial...sem respeito aos  hóspedes.

reviews.author: Lisa E
reviews.title: Never going there again!
reviews.text:
Would never recommend anyone go there. The service was the worst I've experienced. No such thing as 'service with a smile'. The staff are woeful, unpleasant.  They loved closing the bar early even when people were there drinking.  
Room service was a joke as I never got what I ordered, and sometimes it never even came!!
The beach was beautiful, however, a few days it was covered in seaweed and not cleared till the next day! 
They have a massive problem with mosquitoes, I wonder if they are treating the place enough?They gave us spray at the restaurant for them.
Last but not least, the food was AWFUL!!!!

reviews.author: Miguel M
reviews.title: Terrible Service....
reviews.text: I recently visited this resort from September 4 thru September 7, 2015. The resort is in fact beautiful and very clean I must say. However, my experience and guests experience upon arrival to departure was terrible. My guests which were a party of 13 people including myself and two children were treated really poorly. I decided to stay at this resort because me and another guest visited The Level at Melia this past May 2015 also located in Punta Cana which are in deed affiliated to Paradisus The Reserve. We expected that if we go further in category the service would be just as good or will surpass our expectations, but that was not the case. I must state however that the service at The Level at Melia was extremely beyond my expectations and staff was amazing. We were treated as top priority in all areas of the resort. Many staff members even became our friends throughout the stay, they would greet us by our names and immediately asked how they can be of assistance. Furthermore, the staff at this resort would guide us so that we can get to were we need to timely when in need. Also the staff members would periodically give us updates on what events are going on that specific day and also throughout the stay approached us warmly and friendly and to top it off they welcomed themselves with our preferred cocktails many times. This is just some of the many beautiful and memorable things that took place at The Level at Melia. On the other hand, The Reserve at Paradisus really let me down with the service and attention they poorly provided to my party of 13 people. I never met the family concierge who was assigned to each of our rooms (total of 4) one of the rooms had a damaged phone which didn't get repaired. In one instance I called to inquire about another restaurant other than the Gabi Club to go have breakfast to and the staff member advised us of one called Nao, upon arrival we asked one of the staff members we saw around and they told us that the restaurant is currently under construction. Think about it trying to coordinate with 13 people how hard it is to know were to go have breakfast now... Instead of the staff member being more proactive when we inquired and be more respectful to us and our time they instead gave us inaccurate information. Another similar case in which we experienced from a staff member was lack of knowledge and providing accurate information to one of my guests. My guest wanted to take professional pictures which were offered at the resort, my guest inquired and the staff member advised that she will need to be there no later than 5pm. Finally after everyone spent time getting dressed and transporting to another area of the resort were these pictures are taken the staff member at the desk asked my guest if we did a reservation. Here is the problem we were never given that information the only thing that was given to us as information was we needed to be there no later than 5pm. So with this said the staff members at this resort are very careless and not in no way considering the time and efforts being put from its guests. A lot of our time was wasted because of carelessness and misinformation. Furthermore, in the common areas and pool area (including swim up bar) there was no waiter in sight, I only interacted with one waiter who I would see every 45 to an hour, and at the swim up bar not one sole in sight. Beach area was nice, however same thing here no waiters, maybe one person who was nice every 45 minutes to an hour. All of us would ask one an other what is going on.... We did notice that the resort was not fully occupied and with that said you would think the staff would be just as much available but sadly that was not the case. Also I was confused and concerned throughout my stay when many times we were questioned by staff members if we are guests who are attending a wedding...When they asked me that I kind of said to myself is this why no one is around?? Another incident all of us had was at breakfast time one morning were we had found a table for all 13 of us but time kept passing by and not one of the many waiters there approached us for water and coffee. I had to approach someone and point out we need water and coffee, even with me pointing it out he still took long to get us started. I was so upset already and embarrassed with all of my guests whom I invited to experience a memorable and loving experience, this turned out to be the worst choice I have ever made. Another incident we experienced was during the beach party once again not one waiter in sight for cocktails, and what had me and all of guests shocked was they had a drag queen doing a show. Nevertheless, after the poor beach party we were told at sometime of a club we can attend since the beach party was not very appealing or fun to us. When we went to the club it was completely empty and again a staff member there said they were closed that night. More and more time wasted!  Another incident we had was we reported that the baby crib given was damaged and never got replaced or repaired. I finally went to the front desk and reported all of this and with that said I was really stressed because I just couldn't find a way to explain or correct and even go around and explain otherwise to my guests of what is going on.... The staff at the front desk were understanding including the assistant manager I believe. Sadly it was my last night. With that said I came back home with nothing good to say other than I am completely embarrassed and speechless with regards to the horrific treatment and extremely poor staff who made my guests and my experience unsatisfactory. I do want to however take a moment and thank the following staff member who on my last night there made it a bit better, Juan [--], Andres [--], Jana [--] at Gabi club for our last dinner thank you for your kindess and making yourself available throught our last dinner. I know that I will never stay at this resort ever again. Sad but I had to vent because I spent a lot of money on this horrible vacation and in turn all I got was a lot of time wasted and poor customer service.

reviews.author: Redbudian
reviews.title: Follow-up review from a second stay
reviews.text: We originally gave this hotel high marks due to the great stay we had a few years back.  However, when we returned we noticed a huge difference from our first stay.  First of all, the property was not maintained well.  Our room had many things that were out of order, crumbling or missing.  Secondly, the hotel also seemed to be  less clean.  Not only from lack of cleaning, but the wait staff didn't seem to care (or know) about proper hygiene or sanitary practices.  Flies covered the food on the buffet, food was left out too long (e.g. raw sushi grade fish that was unrefrigerated and the guy who plunged your toilet could be seen behind the buffet within minutes of his service visit.  Next, the "vibe" of the hotel has changed.  We watched a European tourist passed out on the couch after what I am assuming is a rough night out.  No one checked on the man, no one escorted him to his room - he just stayed there sleeping (passed out) as we ate our meal.  What seemed like a great family resort has gravitated towards the party crowd, which had to be hard to watch for those with young children.  Many of the people in our large group (300+ who were there for a short business trip turned vacation) left with enteritis and other intestinal issues. We had a few who were hospitalized due to dehydration.  Not sure if the water filtration was working or if it was due to the lack of cleanliness (I suspect it was a combination).  The hotel would not acknowledge any issues and told us we must have arrived sick.  Seeing the number of people in our group, who traveled from all over the U.S. and Canada, I'd say that is highly unlikely.  Bottom line: we will never set foot on this property again.

reviews.author: MissyS4
reviews.title: HORRIBLE!!! Don't waste your money here!
reviews.text: We just showed up and we had been to the Paradisus in Playa Del Carmen. The rooms were beautiful well we get here and the room is so gross. It's old, dingy & smells of must, NOTHING like the Playa deal Carmen! I called he manager and he was rude and of course no help. I'm so irritated I will NEVER EVER stay here again. I wouldn't waste your money. They also convinced us to stay longer and we would get $500 credit to use towards excursion and the spa. Well of course that was a lie and you can only use the money towards what they say. It's a scam and they are rude! I will not be back and I would not recommend it

reviews.author: capriciac
reviews.title: DO NOT GO HERE! Horrible
reviews.text: There are so many things wrong with this resort, just walk away... I got food poisoning and so did 5 other members of my family. My room was not cleaned my entire trip, Food was stale and staff argued with us. I was attending my cousin wedding, who decided to go here because I got married at their parent company hotel - Paradisus Punta Cana Palma Real, but this place is NOTHING like it. RUN!

reviews.author: Julie P
reviews.title: VERY DISAPPOINTED for our honeymoon
reviews.text:
My husband and I were very disappointed on our stay here for our honeymoon. One of the reasons we booked this place was because on trip advisor they make it seem so romantic. When we arrived and checked into our room we were expecting to have something special in the room waiting for us. The room was a standard room and nothing in the room congratulating us at all. I thought that the hotel would make you feel special for your honeymoon and I felt like a regular guest that was just booking a hotel room. 

When we were in the dining areas we were not even greeted with a smile or " Hi, can I help you" it was just ignorance and people acted as if you didn't exist. I don't know if this was because it is all inclusive or what. Whenever we did get good service we tipped the wait staff very well and we were appreciative. 

At the pool we could not order food and they only offered 1 kind of beer? That was a little bit of a rip off. My husband didn't even get to drink and have fun at the pool bc all of the drinks were mostly sugar. He spent most of the night having a massive headache after the pool bc the drinks. 

The beach in the back of the hotel looked pretty from far away but when we were down there walking on the beach we couldn't even get into the water bc of the seaweed. 

Overall, I think we will NOT be back here again and I wouldn't recommend anyone come here on there honeymoon. I would go some place that makes you feel special like you should feel on your honeymoon.

reviews.author: roseandrey l
reviews.title: Think twice
reviews.text: Was not happy at all!!!!! Worse stay ever... I was there five days to long. Food was gross, everything took to long to make it to the. Room. My  transportation was messed up from beginning when I called for Assistance at the hotel they did not want to assist I told them I did not speak Spanish and they sent me the same information in Spanish I have to call for times then did a conference call with a friend of mine so then they could assist me

reviews.author: R8226DAJ
reviews.title: Rude experience
reviews.text:
Visiting for a big conference.  Nearly all the staff was rude and I felt like they were mad about working there.  This was particularly true in the restaurants where they did not take any requests.   They were so rude in one that we walked out.

The WIFI was also terrible - in the rooms it was so weak that it would constantly kick you off.  It was better in the conference rooms but still weak.

reviews.author: Kristina B
reviews.title: Not amongst the best
reviews.text: Overall nice location but terrible service. Issues with in room dining - food was terrible and orders were wrong. Well at least we got food considering it took 5 transfers and 15 minutes just to get someone on the line. The laundry service just as bad - called to get our shirts pressed but again couldn't get anyone on the line just to be told by the operator that they closed at 430pm as opposed to 5 pm like the brochure said. Only to find out the following day it was a lie and we then had to pay for expedited  pressing. Then after asking for expedited pressing we were told we wouldn't get it until after 7pm. Had to make a huge fuss to get them to bring the items before 5pm. Not to mention the terrible unapologetic attitudes of the people answering the calls. Called to get extra towels from housekeeping which took over two hours to get and when they arrived the housekeeper walked into the room didn't say hi went straight to the Bathroom and started saying in Spanish that we had towels which we didn't. Only problem is I speak Spanish and understood all the rude comments she was making. restaurant  reservations kept changing things around and not to mention the poor service in the Mediterranean place and the heat in the Japanese place. Had to call facilities several times and they never fixed the no hot water in the shower but kept insisting that we weren't turning the knob correctly last time I checked i can handle a shower handle. Had to call when a broken vent in the room almost fell on my head but luckily missed me by a couple of inches and hit the floor instead. Also they should have mentioned that they only have one type of beer that they provide for those people that don't drink presidente. Alas don't judge a book by its cover. The location may look nice but the service for a hotel of this status is not where it should be. One thing I can say is I don't come on vacation to deal with rude people for that i would stay home. Oh well I suppose others don't mind this hotel if they spend their time drinking the whole time. I suppose they can overlook things of this nature.

reviews.author: Nora B
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort - followed by disgust
reviews.text:
This resort is beautiful.  The pool is very large and clean.  The beach could use some cleaning as there was a lot of seaweed at the shore that couldn't easily been cleaned.

The food was just okay and the drink were very weak - practically no alcohol.  Service was a bit slow at times, but overall it was great.  The people were really nice.

The entire resort has free wi-fi, which is a nice little perk.

I would've said that the overall experience was great.  However, after returning from my trip, everything smelled horrible- clothes, shoes, toiletries, purse, blowdryer, etc.  I had to wash everything multiple times in order to get the odar out.  I even had to soak my shoes and toiletries in Downy to get the smell out.  I had to throw out my suitcase, blowdryer, phone case, and charger because of it.  I have been back from the trip a week already and I'm still dealing with all of this and am very frustrated.  The smell is almost like a moldy/mildewy smell...which makes me wonder if there was mold in the room.  I had a great time on the trip, but this experience makes me wish that I had never gone.  I have never experienced anything like this before.  We chose this resort because of the 5 star rating and all the great reviews, but honestly, I would never stay at this resort again.  The time and money that was wasted when I returned makes it not worth it at all.  I will not be recommending this resort.

reviews.author: Meghan K
reviews.title: Butler is horrible, drinks in paper cups
reviews.text:
We were so excited to go to Paradisus on our honeymoon, and got Royal Service, but our troubles began from the day we arrived.  We had payed for an early check in on Melia.com, and were made to wait on arrival from 11am until 3 pm for a room.  When I asked for my money back ($70) since we didn't get the early check in , I was told this is nonrefundable.  I don't understand why you would sell this on your site if it isn't available! We were told (after asking) for *something* in return for our money that we could get champagne, flowers, and candles in our Jacuzzi one night.  Well turns out we had to call and remind them about this after 5 days until they finally did it.  While reminding us that it's not normally included.  We had also payed for a dinner at Passions also 70 per person ahead of time on Melia.com and although we were promised multiple times by the waiter at the restaurant, we were charged twice for this and had to dispute it on check out.

Our butler (Jorge) was useless in terms of getting reservations for Papalas or dinner.  We would ask him ahead of time and he would call us the night of dinner around 4 pm to tell us that we didn't get the reservation.  We had much better luck at the pool making friends with the guys and tipping them and they would reserve us spaces at the pool, even though they weren't supposed to since you are supposed to go through your butler which is just annoying.

Drinks were served out of paper cups at the pool.  If you are a good tipper maybe you will get a drink with a normal amount of alcohol in it.  Not very classy. 

Our room that we were given had two queen sized beds pushed together, not very romantic at all given we were on our honeymoon, and just plain weird!!!!! Also many things in our room were broken, the TV would only turn on after multiple tries, the radio did not work, and the sink you had to take out the stopper totally or it would overflow.  I am not making this up.  

 To sum it all up at the end of the trip the girls at the reservation desk told us they "apologize for their incompetence".  Would never go back here.  I have been many places  (Jamaica, Bahamas, Aruba) and never had a poor experience like this. I hope people think twice before going here!!!

reviews.author: Christine E
reviews.title: THEIVES! Awful experience! The resort is gorgeous but not worth having items stolen and horrible customer service
reviews.text:
I was thrilled to be staying at the five star luxury paradisus Palma real resort. The pictures were beautiful! A friend of mine was getting married and 64 guests attended the wedding. 

It was disappointing that a friend of mine had a pair of earrings STOLEN from her room! When she filed a complaint and wanted to take a picture of the complaint the security grabbed it from her hand and wouldn't let her. Security also went through everything in her room looking for the earrings. The next day the earring were placed in her room on her night stand.

The mother of the bride also had a pair of earrings stolen. A report was filed and again security searched her room and two days later the earrings were placed back in her room.

Another guest had her handbag stolen from her room. Again, security searched everything, went through her belongings, checked under the plants... The next day the handbag appeared in her room.

The food is over salted. The wine selection is awful. I also think the refill the more expensive liquor bottles with cheap alcohol. When I ordered a few mixed drinks I couldn't take more than a sip. This establishment would be a wonderful place to visit if items weren't stolen. 

I was also surprised that the beach wasn't taken care of. Dirty, not cleaned and seaweed everywhere. They didn't rake the beach! 

The spa was nice and the grounds were beautiful. The resort is beautiful. It's very unfortunate that they steal from their guests.

reviews.author: Navigator227805
reviews.title: WARNING: DON'T STAY HERE.
reviews.text:
This place is a joke for how much they charge people to stay here. The service is unbelievably HORRIBLE...from front desk, housekeeping, and food service, we have had nothing but rudeness and eye rolling, as if we asked to be treated like royalty. 

To start, we booked our room through Melia rewards. The rep helped explain our options for rooms and we were interested in Royal Service. He told us we had $1100 in credit to use when we come here due to 2 promotions they had running, $550 for each. When we asked how we could use the credit, he ADVISED that we use the our credits to upgrade our room when we got to the hotel rather than spend the money now. We agreed and booked. When we got to the hotel, they gave us 2 sets of coupons to use on other items that are a complete waste of money. For example, $50 towards any spa spend of $130 or more or $20 off $80 bottle of wine. They don't have credits, they have coupons; needless to say, we were pissed. They refused to offer us anything to remedy the situation either. We got the exact room we booked after 2 hours of them going back and forth at the desk to come back with the same answer. They wasted our afternoon to say the same thing they told us 2 hours earlier. 

I'm almost 6 months pregnant and we were here for the wedding of our close friends. I requested that we have a room on the main floor that didn't require too much walking. They put us in a room literally 15 minutes from the main areas of the resort. When we asked to switch somewhere closer, for the second time, they said they said they have no other room available. Lie after lie with no accommodations made whatsoever. 

Housekeeping has been in our room for the 3 days we've been here, cleaning out all of our towels/toiletries and never restocking them. I've had to call the front desk for towels every single day. When they answer, they ask if we can wait until room service comes to replenish them. I explained all 3 days, to each person, that we are not getting any towels or shampoo. It is unbelievably frustrating. Also, there is a sign on the fridge that says "The mini bar stock will be replenished once a day" but ours hasn't been restocked ONCE! When we called for water bottles, they said there is an additional charge to restock after it's been replenished. My husband was very angry and explained our issue with room service and house keeping. They ended up coming with our water after half an hour. Customer service is not a priority here by any means...

As for the food, it's all pre-made and frozen prior to serving. Unless you order items that are made to order directly in front of you, such as an omelette at breakfast or hibachi dinner at Bano or Mizu, it's frozen food. You can't change any ingredients in the meal items or add anything because they're pre-made. The servers don't find any urgency in refilling your glass; they get to you when they get to you. They push to sell bottles of wine and anything they can charge extra, even after I explained I'm pregnant and not drinking. 

The ONLY thing this place has going for it is its beauty. There are plenty of other resorts that can offer the God-given gorgeous aspects of the Dominican. If it wasn't for the wedding being here, I would NEVER stay here. We will not be back after this experience. I can't wait to go home.

reviews.author: 210tamikab
reviews.title: Customer NO service
reviews.text: The hotel is breathtaking ! The food was pretty good but the customer service desk was very rude and non accommodating. For any issues, you must go to customer service for NO help. Getting reservations to restaurants was basically impossible and of course you have to go to customer NO service. A waste of time!

reviews.author: Claudia B
reviews.title: Slechtste vakantie ooit...!! 11-19 april 2015.
reviews.text:
Wij boekten in het Reserve gedeelte een familiekamer, met pràchtig uitzicht, werd ons beloofd. We werden vrij lauw ontvangen en kregen amper uitleg, enkel het kaartje; trek je plan maar...! Eens op de kamer merken we dat we, zoals gevraagd, wel een 2de kamer hadden waar de kinderen konden slapen, met mooi 2 twijfelaars, maar ons bed?? Daar leg ik mijn hond nog niet eens op te slapen!! Het was een open gemaakte sofa, waar je de ijzers zo door voelde. Hooguit 5 cm "dik".  We hebben 3 nachten met ons 4 in de twijfelaars geslapen.
We hadden amper plaats om onze kleren kwijt te geraken, veel te weinig kasten, en ons uitzicht? We keken op bomen... als we heel hard ons best deden dan zagen we misschien wat blauw van het zwembad. De weg naar het strand was vuil en vies, er lag overal glas, alsook kapotte glazen flessen. Daar lopen kinderen rond?? Eveneens het strand was heel vies, veel algen maar ook gewoon puur heel veel afval. We wilden aan het kinderbad gaan liggen, daar heb je van die hutjes. We gaan liggen waar er plaats is, komt er plots een gezin af, die ons komt vertellen dat zij daar liggen. "Hoe??? Hier lag toch niets??" ... oh jawel, blijkbaar hadden we gemist dat er een naamkaartje hing met de naam van die familie op. Mooi, wisten wij niet. Nogal logisch als we amper 5 minuten "uitleg" kregen bij aankomst. We kiezen dan voor een ander hutje, omdat die nog vrij was. De dag nadien letten we goed op dat we geen hutje nemen met een naamkaartje, we liggen daar een klein uurtje, komt de zwembadmeester af met een gezin: "sorry maar zij liggen hier". "Sorry maar hier hing géén naamkaartje, dus wij liggen hier!" .."het spijt me maar dan zal iemand dat kaartje gestolen hebben, maar zij hebben dit geboekt". Ze konden me vertikken! Ik ben niét verhuisd! Geen 2de keer!! Ik heb gevraagd om dan zelf een hutje te reserveren, maar nee hoor... alle hutjes waren voor de rest van de week al volgeboekt. Als we wilden in een hutje liggen, waren er "daarachter" nog wel. Totaal niet aan het kinderbad, mijn kinderen zijn 4 en 5, die laat ik écht niet alleen. Dit vond ik écht niet kunnen. Ons rolluikje op de kamer aan de deur, die je normaal optrekt met een koordje, was stuk. Wilden we de gordijn omhoog of omlaag, moesten we het zelf maar handmatig op- of af rollen. Toen we aan onze hostess voor een andere matras vroegen, zei dat ze er om ging horen, maar wat denk je? Niets gehoord! Als we aan de mensen van het hotel vroegen om wat extra uitleg of een andere kamer, dan keken ze ons aan alsof we chinees spraken. De bediening in het restaurant was waardeloos!! 10 minuten met onze armen staan zwaaien , eer er ook maar ièmand kwam vragen wat we wilden drinken. En dan kwamen ze een kwartier later er mee af, en dan nog de helft fout. Quasi elke keer hetzelfde eten, en koud eten!! Het personeel stond meer samen te praten dan de mensen te helpen. De golfkarretjes naar het hotel, ja hoor goed concept... zij het niet dat ze ofwel altijd vol zaten, omdat wij aan het reserve gedeelte lagen, en die vertrokken aan het "gewone" gedeelte en zat dus meestal vol eer ze bij ons waren. Ofwel zat hij vol met personeel, ofwel vlamden ze ons gewoon voorbij, zonder ook maar een keer te vragen of we mee wilden. 1km naar het restaurant, 3x per dag in de schroeiende hitte met 2 kinderen van 4 en 5. Zo kan ik nog wel even door gaan... 
Vip Selection geboekt, om en bij de 10.000 euro voor neergeteld, en dan zo terechtkomen.... pure schande!! Wij zijn na dag 3 dan ook vervroegd naar huis gekomen (en nog 800 euro mogen bij betalen) en de klacht tegen dit hotel is verstuurd en wordt momenteel behandeld. Ons reisbureau heeft dit intussen ook niet meer verkocht.

reviews.author: V F
reviews.title: 5 star hotel with 2 star quality
reviews.text: We were so excited to stay at the Paradisus Palma Real.  The setting is wonderful and the hotel is nice.  Our one bedroom suite was decent but not 5 star quality.  The mini bar consisted of a couple of sodas, a few waters and a bottle of cheap wine.  No food or anything else.  The TV in the bedroom was broken from the start.  After two calls to have it resolved, we gave up.  The safe wasn't working correctly either.  But, the icing on the cake was when we stripped the bed and discovered blood, urine and other stains on our mattress.  We were so disgusted.  When I informed the service manager, Domingo, he didn't blink an eye.  He was neither surprised nor apologetic.  When we went to bed that night, we discovered that the mattress had been flipped over to the hard bottom.  We felt like we were sleeping on plywood.  But, I guess that was better than the alternative. The food at the buffet was OK at best.  French fries, pizza and hamburgers.   No where near the quality that you would expect. The restaurants on site were much the same.  They looked nice and the servers were friendly but the quality was awful.  The beef at Bana tasted like leather, the fish at Aqua was overlooked and the soup at Vento didn't taste right.  If you're going, bring lots of cash, as everyone expects a big tip.  And, that doesn't guarantee good service.   All in all, we would never recommend this hotel to anyone.  We spent nearly $3000 and regret it.

reviews.author: Eric Gerdts
reviews.title: From a Teen Prospective
reviews.text: No. Absolutely not. This resort was not our favorite. The food was not fresh and tasted as if it were frozen for months. The staff however is very nice. The pullout bed in our room was out of order, so all three of us had to fit in the king bed. The ONLY good thing about the room was the bathroom. The beach had lots of washed up seaweed plants, making the beach dirty. There are few activities to do that come with the package. I would advise to not stay here. IF you happen to disregard my comments, go on a power adventure snorkeling trip. You will not regret it.

reviews.author: seveenh
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: We've done many all inclusive resorts all over the Caribbean and this was the worst of them all.  Not recommended at all.  There are a lot better places around the Caribbean to stay for the same amount of money.  Poor service,  wasn't made to feel important.

reviews.author: Drew H
reviews.title: Ok resort except for horrible food
reviews.text:
I would have enjoyed my stay at this resort except the food, with no exception I found after trying every free a la cart and the buffet.  Food was always, ALWAYS under (or not at all) seasoned, over cooked and poorly designed.  Variety and choice was good, but we literally tried every normal a la cart and the fuego restaurant and didn't find anything redeeming.  Some of the worst food I have ever had in my life.

The room was dated but spacious, service was fairly good, but that food is bad enough to ruin an entire vacation.

reviews.author: Roozbeh2015
reviews.title: Not a quality place.
reviews.text: I was very disapointed to have our meeting in this resort. Not a quality place for the dollar you pay. Bad wifi. Low quality food. Not a professional front desk service. Bad room service. Had no hot water on day. No electricity one day. No water one days. Three days of no service. I selected a place to impress my people. But end up with disapointing experiance. When i discussed these issues with the resort managent, they were indifferent. Not even an apploglogy.

reviews.author: prpmuneca106
reviews.title: You couldn't pay me to return!
reviews.text:
First let me start off by saying the place is absolutely gorgeous! The waitstaff, and housekeeping ppl are all wonderful. George our beach waiter was the best!

Now to the negative...we were supposed to get a VIP check in, in a private room, cold towels, welcome champagne, NEVER HAPPENED, and honestly it wasn't a big deal until everything else started to happen. After check in our concierge (Brunswick) takes us to our room and tells us to meet him in the morning after breakfast to go over a few things and to make our reservations for dinner for the week (which I find reservations at an all inclusive to be ridiculous but i'll get to that). We met him in the morning and he starts talking about the hotel and says "I'm going to take you to a room so we can discuss..."and I kindly cut him off, having stayed at other Paradisus resorts I knew right away he was going to take us to do a timeshare which they tell you takes 30 min and we've done it in the past it takes 3 hours. We kindly told him we weren't interested but thank you, and he asked kindly again and we said no we were only going to be here 6 days we really wanted to enjoy our vacation so he got annoyed and left. He also NEVER made our reservations and just like magic NO ONE wanted to give us a reservation to eat! Coincidence I think not!

I called from the room 8 times, I was transferred all over the place, and no one would answer the phone, the front desk just began ignoring my calls then finally a person answered, Stephanie Belido at the reservation desk, who was nasty, rude and highly inappropriate, she refused to give us a reservation, when I finally asked her "what are we supposed to eat while we are here" she had the nerve to say "I dont know what to tell you ma'am" and hung up! Every restaurant for the next few days was booked! I called her back cause she hung up on me, she huffed and puffed and said fine you can have a reservation at 10pm! Totally unacceptable as I was traveling with my 3 yr old son! She finally gave in and gave us a reasonable reservation and to our surprise the restaurant was empty! We then went to the reservation desk and asked for reservations for the rest of the week, since speaking to her over the phone was useless, speaking to her over the phone was no better! We asked several times to see a manager and she never called one but miraculoulsy had reservations all week for us, and again to our surprise each restaurant was empty! She then made an error which we thought was ok, she told us we had reservations for a restaurant she gave us our card, we get to the restaurant "Vento" they dont have our name, and with my 3 yr old son they denied us entry! That restaurant was also empty! Please note as we sat in each restaurant they did not eventually fill up they were empty, and when I say empty I mean there were about 4 or 5 other couples and families there! We knew going forward they were rude to us because we refused the timeshare tour, every time we saw Brunswick our so called concierge in the lobby he'd literally run the other way. We were so disgusted, we spent alot of money to come here and relax and enjoy our vacation not to be harassed, and denied food! We were married at the Paradisus Punta Cana and could not have had a better experience, we didnt need reservations, the people could not have been nicer! The Paradisus Palma Real was horrible! 

I will say again, the place is gorgeous! Besides the reservations, and front desk people every one else was nice. In all the restaurants except Vento because after they denied us entry we refused to eat there, the staff was nice. The food wasn't all that great, it is an all inclusive you don't expect it to be wonderful, it was very cold, and hard but if you do stay here the steak house Rare was delicious!!! The drinks were delicious the place was gorgeous! Our waiter i didn't catch his name looked like Ray Liotta and he was so kind and professional. We spent a fortune on tips, because the other staff deserved it! George our beach waiter you were awesome! He got me a passion fruit margarita and they didn't even make those! Other than that I would spend your money! This place is prettier but Paradisus Punta Cana is just as nice and we loved everyone there, we honeslty left them feeling sad cause they were all such good people and the food was better. 

PS...If you want to sell a timeshare I think you should advertise something in the lobby saying we offer timeshares please come join us on this date and time in this location, not harass people about it and then mistreat them if they dont want it. In addition, i didn't like being asked to donate money to different charities while laying on the beach. No one wants to be harrased on vacation, leave stuff in the lobby and give people the option to do it on their own.

reviews.author: Steven A
reviews.title: WATERED DOWN ALCOHOL
reviews.text:
*This is less a review of the resort than an advisory to the public (the hotel, grounds, and staff all are wonderful)*

If you look at my tripadviosr profile, I hardly leave bad reviews, but I think the behavior at the Palma real resort was so egregious that it was necessary to point out.  

This resort unequivocally adds water to their liqueur bottles. Now you may think this is acceptable and maybe par for the course as far as all inclusive's go, but at this price range - when you're spending close to $500 a night - to have the resort nickel and dime you (an insult) in such a manner is unacceptable. 

This is the case at all bars at the resort - reaffirmed by a taste test from two seperate bottles of the same liqueur - I would sip a pre opened bottle and then ask the bartender to open a brand new bottle - where it was abundantly clear what was going on. 

I assume management will respond here and apologize but quite frankly, this stuff doesn't happen without management knowing and abating. 

Furthermore, the bartenders at the resort are fabulously skilled at making cocktails but this talent is wasted, as most taste like sugar water due to the aforementioned shenanigans.

It's just insulting and embarrassing for a premium brand resort to stoop to that level.

reviews.author: Allison H
reviews.title: Cleaning Staff Stole
reviews.text: The resort is a beautiful place to relax and unwind.  HOWEVER, if I am going to pay for a 5 star hotel I want a 5 star experience.  After our first night we realized money was missing from my wallet.  Typically on vacation my husband pays for everything so I do not use my wallet.  I kindly went to the front desk to let them know about the situation.  Rather than saying they would look into it and get back with me they went through our room twice accusing us of "hiding the money."  We continued to get stolen from for the next two days until I had no cash left.  I hid my wallet in different locations and the staff was able to still find it!  When we left they said they would continue their investigation and let us know how we would be reimbursed.  After contacting them five times they let us know nothing was found on their staff and they were sorry for our loss.  Unacceptable!

reviews.author: sunloving2015
reviews.title: Not what we expected!
reviews.text: Do yourself a favor and sort by all the one and two star reviews. I ignored those negative reviews and wish I hadn't. The dinner reservation system is a joke! They push you to eat at the buffets and claim the restaurants are full. It was a haggle all week long getting into a restaurant. Getting a cup of coffee in the restaurant in the morning was even harder. Don't even get me started on the time share presentation. I wouldn't even consider the meeting given how bad the service was all over the resort. The property was nice but in no way a 4 or 5 star resort given all the service issues.  It was not just our family having the issues either. We heard other families complaining each time we walked through the lobby of our building. I don't see how this property is getting such rave reviews. Buyer beware!

reviews.author: David James C
reviews.title: Service is extremely poor and rare
reviews.text: The I was the worst service I have ever seen. The tips don't seem to motivate the staff. If you don' t mind going and getting your drinks you might like it. The food is average. Two good restaurants. The resort is beautiful and large. Watch out for the outside activities bate and switch on what you get.

reviews.author: Jordan C
reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: We stayed for four days for my brother's wedding and were very dissatisfied with the whole experience. Had three issues with management that were handled poorly: they double charged us for the room; did not fix our running toilet; and locked our phones and purse in the room safe without notifying us (scared me half to death).

reviews.author: jenann1112
reviews.title: Am I staying at the same resort as the rest of these people??
reviews.text:
I am curretly staying at the hotel and I am looking forward to going home.  This place is terrible!!  It is run on the a scarcity model and with some customers as being "special."  Here are the pros:
1. The nature is beautiful.  Lovely beach, nice landscaping, perfect weather.
2. Food is fine.  Nothing special but enough variety to please most people.
3. The pool is also fine. It may be worth staying on this side of the resort if you don't have kids.  It's almost empty which is nice.  You don't feel like you are swimming on top of peope

And the cons:
1. When we arrived, they did not have the room we requested/paid for in our package (2 queen beds) so they showed me 2 different rooms.  Both with kings.  Both on the third floor with no elevator.  We chose to be upgraded so they put us in  the family conceirge section but we did not get family conceirge.  And they made me pay $500 in cash (weird... I'm sure that wentright into somebody's pocket) for the room.  Now my son has slept on a sofa bed all week and is having back pains.  
2. So now we are in the family conceirge section but not family conceirge guests.  Well that must have been a personal attack on all of them because they treat us like lepers.  They won't even say hello/hola.  One of them did whistle at me one morning which was super inappropriate and had my 11 year old asking me if that really just happened.  
3. The resort is very large.  They say that they have trams that circle every 5 minutes but it's more like every half hour and then good luck getting a seat. 
4. You can rent bikes but good luck getting there early enough to get one. 
5. There is almost nothing for kids to do at the Reserve pool.  You need to go to the other pool.  
6. The staff is rude. 
7. The staff does not speak English.  At all.  I speak Spanish and found myself interpreting half the day.  I am not one to say that all should learn English but please do not ask me to interprete.  
8. We had to call for the last two days to get our minibar restocked.  We got home from an excursion today at 8pm and had no water to drink.  I'm so tired of asking for stuff I have paid a lot for.
9. I am basically harrassed everyday by the Melia Club people to join their time share thing.  It's ridiculous.  Last time I checked, no meant no.....

Basically, save yourself the trouble (and some money) and go to the Paradisus in Playa del Carmen, Mexico.  You won't regret it.

reviews.author: ashishdoc1973
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text:
Horrible experience
Especially front desk
They messed up our rooms gave us smaller rooms than we had booked and made us move in between our stay to other rooms even when our son was sick
Did not have any of the dinner reservations that we had made
Overall 1 star service at 5 star price
Never recommend it

reviews.author: Faron H
reviews.title: DON'T DO IT!!!!!
reviews.text: IF YOU DECIDE TO DO IT, please print every single piece of documentation and take it with you to the property.  They will screw up everything from your trip to the hotel (ground transportation) to the room rate, location and quality!  If you do not have written documentation you're screwed.

reviews.author: Phillip L
reviews.title: DO NOT STAY HERE
reviews.text: Just FYI this place is not worth the money. Not even comparable to service you would receive at a Mexican resort. Staff are indifferent and spend most of their time talking/playing with each other. If you have a question or require assistance, don't expect them to help you out. They'll just say I don't know or ask someone else. Would not recommend staying here, much better resorts for half the price with much better service.

reviews.author: jinkgo b
reviews.title: can't manage to talk to anyone via the hotel number
reviews.text:
I have tried to call the hotel for days and 100 times and still can't manage to get an answer yet. Once someone answer the phone, I tell him what I'm asking about (a shuttle bus from the airport to the hotel etc.) , he put me through a voice mail box with Spanish, or the phone just went silence.

If that's how the hotel treats any customer, I guess it is a zero star.

reviews.author: RobfromLondonontario
reviews.title: Not worth the money beware or timeshare sharks!
reviews.text:
So we just returned from Punta Cana and I've always said I wouldn't stay anywhere else than Majestic Elegance but after being there 5 times in the last 7 years I thought I would try something new. 
That being said I was a good trip advisor and read up on the "best resorts" in PC. #1 was "The Reserve at Paradisius Punta Cana" surely I couldn't go wrong! 
After arriving I was quite impressed, small quaint check in with extremely nice check in staff. Almost too nice. It was very quiet as well which I found odd. 
Well after we got to the room which was a decent size and in reasonable condition we decided to look around. That's when we figured out we were almost 1.5 Kms from the beach! ( turns out that wasn't a bad thing as it helped keep the weight off from eating so much) 
There are little trams running every 20 minutes or so if you really don't want to walk. 
That being said it started to head downhill from there. To get a "palapa" by the pool or the beach it had to be reserved but the catch was that it was only reserved for the families that had concierge. So really as a couple we were screwed unless we were up at an ungodly hour to put a towel on the very few ones that haven't been marked the night before.
Which lead to the next problem. We knew that it wasn't an adults only resort but on the website it says that there is a kids pool. What it didn't say is that there is absolutely no where that a couple can relax without having screaming kids throwing balls and splashing around. 
Ya I know that it doesn't sound nice but we paid top dollar to be there as well and left ours at home to try to have a quiet holiday.  The large pool is completely open to families so the kids have the run of both pools in the "Reserve" area. 
Now hearing from the families constantly complaining as well about the "reserve policy" they were having as much trouble as well as they had far too few for the amount of guests that were there. You had to pretty much bribe the beach guy to remove planted towels from a "taken" one if you were to have a chance to get one after 10 am. Overall a lot of pissed off negative people walking around.
The food was ok. Far from 5star which we have had in the past at other resorts. The 3 buffets all served the same boring food with very little change during the week. We had a cockroach walk across out table at the "bama" Japanese restaurant which was mediocre at best. Saw another roach crawl across the wall there as well. Not very appetizing. 
We also saw a huge roach in the hallway right outside our room but I guess rats and roaches are to be expected in the DR we just have never seen them at the better resorts. 
We got duped into spending the $150 ($120 plus tip) at the passion restaurant which is played up to be 6star cuisine. What a joke. Although the service was great and the manager was nice the food was non existent and not special at all other than how it was presented. A total waste of money. Also they nail you another $60 per couple to do their wine sample during dinner. 
Other a la carte restaurants were decent, but nothing memorable. 
The thing that stood out the most was the poor service overall, I think because of the high price of the resort and the family nature that not many people tipped so the staff didn't seem motivated to please. I usually tip 4 to 5 hundred dollars over a 7 day period and you have staff happy and willing to wait on you hand and foot. It is a vacation you know! Also doesn't hurt helping these poor people that make next to nothing slaving in these places.
We happened to run into the general manager "Roderico" at one of the bars and I voiced my displeasure. He was extremely nice and said he would fix it. Offered to send us to the other $20 upgrade restaurant but nothing ever came of it. 
He said the ultra small " adults only Royal service" area was overbooked internally so he couldn't accommodate us there either. ( funny thing is that that area was cheaper when we booked) 
We walked through and it was a 20x 40 pool with people crammed in. Another joke.   
So in the end I take the blame for not somehow figuring out that the only privacy was in this tiny area that we were not allowed into although we paid the top price at this paradisius resort. 
And one last thing, the reason why the concierge staff was so nice when we arrived is that their primary job is to whisk you away to the hard sell time share that is the true heart of this "melia club" resort. 
Nothing like spending good money to get away only to be pressured and then looked down and ignored once you refuse to buy into the hard sell of a timeshare. 
So take my advise and don't always think that #1 on the list is the best. I'll be returning to the majestic elegance for some great food, great service and an overall relaxing vacation next time!

reviews.author: Lisa S
reviews.title: Never Again
reviews.text: They give a whole new meaning to all inclusive. I have just returned from a four night five day stay and brought home bed bugs. The service, staff, food and overall experience was by far the worse experience I've had in years.  Trying to get assistance with reservations, basic first aid and table service was next to impossible. The wifi was turned on at 8am and off in the evening. Asked for no first floor room but that is what I received. We asked to have rooms located next to each other, didn't receive that. Was pressured to join rewards program even after declining several times.

reviews.author: James S
reviews.title: It's the little things...
reviews.text:
This review is for the royal service in a garden view room. 

This hotel has a great setting. The grounds, beach, pool and room size are all very good and if you get a decent deal and come with average expectations it'll be ok. 

However do not get the royal service. Our butler never picked up his phone. It's a complete waste of money. Whenever we went to complain at the desk they wouldn't give a straight answer and just tried to push you back to calling the butler (who didn't answer).

My biggest gripe however is the with the small things that don't take much to fix but make the difference. 

Things like you order breakfast in the room but they never give you another ordering card, you go the gym and there are no clips for the barbell, towels don't get replaced, the mirror is affixed to the wall at a weird angle, the shower only has 1 temperature, you ask about checking in and they say in 15 mins whilst you wait for over 2 hours, they ask if you want a newspaper but never actually give it to you.

The list is pretty endless and these a small selection. The service just isn't that great... 

Also we were staying with 2 other couples on the royal service and they all had equally bad experiences.

Basically save your money, don't do royal service, bring your kids and enjoy the grounds at a good rate and you'll be fine...

reviews.author: Kerry F
reviews.title: Does not live up to photos or expected level of luxury for price.
reviews.text: So many things wrong...broken...unkept.  Towels at pool ran out first day, no loungers to be had.  Tried to make restaurant reservations upon arrival and was told they were all booked for remainder of my stay (despite only being half full every time I walked by at dinner hours).  Food at buffet (that what we had to eat all week) was OK but nothing special.  Included alcohol bevs were weak.  Free snorkel was booked whole week, and we were told to come everyday to see if they could make room.  Free snorkel was a joke...the life jackets were all ripped and latches broken (unusable) and the boat was  basically a small open fishing boat.  Dropped off at reef, told to jump in, and had no ladder to get back in the boat.  Ridiculous.  This resort frequently presented you with many options to purchase extra excursions, upgrades, option, etc....but the all-inclusive was a total joke and waste of money.

reviews.author: Peter S
reviews.title: The worst vacation ever!
reviews.text: After reading the many favorable reviews of this property, I took my first plunge into a Punta Cana vacation.  Beginning with two rooms with showers that did not work and WIFI that was at best intermittent, followed by repeated evasions and misstatements by the senior staff about corrections and concessions to be made, and wrapped up by fantastically high prices for poor service and facilities, I have to wonder at the experience and truthfulness of the reviews I read.  My wife and I travel 3 to 5 times per year for vacations, and have never had anything approaching the abysmal experience at this location.

reviews.author: ThomasR239
reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text:
Paradisus palma real is a big hotel with a nice beach. However the service is severely lacking. 

From the buffet servers to the bartenders, you will notice a sense of indifference from the staff. You are merely the inconvenience between them and their paycheck. There will be 3-4 staff members standing around chatting with each other and you will be lucky if they choose to acknowledge you.

A few examples: for some strange reason the buffet was closed for lunch on a Saturday. Leaving no other option but the snack bar Blue Agave. With only 5 other occupied tables and 3 waiters, i sat for 15 minutes with my girlfriend for a waiter to come by and serve us water or at least take our drink order. We along with a couple next to us were never approached. After making eye contact many times and being ignored i got up and went to the bar myself to get our drinks. The waiters seemed to have selective service, as some patrons were ignored and others served immediately.

The buffet servers seem to be annoyed or hate their jobs. They simply point at you and you tell them what you want. No greeting, no smile. 

Even the concierge who showed us around seemed to be just going through the motions and had everything on auto pilot. Like he just wanted to finish so he could hang out with the other concierges (which he did).

Reservations are also difficult to obtain. Do not expect to eat at a place you want unless it's booked 2-3 days in advance.

This resort also allows sales people to wander around the hotel. Expect to be harassed by people offering excursions or trinkets on the hotel grounds.

There were some pleasant staff members but the negative interactions far outweigh the positives and ruin the whole vacation.

This resort is not worth the price you pay. You're better off staying at a regular hotel and paying for food.

Furthermore i seemed to be the only one tipping yet i received no better service.

Service may be better with royal service or family concierge.

reviews.author: Shay B
reviews.title: HORRIBLE STAY AWAY
reviews.text:
Don't be fooled by the beautiful property. The service is awful they oversold our rooms. I was there for a wedding and the bride and groom didn't even have a room.  They even made some of the guest at the wedding stay at a completely different resort.  Just sad I can't believe how much money we paid and the poor service we received.  We were treated so poorly.

1. Room switch - When we first arrived to the resort we were not given a room until hours after our arrival. Once we were given a room we were told we had to move out the next day.  When I asked if we can stay in the room I was told another guest booked the room. I do not understand why some guest were given priority over us. There where two other guest that were given the same room type and we all paid the same price only to have us be the only one kicked out of our room. Which was extremely inconvenient during our vacation.  

2. Broken Door - Once we arrived in our room the door would not open properly. When told them to have it fixed they came to fix it but it still did not work only this time it would not close. My door was left wide open leaving all my personal belongings at risk. This was another inconvenience where I had to immediately leave after the wedding ceremony and miss a part of the wedding reception to wait until I was able to lock my door.  Yet another inconvenience where I missed a portion of one of my closest friends biggest day. 

3. No telephone - During all of this turmoil our telephones did not work. So each time we had an issue I had to go to the front desk in person only to be told to go back to my room and wait.  

4. Stranger in the room at midnight - Somebody walked in the room while my sister was not dressed in the middle of the night somebody walked in our room because the front desk gave our room to another individual. My sister was sleeping and not properly dressed. She was startled and awakened to a stranger in our room. That experience left her frightened and terrified. She was so scared she had to sleep with mace by her bed to try and feel safe enough to fall asleep. Even after being traumatized by this event, the front desk immediately called her (which surprisingly the phones worked for them) and told her that she was not supposed to be in that room and to come down immediately to the front desk and show our itinerary. This is extremely unacceptable my sister already had a pre-existing nervous condition and this only exasperated it more leaving her more traumatized.
