*Check –in was a breeze.  We were upgraded to a private garden room which was nice and a definite bonus.  Our room was clean, cool and fresh.  The rooms are Huge and nicely decorated.  Though they are showing some wear and tear, but I look at it as they were just coming out of the busiest season, it happens.  
*Food was much better than I was expecting, lots of fresh fruit, seafood and so many different food choices.  Reading some of the review made me very nervous about the food.  
*LOVED the ladies(and gentleman) at the KidsZone!  They are this Resorts shining stars!  
*Beautiful Beaches, there is some seaweed but they take care of it.  
*This resort is beautiful, expansive and impressive.  The grounds are well cared for and the grounds staff is again this resorts shining star.  If they saw a bird, frog or anything interesting they would point it out to our daughter language barrier and all (though we speak/understand some Spanish, I found the accent difficult to sort through).   
*The Spa…a little piece of quite expensive but, oh so well, well, worth it heaven.  
*Housekeeping staff….were so sweet and always made sure we have everything that we needed in our room including extra chocolates for our little one and a nice supply of CocoRico!
	

The Con’s:
*I don’t how to explain this any better than to say plainly-about 80% of the service staff there had a horrible attitude.   The service was BAD to Shockingly BAD overall.  Though, I want to give credit where credit is due.   I wanted the cheerful and friendly Gardeners who always had a smile and a “Buenos Dias” to be our waiter.  Tipping is a waste of money for the most part and thinking back now I wished we had tipped the Gardeners rather than the waiters it would have been more appreciated!
*The Reserve is a distance from the Main Hotel and there are suppose to be golf carts that ferry you between the two Hotels.   I can tell you that we walked more than 50% of time to the main hotel including the above mentioned day.   Yes, that day.  
*Somewhat confusing and difficult to get reservations. 

Restaurants:
*Gabbi Beach:  Wonderful Food and Staff.  	 
*HydroGrill and Bar:  Loved the Staff and Cook at this place.  They are busy and a little slow, but 	they try very hard and they made our daytime at the pool wonderful!  
*Passions:   Wonderful Food and Staff.	
*Market Grill:  Food was very good, but our reservation was at 9:15 and staff seemed ready for us to leave and service was pretty bad. 
*Aqua:  Our worst food experience.  Reservations at 8:15, starters arrived at 10pm.  Our daughter fell asleep on two pulled together chairs her food did not arrive until 10:30, she ordered plain pasta.  
Gabbi Club and Bar:  Service is horrible!  Go to the Main Hotel Buffet for Breakfast and Lunch, the service is better and you have more choices.  
H2o Bar:  What a nice Bartender!
I would not recommend this hotel, but we were very lucky in that we got an incredible deal for our week there, but that was before our unfortunate experience.   Unforgivably Horrible Service is when your hotel is neglectful with the Health of Your Costumers.  There is NO excuse for not having a protocol for ill/injuried costumers and with the number of Staff members we had contact that is absolutely negligent on Paradisus Palma Real’s part.  
If you have any questions please feel free to message me.

reviews.author: lurp1234
reviews.title: Don't go! Terrible experience
reviews.text:
This is the first hotel review I have ever written.  I have to share our experience because no one should pay hard-earned money  to endure such terrible service.

First, we book a 5 day vacation thru Liberty Travel expecting a high-end, all-inclusive experience.  We spent over $5000 for a family of four.  We get to the hotel and the first thing the receptionist says is that we did not book the VIP service.  For an additional $600, we can use a more private pool, a more private beach and eat at a larger selection of restaurants.  He then ties to sell us on an upgraded room for an additional $200.

We are then intriduced to our "concierge" who told us that he will make sure our stay is perfect.  First thing is that we had to wait 1 1/2 hours till our room was ready.

There are a number of restaurants on the resort that serve different kinds of cuisine.  However, we could not get a reservation before 9PM at any of the popular ones because they best times are reserved for their time-share program and VIP guests.

The food in the general buffet restaurants is inedible.  The waiters are nice but it seems that they are sorely understaffed.  We waited absurdly long periods of time between drink and coffee refills.

We could not get cushions for our beach chairs.  Once again, we were told that the cushions were reserved for their time-share program and VIP guests.  How can they not have enough cushions?

No towels in the gym.  No hand towels in many of the restrooms. 
My recommendation...find another resort.

reviews.author: Анна Ш
reviews.title: Terrible service for big money
reviews.text:
If you want to stay in a hotel where the General Manager will tell you: are you going to sleep now? After your complaints that your bed has no bedclothes after cleaning!! Come on!! I should not explain what I am going to do in my room, for which I paid (by the way I had very high temperature and I called to the manager after few calls to room service, etc).
If you want to stay in a hotel where you book a table restaurant, you go there and they tell you that there is no your reservation. You spend a lot of time explaining, asking, demanding and finally they gave you a table and... The restaurant is empty, only few tables are busy. Does all this talks worth that????
So if you don't want to spoil your vacations and spend too much money for that - DON'T GO THERE!!

reviews.author: chrisozz
reviews.title: BEWARE: Bait and switch: Looks can be deceiving - terrible service
reviews.text:
Complete Bait and Switch!  I booked a 6 person birthday trip online in Nov getting a special rate for 3 rooms that included the "Royal Service" in a garden suite.   I had called to clarify the extra service and special rate prior to booking and was told at the time that there were 9 rooms left.  I booked three.  I was particularly interested in the Royal Service as it allowed us entry to the adult only beaches, which all of my travelers, especially those with families that they were leaving behind, would appreciate.

Upon check-in, the front desk person said our rate was actually lower than what I had booked, and there was no "Royal Service".  Despite having the paperwork to show our confirmed rate, he said he would look into the reservation company as to why my rate was higher than the rooms they had for us and get back to us after we enjoyed some lunch.  

Lunch buffet was average, wide selection of local foods.  The property is nice, great vast views of the water and a nice pool.

An hour and a half later after lunch the front desk offered no solution and somehow blamed me for the mistake.  While my confirmation  did not mention "royal service", the confirmed, written rate for the rooms was the advertised rate online at that time that I booked, which was obviously different than the rate that they were now quoting us.   He blamed me and then the reservation company for the error.  Despite me having called and spoken to people at the time of the reservation prior and reconfirming the "royal service" booking by phone after I placed my order online, apparently I should have known that the email confirmation needed to say that it was a special rate with additional services.  The front desk people refused to acknowledge the fact that the rates on my confirmation matched that of the special and insisted on giving us the lesser quality/service rooms.

My request to speak to a manager fell on deaf ears.  When we had a local friend who is the real estate agent that referred us to this property talk to the front desk person on the phone, he revealed that they actually were overbooked and couldn't give us the room that we had reserved even if they wanted to.  The front desk supervisor eventually came out, 2 hours later and just kept repeating that they couldn't do anything, that the rooms we had were the cheaper ones they offered.  They were unapologetic, blaming me and the reservation company.  After three hours of heated conversation going no where, and we arranged for staying at Tortuga Bay, they offered us rooms at another lower end property.   

There was a wedding party checking in at the time we were dealing with all this hassle and all I could think about was how terrible it would be to be a bride dealing with the incompetence and lack of customer service demonstrated by the front desk at this hotel.  I strongly discourage anyone from booking with this property and definitely don't expect them to be able to coordinate all the fine details of any special event.

Despite getting a note from them in writing that they would no charge us a cancellation fee, I am now having my credit card fight the charges that appeared on my  credit card 2 weeks later.

So three hours of hell into the start of what was supposed to be a luxurious rare getaway to celebrate birthdays, we were finally whisked away by the amazing people from Tortuga Bay, where the service was outstanding,  accommodation were luxurious, right on the beach and food was amazing.  Everything was perfect at Tortuga Bay.  

Leave the bait and switch for the fish.  If you want a hassle-free, relaxed, fun time, go to Tortuga Bay.

reviews.author: krapihotelssuk
reviews.title: Vacation HELL
reviews.text:
I had the pleassure to stay in "paradise" at the paradisus palma real in punta cana. i stayed at the reserve with my son matthew. the reserve is said to be the nicest part of the hotel. but if what happed there was at the nicest part of the hotel, i cant imagne what the other part is like.

By staying at the reserve we got our own  family concierge , but in 3 mins. we had to change to someone who could understand english. the new concierge was very hepful and nice i give him 5 stars.after all that trouble we ate dinner at gabi club. the food and service were horibel so we left to our room. we order room service and i wash up in the bath room. as i get out i shut the sliding door and  out of know where a arir vent hits me in the head. and they wouldnt recompinsate me. i have to stop writing now because of a headache from somthing rectangular and heavy.

reviews.author: Monica-Tfe
reviews.title: Patético
reviews.text:
NO VALE LO QUE CUESTA, cómo mucho la mitad. No es un hotel para estar dentro de "The Leading Hotel of the World"

Mal servicio en general:
- Ofrecen muchos restaurantes y la mitad están cerrados.
- En el almuerzo era imposible comer con la bebida siempre la traían al finalizar. 
- Habitación con olor a cerrado y a humedad. 
- Amenities de hotel de 3*, toallas de baño asperas.
- El personal de la recepción es muy incompetente: no nos dan habitación con cama kingsize a pesar de haber muchas disponibles. No nos quieren facilitar el mail del director y dicen no saber cómo se llama ¿cómo es posible?.
- Pésimo servicio de camareros en la zona de la playa.
- Poco material de deportes acuáticos.
- Acoso constante y desagradable del personal del club de vacaciones.
- No ofrecen internet abierto ni en las zonas comunes, muy cutre para un hotel de lujo.
- etc etc etc
Desde luego si quieres unas vacaciones de lujo este no es tu hotel.

reviews.author: SPAGIRL111
reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text:
A ripoff!
For what they charge we expected luxury-what we got was horrible service,terrible food,1/2 the restuarants areclosed, BED BUGS ALL OVER,the staff has no idea of what you want and could not care less.
I would suggest staying at Eden (NH) next door for less than 1/2 the price.!

reviews.author: DRBride7
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel but MANY MANY issues, dont waste yoru time or money
reviews.text: I got married at Paradisus and was very disappointed with my experience.  There is no rhyme or reason as to how this hotel is run.  It is virtually impossible to get dinner reservations and you wind up eating in  the only other option you have, the buffet.  This hotel is very expensive and to have to eat in a buffet everyday for breakfast lunch and dinner is outrageous.  I traveled with 60 guests and each one of them had several issues, none of which were fixed.  For example severely moldy rooms, leaky showers, water bugs and mosquitoes in rooms etc.  I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

reviews.author: hoyasaxa00
reviews.title: Not worth the price!
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at this hotel in march 2008 and I've been meaning to write a review because we hated it so much!  The whole thing started off bad when they took us to our room and it was much smaller than we expected.  When we complained that it didn't look like the room we had selected online we discovered that it wasn't the room we saw online, not the room we booked and not the room we were paying for.  It took 2 days for them to move us and they didn't even want to reduce the rate for the smaller room they put us in! We then moved to the our correct room and paid extra for the family concierge service because by this time we realized that you pretty much could not get a pool or beach chair unless you had access to one of the concierge pool/beach.  I can't say enough about the terrible service.  It seemed like the entire 7 days were were there someone was trying to pitch their stupid vacation club.  If you sit through their pitch they offer you "private beach" and a "private pool". You just might have to do this in order to get a chair.  

This hotel was so overpriced for what you get. We spent less money for a stay at the Four Seasons with superb service.  I'm not only into fancy chains - also stayed at the Marriott in Cancun at HALF the cost of this hotel and would go back there any day.

There are better hotels on the island for a fraction of the cost - keep shopping.

reviews.author: Divalatina73
reviews.title: The 50/50 Honeymoon
reviews.text:
We normally go to Iberostar but decided to try something new for our honeymoon. What a mistake!! We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real - the Reserve which is supposed to be an upscale, exclusive part of the property w/full mini bar, 24 hr room service, daily concierge service, and sooo much more. Boy, we were misled. Our mini bar was stocked twice in the 8 days that we were there. I had items stolen from me (cell phone and necklace), the room service NEVER got our orders right and we waited HOURS for the food to get there. Certain restaurants wouldn't even be open on some nights and the staff wouldn't know from day to day which restaurants/buffets would be open on any given day. Everyone hovered expecting to be tipped CONSTANTLY. The food was beyond horrible for an all inclusive. 
We went to the Thai Fusion restaurant and the rice was raw, the next night we went to the steak restaurant and there was a fliy in our dessert.  To make matters worse, if you complained, very few people cared or even attempted to fix the matter.  Again, I've traveled to all inclusive resorts before but this was by far the worst experience of our lives and a complete and total waste of our money. I have to agree w/the other reviewer that the casino was beyond sad, it was small and just uninspiring. There was very little to do on the property itself (another shock from other resorts that I've stayed at). And we heard people constantly flipping out at the management staff for poor service at the spa, bad food, and inconsistent service. Every once in a while you would meet a person that would prove that service was possible - Veralucia, Genaro, and Juan. 

But overall, if you're going to spend the money, I would not recommend this resort..

reviews.author: traveler12012
reviews.title: Don't Stay here ........
reviews.text:
This place is a nightmare - we booked a full week stay and left after only two days ..... here is why .........

1. They have designated areas for the pool & beach. If you don't pay for Family Service or Royal Service - you get the worst part of the beach & Pool. You cannot use the cabana's and the number of beach chairs actually on the beach are very few. Unless you get up by 7am to claim a beach chair you will not get one either on the beach or by the pool.

2. The food is awful - I can only compare it to low end cruise food and the drinks are watered down and are poorly made.

3. Again with the rooms - unless you pay for the upgraded service - you get the rooms that are not rennovated. Ours smelled of mildew to the point the sheets were damp, the bathrooms were not clean and towels were impossible to find, the mini bar was to be fully stocked and never had more than 4 soda's. Lastly, our room was infested with bugs!

We tried to contact the management - but no one spoke enough english to understand what we were trying to communicate.

This resort is poorly managed and over rated.

reviews.author: anne101777
reviews.title: WEDDING PROBLEMS
reviews.text: I CANNOT STRESS HOW MUCH ANY COUPLE SHOULE RECONSIDER GETTING MARRIED HERE. IT IS SO BEAUTIFUL HOWEVER THE PROBLEMS WE ENCOUNTERED DO NOT OU WEIGH THE BEAUTY.  The first problem arose with the date we chose, for 11 months the date was set and items were engraved for our date. OUR WEDDING PLANNER WAS ON BOARD WITH OUR DATE UNTIL THE DAY WE MET WITH HER FOR THE FIRST TIME FACE TO FACE.  THREE DAYS BEFORE WE WERE SET WITH ALL ITEMS ENGRAVED WITH MAY 16, WE WERE TOLD WE COULD NOT HAVE THAT DATE DUE TO PRESIDENTIAL ELECTIONS. ( I HAVE A FEELING SHE KNEW MORE THAN 3 DAYS PRIOR!) we are now waiting with no resoponse to our calls or emails for our paperwork that was supposed to be done and in our hands in 3 months! it has ow been over 6 months and no one has any idea where it is or what has happened. so now back in the U.S. we are not recognized by our country as a married couple!   am so upset and all i want is to inform new couples about the info they do not tell you and all the while we were told everything is ok!!!!

reviews.author: Diamonds01
reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE! Do NOT stay here!!!
reviews.text:
This hotel is not worth the money! Do NOT STAY HERE!  We paid extra for the Royal service which turned out to be the Royal Screw You Service!  Very over-rated!! No One understands english and they play everything off that they don't understand what you say so they don't have to accomidate you.  Our butler messed up our dinner reservations so bad one night, they almost refused to let us eat in a resturant that wasn't even 25% full.  We have to find a manager that spoke english and that took over an hour then we were finally seated to eat!  Shouldn't have been such a big deal- the resturant wasn't busy!!
Our room in the Royal Service was nice but did see bugs from time to time.
We asked for a late check out - (Check out is normally 12 and we wanted to check out at 1) they told us our room was promised to someone else for early check in and we had to be out by 12- funny when we arrived at the hotel originally they told us there was no early check in and then when we want late check out there magically is early check in for someone else.  HORRIBLE HOTEL!  No where near a 5 star hotel!  
We are a young couple with money to spend and they treated us like DIRT!  I won $50 in the casino and the next morning I wanted them to break the $50 so I could go shopping in the local markets with 1's, 5's and 10's and they gave us the run around- NO ONE WOULD MAKE CHANGE!  What kind of hotel doesn't accomidate when we want to spend money!  Just blows my mind!  
PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE THINK TWICE ABOUT STAYING HERE- DON'T MAKE THE MISTAKE WE DID!

reviews.author: fernando50
reviews.title: Horrible, extremely overated
reviews.text: So, i just came back from the palma de crap. i have stayed in the other paradisus in punta cana and it by far exceeds the palma real. this was by far absolutely the worst the hotel that i have stayed in. so not worth the 400 a night, especially when the hotel was only 26% occuppied. They lacked simple things like black label. what kind of 5 star resport does not have black label, and charges for absolute vodka. this place was extemely overated.

reviews.author: Matthew M
reviews.title: Don't bother unless you like parasites!
reviews.text: I went here for a wedding and was excited upon walking in and seeing how beautiful everything looked.  My happiness was soon quelled by the constant issues I encountered.  Doing anything with the front desk is always a serious pain.  Avoid the front desk if you can because you will be there for a long time while they make a hundred calls to figure out how to accomplish seemingly simple tasks.  The guy checking us in had no idea what he was doing and didn't understand my questions.  The room we got was right near the road so all we heard were cars all night.  They are constantly trying to take you promotional tours to up-sell you into their membership program - extremely annoying!  There is only one place to eat breakfast and lunch daily (actually 2 for lunch but it seems like all the same food).  You can get tired of the food quickly.  There is no place to dine and be served during the day - only buffet and that gets old after a couple days. The buffet has a lot to choose from but there are a lot of warm, creamy selections and questionable-looking deli meats - which doesn't seem appetizing or safe to eat in 90+ degree weather.  Stick with fried stuff with fries. Dining at night was very inconsistent.  We had one good night at a place that serves sushi and hibachi-style stir-fry: food was good, service was good.  We had several occassions where just getting drinks during dinner was almost impossible and one time had to get up and grab the wine bottle myself to serve the table.  They also rush you out if you have a 9:45 reservation because you are the last ones there.  The 9:45 reservation should be avoided if you want a casually served meal.  Even after all of that, the majority of the wedding party got sick from food poisoning and some that were sick went home with parasites - myself included!  I had to go through the exprience of seeing a doctor after coming home to get meds and treatment.  If you like giving stool samples and anal exams, this is the place for you!  There is a general attitude that they expect tips with bad service, which only gets worse when you don't tip.  All-inclusive usually includes service (tips) and additional tipping is for exceptional service. Generally, there always seems to be confusion and disorganization around any planned event like making reservations for dinner, doing activities, or communicating something outside of the norm.  My brother actually erroneously received the marriage certificate from another couple and the front desk told my brother to be responsible for it and give it to the wedding coordinator.  Nobody at this resort wants to be responsible for anything or go out of their way for anyonoe.  I don't want to be the annoying American travling abroad but when you cater to an English-speaking clientele, then it is important that you can communicate to them in English - I would definitely not expect that traveling the countryside or anywhere outside of the resort.  There were lots of kids and mixes of people of different ages.  The pool and the pool bar were both nice.  Get up early to claim a Bali Bed near the pool - it can make your time there more enjoyable.  The beach was nice.  The place looks gorgeous but is offset by poor food and service, and the annoying soliciting of the promotional tour of their membership program.  Overall, I wouldn't recommend it because I have been to several other resorts that didn't have any of these problems with service, sanitary food environments, and obvious operational issues.

reviews.author: kikiheff
reviews.title: Beautiful but not secure
reviews.text:
The property is by far one of the most beautiful I have seen. The pool is amazing. However, the hotel "misplaced" one of our bags (between the bell stand and our room) The bag conrtained electronics and the hotel took no action, and as of yet has made no restution. We spent a portion of our stay at the police station. 

In addition, another member of our group spent a couple of nights at the local hospital with food posioning. You can never pinpoint where that happened, however it is all inclusive and we ate all meals there.

Lastly, it doesn't live up the the "all inclusive" title. It is only every resturant if you upgrade to family concierge.

So, I think you can find other properties with the scenery and better amenities, support and security.

reviews.author: musa_8
reviews.title: No pienso volver
reviews.text:
hola os voy a relatar mi experiencia...
El viaje fue con motivo de la luna de miel y me costó más de un millón d pesetas...y para nada cumplió las espectativas..Al llegar hasta las diez de la noche no nos dieron habitación...y encima tube que quejarme varias veces porque me daban una de camas separadas ( para unos recién casados!!) y eso que pagaba servicio real..En fin ..
Los dias siguientes estubieron muy bien ...las instalaciones son muy comodas y permitian hacer muchas actividades en el mar  y en el spa nos dejamos más dinero porque era ideal..
La comida estubo bien menos en el passion que era muy rara y en platos para pin i pon.
Lo peor...bueno además de que las vistas eran parciales al mar ( informaros bien en la agencia) el servicio real bastante malo 
( los dos ultimos dias no tubimos mayordomo, osea no cojia el telefono) cuando pides algo al room service todo es "_A su orden "pero tardan 3 horas!! La charla del vacation club un timo y lo peor un agobio y un acoso.
Los camareros muy agradables los dos primeros dias ..cuando ven que ya no hay propinas ...la cosa cambia ..Nosotros nos sorprendiamos de las reacciones que tenian con los clientes ..era muy  a saco.
Y lo peor de lo peor fue al final cuando ya nos ibamos... nos dijeron en la agencia que podiamos disponer de la habitación hasta las cinco ,,,i no podiamos entrar ya a la una ...asi que fuimos al lobby y nos comentó que no se podia ...le dijimos que teniamos las maletas( pues no  sabiamos nada) y acordamos que cuando acabaramos de comer a las cuatro las retirariamos y nos marchariamos ya que no sabiamos nada con antelación...
La sorpresa fué que al acabar de comer fuimos a la habitación a buscarlas y nos llamaron al telefono para decirnos que nos iban a cobrar 200 dolares por el retraso  ...y no entendimos nada...Nos molestó bastante y al final nos dijo que nos fueramos tranquilos que daba igual que cojieramos las maletas y nos fueramos.
Vino el maletero y  al cojer el bus para ir al aeropuerto no nos daban las maletas!!!!No tenian alli retenidos ( en serio) hasta que no pagué los 200 dolares no nos pudimos ir ...El trato fué horrible ( no quiero dar más detalles)y la agencia ya esta en marcha para poner una queja formal  al encargado de cobrarnos el dinero que es lo unico que se digno a hacer y que tiene mucho que aprender del trato al cliente .
Aunque el dinero me da igual lo que me importa es que esa persona no debería estar allí , en un hotel de cinco estrellas que cuesta un pastón  y que representa en parte a la cadena melià.
Un poquito de competencia por favor...

reviews.author: staymanToulouse
reviews.title: plus que décevant ...;;;;
reviews.text: ARRIVÉE  a l'hotel paradisus palma réal la1ere  chose a la réception personne parle francais. 2eme  on nous demande en 1er  une caution de 300§ pour le S.P.A meme si nous n'y allons pas . reviews.author: bazook
reviews.title: Paraisus Palma Real is dangerous
reviews.text:
This has to be the worst travel experience of my families life. When we arrived at the front desk which had lines of 10 deep waiting to check in. There was another area where management and guests were huddled together talking. We found out later this is typically the way they handle irate customers with problems.
 They didn't have our reservations. We waited two hours for them to straighten the problem out.We had made reservations for two rooms to be next to each other as we have small children. Not only were we not next to each other but were on different floors.
Any apology? None they said we were lucky to be given a room at the hotel as they were booked solid.

Okay we went to our rooms. We were supposed to get an ocean view room. There is is no ocean view unless you lean out of the terrace and crane your neck you might get to see the water.
Again a shrug of the shoulders from management.

WE had a business associate a single female join us some days into our trip. She was confirmed in our hotel. Upon arriving she was told there was no room for her at our hotel but they could put her up at a hotel 5 miles away and a $14 cab ride each way. They promised her a room the next day. They wouldn't adjust her room rate even though it was a lesser hotel. We knew there would not be a room available because they had been one lie after another. 
As predicted they didn't have a room the next day in fact there would not be a room available at all. We got very angry at this and demanded once again to sit with management and discuss the situation. This time I decided to video tape it. I did get alot of the conversation on tape before security decided to threaten to confiscate my camera if I didn't stop filming. 

We did get satisfaction.Our guest got her room in our hotel.

Two nights later my eleven year old daughter slept in our friends room. Ar 4 am they awoke to find a maintenance worker rifling through her purse. She gave chase and lost the person between some buildings.
Hotel reaction  please don't call the police. WE have a special procedure to handle these things. We called anyway. The police didn't want to make a report. The hotel promised us a copy.

The next day the hotel said sorry we can't give you a report of the incident. I threatened call the American consulate and the hotel then gave me a copy. 

We called the general manager for three days to try and meet with him to tell him this story. Not a call back or acknowledgement. Again no apologies.

This is owned by Sol Melia worldwide hotel group. I would never stay at any of thier hotels or patronize any of thier properties again.

reviews.author: pfknewjersey
reviews.title: A beautiful hotel destroyed by terrible service!
reviews.text: Our stay started out with problems at the front desk. We around 20 minutes before 3:00. Told that check in time is at 3:00 and we should go to lunch and come back at 3:00. We returned after lunch and was given a room and told our luggage was already in the room. No concierge took us to the room, it took us 20 minutes to get there and the room was located far away. Of course, our luggage was not there. We went back to the front desk and told them we did not want that room. The said okay but we could not get another room until 6:00. We sat in the lobby in our travel clothes and waited for another room. The concierage told us that he would tell us about the hotel at 9:00 the next morning. Why couldn't he tell us during the 2 hours we sat in the lobby?  Because he wanted to try and sell us time share. So we never got the introduction to the hotel. At 6:30 we finally got a new room and they found our luggage. First day, totally wasted. Turned out that room was next to the utility closet and we did not sleep at all the first night  because we heard the pipes all night. Went down to the lobby in the morning and asked to have our room changed. They said they couldn't because the hotel was 100% booked and there were no empty rooms.  The hotel was actually about 25-30% booked. They finally gave us another room and a concierge did take us this time and showed us around the room. This room was on the 3rd floor and that night there was a door on the roof blowing opening and closing. Went down to the lobby again to complain and they gave me the 100% booked speech again. I made the head of guest services come up with me and she could not believe how bad it was. She called maintaince and in 15 minutes had the door closed. End of that problem. We had massages in the spa and droped $250.00. Massages were good. However, the next day we took a massage workshop in the Zen pavillian. They told us how they take you into the spa and show you how to use each pool first, than the steam room and then the sauna.  No one showed us and we did it all wrong. They also had fabulous cabanas outside where you could have your massage in as a single or a couple. But no one offered us that and instead we had our massages upstairs and listened to the drilling that they were doing downstairs with construction in the spa. Too bad that  they did not offer the beautiful cabanas. The food was average- enjoyed the Japanese and Asian the best. Some of the outdoor restaurants did not open when it rained and also Nanos did not open until our last day- we were told it was because the hotel was not full enough to have 2 outdoor buffets open. Hmmmm.... they could not change our room because they were 100% booked yet the restaurants did not open because they did not have enough people. Not impressed with the Market Grill because the food laid out there all day from 11:00 to 6:00. We found the atmosphere to be a bummer because everyone we met either in the lobby or the restaurants or the pool had nothing but similar complaints that we had. It was a shame because the hotel was beautiful and the grounds with the gardens was really nice. The service was terrible, food just fair, rooms very musty and nightly entertainment very weak. Overall, we would NEVER recommend this resort and would NEVER return. We have travelled for over 30 years and been to so many great places. This one was a real disappointment and we felt like it was a waste of our money. By the way, we did tip including a real nice tip to the front desk when we arrive and found it did not help at all.     Trip was a bummer!
